### 1.10. `src/llm/providers/ollama.ts` — Modelos Locais

```typescript
// src/llm/providers/ollama.ts
import axios from 'axios';
import { LLMProvider, LLMMessage, LLMResponse } from '../provider.js';

export class OllamaProvider implements LLMProvider {
  id = 'ollama';
  private baseUrl: string;
  private model: string;

  constructor(baseUrl: string = 'http://localhost:11434', model: string = 'llama3:latest') {
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
    this.model = model;
  }

  async chat(messages: LLMMessage[]): Promise<LLMResponse> {
    const response = await axios.post(`${this.baseUrl}/api/chat`, {
      model: this.model,
      messages,
      stream: false,
    });
    return {
      content: response.data.message.content,
    };
  }

  async *stream(messages: LLMMessage[]): AsyncGenerator<string> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/api/chat`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: this.model, messages, stream: true }),
    });
    const reader = response.body?.getReader();
    if (!reader) return;
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = '';
    while (true) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buffer += decoder.decode(value);
      const lines = buffer.split('\n');
      buffer = lines.pop() || '';
      for (const line of lines) {
        if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
          try {
            const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
            if (data.message?.content) yield data.message.content;
          } catch (e) {
            // ignore
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 1.11. `src/jobs/durable-objects.ts` — Jobs Longos com Durable Objects

```typescript
// src/jobs/durable-objects.ts
import { DurableObject, DurableObjectState } from '@arke-institute/agent-core';

export interface JobState {
  id: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed';
  progress: number;
  result?: string;
  error?: string;
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export class ArkheJobDO extends DurableObject<JobState> {
  async onStart(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const body = await request.json() as { goal: string };
    const state: JobState = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      status: 'pending',
      progress: 0,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    await this.ctx.storage.put('state', state);
    await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 1000); // Process in 1 second
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ jobId: state.id }), {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    });
  }

  async onAlarm(): Promise<void> {
    const state = await this.ctx.storage.get<JobState>('state');
    if (!state) return;

    state.status = 'running';
    state.updatedAt = Date.now();
    await this.ctx.storage.put('state', state);

    try {
      // Simula processamento longo
      for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
        state.progress = i * 10;
        state.updatedAt = Date.now();
        await this.ctx.storage.put('state', state);
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      }
      state.status = 'completed';
      state.result = `Job ${state.id} completed successfully`;
    } catch (error) {
      state.status = 'failed';
      state.error = String(error);
    }
    state.updatedAt = Date.now();
    await this.ctx.storage.put('state', state);
  }

  async onStatus(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const state = await this.ctx.storage.get<JobState>('state');
    if (!state) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Job not found' }), { status: 404 });
    }
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(state), {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    });
  }
}
```

### 1.12. `src/orchestrator/ecs.ts` — Integração com chippr-agi (ECS)

```typescript
// src/orchestrator/ecs.ts
import { World, System, Entity, Component } from 'chippr-agi';

export class ArkheECS {
  private world: World;

  constructor() {
    this.world = new World();
    this.registerSystems();
  }

  private registerSystems(): void {
    // SystemSelector: Roteia tarefas para o sistema mais apropriado
    this.world.registerSystem({
      name: 'SystemSelector',
      execute: (entities: Entity[]) => {
        for (const entity of entities) {
          const task = entity.getComponent('task');
          if (task) {
            // Determina qual sistema deve processar
            const targetSystem = this.selectSystem(task.data);
            entity.addComponent('target_system', { value: targetSystem });
          }
        }
      },
    });

    // TaskGenerator: Decompõe objetivos em subtarefas
    this.world.registerSystem({
      name: 'TaskGenerator',
      execute: (entities: Entity[]) => {
        for (const entity of entities) {
          const goal = entity.getComponent('goal');
          if (goal && !entity.hasComponent('subtasks')) {
            const subtasks = this.decomposeGoal(goal.data);
            entity.addComponent('subtasks', { value: subtasks });
          }
        }
      },
    });

    // TheJudge: Avalia conclusão da tarefa
    this.world.registerSystem({
      name: 'TheJudge',
      execute: (entities: Entity[]) => {
        for (const entity of entities) {
          const task = entity.getComponent('task');
          if (task && task.data.status === 'pending') {
            const score = this.evaluateTask(task.data);
            if (score > 0.8) {
              task.data.status = 'completed';
              entity.updateComponent('task', task.data);
            }
          }
        }
      },
    });
  }

  private selectSystem(task: any): string {
    if (task.type === 'analysis') return 'Analyst';
    if (task.type === 'code') return 'Developer';
    if (task.type === 'research') return 'Researcher';
    return 'General';
  }

  private decomposeGoal(goal: string): string[] {
    // Simplificado: em produção usaria LLM para decomposição
    return [
      `${goal} - step 1`,
      `${goal} - step 2`,
      `${goal} - step 3`,
    ];
  }

  private evaluateTask(task: any): number {
    // Simplificado: avalia progresso
    return task.progress || 0.5;
  }

  run(): void {
    this.world.run();
  }

  addEntity(entity: Entity): void {
    this.world.addEntity(entity);
  }
}
```

### 1.13. `src/server.ts` — API REST com Hono

```typescript
// src/server.ts
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { cors } from 'hono/cors';
import { ArkheAgent } from './orchestrator/agent.js';
import { ArkheECS } from './orchestrator/ecs.js';
import { logger } from './utils/logger.js';

const app = new Hono();

app.use('*', cors());

// Agentes
app.post('/api/agent/run', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json();
  const agent = new ArkheAgent({ id: body.agentId || 'default' });
  const result = await agent.execute(body.input, body.context);
  return c.json({ result });
});

app.post('/api/agent/stream', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json();
  const agent = new ArkheAgent({ id: body.agentId || 'default' });
  const stream = agent.stream(body.input, body.context);
  return new Response(
    new ReadableStream({
      async start(controller) {
        for await (const chunk of stream) {
          controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(chunk));
        }
        controller.close();
      },
    }),
    {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' },
    }
  );
});

// ECS (Orquestração avançada)
app.post('/api/ecs/run', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json();
  const ecs = new ArkheECS();
  const entity = ecs.world.createEntity();
  entity.addComponent('goal', { data: body.goal });
  ecs.addEntity(entity);
  ecs.run();
  return c.json({ status: 'started', goal: body.goal });
});

// Memória
app.get('/api/memory/search', async (c) => {
  const query = c.req.query('q');
  const limit = parseInt(c.req.query('limit') || '10');
  // ... implementação
  return c.json({ results: [] });
});

// Job management
app.post('/api/jobs', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json();
  // Inicia job longo via Durable Objects
  return c.json({ jobId: crypto.randomUUID() });
});

app.get('/api/jobs/:id', async (c) => {
  const id = c.req.param('id');
  // Retorna status do job
  return c.json({ id, status: 'pending' });
});

export default app;
```

### 1.17. `src/guardrails/index.ts` — Sistema de Guardrails

```typescript
// src/guardrails/index.ts
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';

export interface GuardrailPolicy {
  name: string;
  check: (input: string, context?: any) => { passed: boolean; reason?: string };
}

export class Guardrails {
  private policies: GuardrailPolicy[] = [];
  private approvalHandlers: Map<string, (input: string) => Promise<boolean>> = new Map();

  addPolicy(policy: GuardrailPolicy): void {
    this.policies.push(policy);
  }

  addApprovalGate(name: string, handler: (input: string) => Promise<boolean>): void {
    this.approvalHandlers.set(name, handler);
  }

  async check(input: string, context?: any): Promise<{ passed: boolean; violations: string[] }> {
    const violations: string[] = [];
    for (const policy of this.policies) {
      const result = policy.check(input, context);
      if (!result.passed) {
        violations.push(result.reason || `Violou política: ${policy.name}`);
        logger.warn(`⚠️ Guardrail violado: ${policy.name} - ${result.reason}`);
      }
    }
    return { passed: violations.length === 0, violations };
  }

  async requireApproval(action: string, input: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const handler = this.approvalHandlers.get(action);
    if (!handler) return true; // Sem handler, aprova automaticamente
    const approved = await handler(input);
    logger.info(`🔐 Aprovação para ${action}: ${approved ? '✅' : '❌'}`);
    return approved;
  }

  toOrdinatioGuardrails(): any {
    return {
      check: this.check.bind(this),
      requireApproval: this.requireApproval.bind(this),
    };
  }
}
```

### 1.3. `bootstrap/orchestrator.ts`

```typescript
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { ArchitectAgent } from './agents/architect.js';
import { BuilderAgent } from './agents/builder.js';
import { ValidatorAgent } from './agents/validator.js';
import { RollbackManager } from './core/rollback-manager.js';
import { MetricsCollector } from './utils/metrics.js';
import { logger } from './utils/logger.js';
import { ApprovalUI } from './ui/approval-ui.js';
import fs from 'fs/promises';
import path from 'path';

export interface BuildGoal {
  description: string;
  maxIterations?: number;
  budget?: number;
  requireHumanApproval?: boolean;
}

export class SelfCreationOrchestrator extends EventEmitter {
  private architect: ArchitectAgent;
  private builder: BuilderAgent;
  private validator: ValidatorAgent;
  private rollback: RollbackManager;
  private metrics: MetricsCollector;
  private killSwitch: boolean = false;
  private iteration: number = 0;
  private totalCost: number = 0;

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.architect = new ArchitectAgent();
    this.builder = new BuilderAgent();
    this.validator = new ValidatorAgent();
    this.rollback = new RollbackManager();
    this.metrics = new MetricsCollector();
  }

  async create(goal: BuildGoal): Promise<void> {
    logger.info(`🚀 Iniciando auto-criação: ${goal.description}`);
    this.emit('start', { goal });

    const maxIter = goal.maxIterations || 50;
    const budget = goal.budget || 10;

    while (this.iteration < maxIter && !this.killSwitch && this.totalCost < budget) {
      this.iteration++;
      logger.info(`🔄 Iteração ${this.iteration}`);

      try {
        // 1. Planejamento
        this.emit('planning', { iteration: this.iteration });
        const blueprint = await this.architect.design(goal, this.iteration);
        this.totalCost += blueprint.estimatedCost || 0;

        // 2. Construção
        this.emit('building', { iteration: this.iteration });
        const codebase = await this.builder.build(blueprint);

        // 3. Validação
        this.emit('validating', { iteration: this.iteration });
        const validation = await this.validator.validate(codebase);

        // 4. Decisão
        if (validation.passed) {
          if (goal.requireHumanApproval) {
            const approved = await ApprovalUI.requestApproval(blueprint, codebase);
            if (!approved) {
              logger.warn('⛔ Rejeitado pelo humano. Rollback.');
              await this.rollback.restoreLatest();
              break;
            }
          }

          this.emit('deploying', { iteration: this.iteration });
          await this.deploy(codebase);
          logger.info('✅ Auto-criação concluída com sucesso!');
          this.emit('success', { iteration: this.iteration, codebase });
          this.metrics.recordIteration(this.iteration, true, Date.now(), this.totalCost, []);
          return;
        }

        // 5. Correção (limitada)
        logger.warn(`⚠️ Validação falhou. Tentando corrigir...`);
        const corrections = await this.architect.correct(validation.errors);
        if (corrections.length === 0) {
          logger.error('❌ Não foi possível corrigir. Rollback.');
          await this.rollback.restoreLatest();
          this.metrics.recordIteration(this.iteration, false, Date.now(), this.totalCost, validation.errors);
          break;
        }
        await this.builder.applyCorrections(corrections);

        // Registra métricas parciais
        this.metrics.recordQuality(this.iteration, validation.coverage, validation.securityIssues.length, validation.warnings.length);

      } catch (err) {
        logger.error(`Erro na iteração ${this.iteration}: ${err}`);
        this.emit('error', { iteration: this.iteration, error: err });
        await this.rollback.restoreLatest();
        break;
      }
    }

    if (this.killSwitch) {
      logger.warn('🛑 Kill switch ativado.');
      this.emit('kill', { iteration: this.iteration });
    } else if (this.totalCost >= budget) {
      logger.warn(`💰 Orçamento esgotado (${budget} USD).`);
      this.emit('budget_exceeded', { iteration: this.iteration, cost: this.totalCost });
    } else if (this.iteration >= maxIter) {
      logger.warn(`⏱️ Limite de iterações atingido (${maxIter}).`);
      this.emit('max_iterations', { iteration: this.iteration });
    } else {
      logger.error('❌ Auto-criação falhou por motivo desconhecido.');
      this.emit('failure', { iteration: this.iteration, totalCost: this.totalCost });
      throw new Error('Falha na auto-criação');
    }
  }

  private async deploy(codebase: any): Promise<void> {
    // Cria checkpoint antes do deploy
    await this.rollback.createCheckpoint(codebase);

    // Escreve arquivos no sistema
    for (const file of codebase.files) {
      const dir = path.dirname(file.path);
      await fs.mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
      await fs.writeFile(file.path, file.content, 'utf-8');
    }

    // Instala dependências (simulado)
    if (codebase.dependencies && codebase.dependencies.length > 0) {
      logger.info(`📦 Instalando dependências: ${codebase.dependencies.join(', ')}`);
      // Em produção: executa npm install ou pnpm install
    }

    // Compila (simulado)
    logger.info('🔨 Compilando código gerado...');
    // Em produção: executa tsc ou similar

    logger.info('🚀 Sistema implantado com sucesso.');
  }

  emergencyStop(): void {
    this.killSwitch = true;
    logger.warn('🛑 Kill switch ativado!');
    this.emit('kill', { iteration: this.iteration });
  }
}
```

### 1.4. `bootstrap/agents/architect.ts`

```typescript
import { LLMEngine, ChatMessage } from '../llm/types.js';
import { OllamaEngine } from '../llm/ollama-engine.js';
import { ExternalFallback } from '../llm/external-fallback.js';
import { PromptTemplates } from '../llm/prompt-templates.js';
import { CodeExtractor } from '../core/code-extractor.js';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';
import { BuildGoal } from '../orchestrator.js';

export interface Blueprint {
  projectName: string;
  components: ComponentSpec[];
  dependencies: string[];
  estimatedCost: number;
  metadata: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface ComponentSpec {
  name: string;
  type: string;
  path: string;
  interface: string;
  implementation: string;
  dependencies: string[];
  testScenarios: string[];
}

export interface Correction {
  filePath: string;
  pattern: RegExp;
  replacement: string;
}

export class ArchitectAgent {
  private llm: LLMEngine;

  constructor() {
    // Tenta Ollama local primeiro, fallback para externo
    this.llm = new OllamaEngine('llama3:latest', 'http://localhost:11434');
    // Em produção, verificar disponibilidade e fallback
  }

  async design(goal: BuildGoal, iteration: number): Promise<Blueprint> {
    logger.info(`📐 Arquiteto projetando (iteração ${iteration})...`);

    const context = this.buildContext(goal, iteration);
    const prompt = PromptTemplates.architecturePrompt(goal.description, context);

    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [
      { role: 'system', content: 'Você é um arquiteto de software experiente.' },
      { role: 'user', content: prompt }
    ];

    const response = await this.llm.chat(messages);
    const raw = response.content;

    // Extrai JSON do blueprint
    const blueprintJson = CodeExtractor.extractJSON(raw);
    if (!blueprintJson) {
      throw new Error('Falha ao extrair blueprint da resposta do LLM');
    }

    return this.parseBlueprint(blueprintJson);
  }

  async correct(errors: string[]): Promise<Correction[]> {
    if (errors.length === 0) return [];

    logger.info(`🔧 Arquiteto corrigindo ${errors.length} erros...`);

    // Lê o código atual (simplificado: usa o último blueprint salvo)
    const currentCode = await this.loadCurrentCode();

    const prompt = PromptTemplates.correctionPrompt(errors, currentCode);
    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [
      { role: 'system', content: 'Você é um especialista em correção de código.' },
      { role: 'user', content: prompt }
    ];

    const response = await this.llm.chat(messages);
    const raw = response.content;

    const correctionsJson = CodeExtractor.extractJSON(raw);
    if (!correctionsJson || !Array.isArray(correctionsJson)) {
      logger.warn('⚠️ Não foi possível extrair correções estruturadas.');
      return [];
    }

    return correctionsJson.map((c: any) => ({
      filePath: c.filePath,
      pattern: new RegExp(c.pattern, 'g'),
      replacement: c.replacement
    }));
  }

  private buildContext(goal: BuildGoal, iteration: number): string {
    return `Iteração: ${iteration}\nObjetivo: ${goal.description}\nOrçamento: ${goal.budget || 10} USD\nLimite de iterações: ${goal.maxIterations || 50}`;
  }

  private parseBlueprint(json: any): Blueprint {
    return {
      projectName: json.projectName || 'arkhe-generated',
      components: (json.components || []).map((c: any) => ({
        name: c.name,
        type: c.type || 'agent',
        path: c.path || `src/${c.name}.ts`,
        interface: c.interface || '',
        implementation: c.implementation || '',
        dependencies: c.dependencies || [],
        testScenarios: c.testScenarios || []
      })),
      dependencies: json.dependencies || [],
      estimatedCost: json.estimatedCost || 0.10,
      metadata: json.metadata || {}
    };
  }

  private async loadCurrentCode(): Promise<string> {
    // Em produção: lê os arquivos gerados
    // Para simplificar, retorna um placeholder
    return '// Código atual...';
  }
}
```

### 1.5. `bootstrap/agents/builder.ts`

```typescript
import { TemplateEngine } from '../core/template-engine.js';
import { SecurityScanner } from '../core/security-scanner.js';
import { Blueprint, ComponentSpec, Correction } from './architect.js';
import { Codebase } from './validator.js';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';
import fs from 'fs/promises';

export class BuilderAgent {
  private templateEngine: TemplateEngine;
  private scanner: SecurityScanner;

  constructor() {
    this.templateEngine = new TemplateEngine();
    this.templateEngine.registerHelpers();
    this.scanner = new SecurityScanner();
  }

  async build(blueprint: Blueprint): Promise<Codebase> {
    logger.info('🔨 Construtor gerando código...');

    const codebase: Codebase = { files: [], dependencies: [] };

    // Carrega templates necessários
    await this.templateEngine.loadTemplate('agent/base');
    await this.templateEngine.loadTemplate('agent/subagent');
    await this.templateEngine.loadTemplate('agent/test');
    await this.templateEngine.loadTemplate('package/package.json');
    await this.templateEngine.loadTemplate('package/tsconfig.json');

    for (const component of blueprint.components) {
      const templateName = this.selectTemplate(component.type);
      const code = this.templateEngine.render(templateName, {
        name: component.name,
        interface: component.interface,
        implementation: component.implementation,
        dependencies: component.dependencies,
        imports: this.buildImports(component)
      });

      codebase.files.push({ path: component.path, content: code });

      // Gera testes
      if (component.testScenarios && component.testScenarios.length > 0) {
        const testCode = this.templateEngine.render('agent/test', {
          name: component.name,
          scenarios: component.testScenarios
        });
        const testPath = component.path.replace(/\.ts$/, '.test.ts');
        codebase.files.push({ path: testPath, content: testCode });
      }
    }

    // Gera package.json e tsconfig
    const pkg = await this.generatePackageJson(blueprint);
    codebase.files.push({ path: 'package.json', content: JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) });
    const tsconfig = this.generateTsConfig();
    codebase.files.push({ path: 'tsconfig.json', content: JSON.stringify(tsconfig, null, 2) });

    // Análise de segurança preventiva
    const issues = this.scanner.scan(codebase);
    if (issues.length > 0) {
      logger.warn(`⚠️ ${issues.length} problemas de segurança detectados na pré-construção.`);
      codebase.files = this.scanner.fixIssues(codebase.files, issues);
    }

    codebase.dependencies = blueprint.dependencies;

    return codebase;
  }

  async applyCorrections(corrections: Correction[]): Promise<void> {
    for (const corr of corrections) {
      try {
        const content = await fs.readFile(corr.filePath, 'utf-8');
        const fixed = content.replace(corr.pattern, corr.replacement);
        await fs.writeFile(corr.filePath, fixed, 'utf-8');
        logger.debug(`✅ Corrigido: ${corr.filePath}`);
      } catch (err) {
        logger.warn(`⚠️ Falha ao corrigir ${corr.filePath}: ${err}`);
      }
    }
  }

  private selectTemplate(type: string): string {
    const map: Record<string, string> = {
      'agent': 'agent/base',
      'subagent': 'agent/subagent',
      'service': 'agent/base',
      'microservice': 'agent/base'
    };
    return map[type] || 'agent/base';
  }

  private buildImports(component: ComponentSpec): string {
    const imports = component.dependencies.map(d => `import * as ${d.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')} from '${d}';`);
    return imports.join('\n');
  }

  private async generatePackageJson(blueprint: Blueprint): Promise<any> {
    return {
      name: blueprint.projectName,
      version: '0.0.1',
      description: `Gerado pelo Arkhe: ${blueprint.projectName}`,
      main: 'dist/index.js',
      scripts: {
        build: 'tsc',
        test: 'jest',
        start: 'node dist/index.js'
      },
      dependencies: blueprint.dependencies.reduce((acc: any, d: string) => { acc[d] = '*'; return acc; }, {}),
      devDependencies: {
        '@types/node': '*',
        typescript: '*',
        jest: '*',
        'ts-jest': '*'
      }
    };
  }

  private generateTsConfig(): any {
    return {
      compilerOptions: {
        target: 'ES2020',
        module: 'commonjs',
        strict: true,
        esModuleInterop: true,
        skipLibCheck: true,
        forceConsistentCasingInFileNames: true,
        outDir: './dist',
        rootDir: './src',
        declaration: true
      },
      include: ['src/**/*'],
      exclude: ['node_modules', 'dist', '**/*.test.ts']
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import ts from 'typescript';
import { spawn } from 'child_process';
import { Codebase, ValidationResult } from './types.js';
import { SecurityScanner } from '../core/security-scanner.js';
import { Sandbox } from '../core/sandbox.js';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';

export interface Codebase {
  files: { path: string; content: string }[];
  dependencies: string[];
}

export interface ValidationResult {
  passed: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  coverage: number;
  securityIssues: any[];
  performanceIssues: string[];
}

export class ValidatorAgent {
  private scanner: SecurityScanner;
  private sandbox: Sandbox;

  constructor() {
    this.scanner = new SecurityScanner();
    this.sandbox = new Sandbox();
  }

  async validate(codebase: Codebase): Promise<ValidationResult> {
    const result: ValidationResult = {
      passed: true,
      errors: [],
      warnings: [],
      coverage: 0,
      securityIssues: [],
      performanceIssues: []
    };

    // 1. Sintaxe e tipos (TypeScript)
    const tsResult = await this.validateTypeScript(codebase);
    if (!tsResult.passed) {
      result.passed = false;
      result.errors.push(...tsResult.errors);
    }

    // 2. Testes unitários (no sandbox)
    const testResult = await this.runTests(codebase);
    if (testResult.failed > 0) {
      result.passed = false;
      result.errors.push(...testResult.failures);
    }
    result.coverage = testResult.coverage;

    // 3. Segurança (estática)
    const securityIssues = this.scanner.scan(codebase);
    if (securityIssues.some(i => i.severity === 'critical')) {
      result.passed = false;
      result.errors.push(...securityIssues.filter(i => i.severity === 'critical').map(i => i.message));
    }
    result.securityIssues = securityIssues;

    // 4. Performance (análise estática simples)
    const perfIssues = this.checkPerformance(codebase);
    if (perfIssues.length > 0) {
      result.warnings.push(...perfIssues);
    }
    result.performanceIssues = perfIssues;

    return result;
  }

  private async validateTypeScript(codebase: Codebase): Promise<{ passed: boolean; errors: string[] }> {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const options: ts.CompilerOptions = {
      strict: true,
      target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020,
      module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS,
      esModuleInterop: true,
      skipLibCheck: true
    };

    const fileMap = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const file of codebase.files) {
      fileMap.set(file.path, file.content);
    }

    const host: ts.CompilerHost = {
      fileExists: (fileName) => fileMap.has(fileName),
      readFile: (fileName) => fileMap.get(fileName) || '',
      getSourceFile: (fileName) => {
        const content = fileMap.get(fileName);
        if (!content) return undefined;
        return ts.createSourceFile(fileName, content, ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, true);
      },
      getDefaultLibFileName: () => ts.getDefaultLibFilePath(options),
      writeFile: () => {},
      getCurrentDirectory: () => process.cwd(),
      getDirectories: () => [],
      getCanonicalFileName: (f) => f,
      useCaseSensitiveFileNames: () => true,
      getNewLine: () => '\n'
    };

    const program = ts.createProgram(Array.from(fileMap.keys()), options, host);
    const diagnostics = [
      ...program.getSyntacticDiagnostics(),
      ...program.getSemanticDiagnostics()
    ];

    for (const diag of diagnostics) {
      const message = ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(diag.messageText, '\n');
      errors.push(message);
    }

    return { passed: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  private async runTests(codebase: Codebase): Promise<{ failed: number; coverage: number; failures: string[] }> {
    const testFiles = codebase.files.filter(f => f.path.endsWith('.test.ts') || f.path.endsWith('.spec.ts'));
    if (testFiles.length === 0) {
      return { failed: 0, coverage: 0, failures: [] };
    }

    try {
      const results = await this.sandbox.runTests(testFiles);
      return {
        failed: results.failures.length,
        coverage: results.coverage || 0,
        failures: results.failures
      };
    } catch (err) {
      logger.warn(`⚠️ Falha ao executar testes no sandbox: ${err}`);
      return { failed: 1, coverage: 0, failures: [`Erro no sandbox: ${err}`] };
    }
  }

  private checkPerformance(codebase: Codebase): string[] {
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    for (const file of codebase.files) {
      const content = file.content;
      // Loops aninhados (O(n^2))
      if (content.includes('for (') && content.includes('for (') &&
          content.indexOf('for (') !== content.lastIndexOf('for (')) {
        warnings.push(`${file.path}: Possível loop O(n^2) detectado.`);
      }
      // Recursão potencialmente profunda
      if (content.includes('function') && content.includes('self') && content.includes('call')) {
        warnings.push(`${file.path}: Possível recursão profunda.`);
      }
      // Leak de memória (setInterval sem clear)
      if (content.includes('setInterval') && !content.includes('clearInterval')) {
        warnings.push(`${file.path}: Possível memory leak (setInterval sem clear).`);
      }
    }
    return warnings;
  }
}
```

### 1.7. `bootstrap/core/template-engine.ts`

```typescript
import Handlebars from 'handlebars';
import fs from 'fs/promises';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

export class TemplateEngine {
  private templates: Map<string, HandlebarsTemplateFunction> = new Map();

  async loadTemplate(name: string): Promise<void> {
    const templatePath = path.join(__dirname, '../../templates', `${name}.hbs`);
    try {
      const content = await fs.readFile(templatePath, 'utf-8');
      const compiled = Handlebars.compile(content);
      this.templates.set(name, compiled);
    } catch (err) {
      // Se o template não existir, cria um padrão
      const fallback = this.createFallbackTemplate(name);
      this.templates.set(name, Handlebars.compile(fallback));
    }
  }

  render(name: string, data: any): string {
    const template = this.templates.get(name);
    if (!template) throw new Error(`Template "${name}" não encontrado`);
    return template(data);
  }

  registerHelpers(): void {
    Handlebars.registerHelper('ifEquals', function(arg1, arg2, options) {
      return (arg1 === arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
    });

    Handlebars.registerHelper('indent', function(text: string, spaces: number) {
      const indent = ' '.repeat(spaces);
      return text.split('\n').map(line => indent + line).join('\n');
    });

    Handlebars.registerHelper('capitalize', function(str: string) {
      if (!str) return '';
      return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
    });

    Handlebars.registerHelper('kebabCase', function(str: string) {
      return str.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1-$2').toLowerCase();
    });
  }

  private createFallbackTemplate(name: string): string {
    return `// Template fallback para ${name}
export class {{capitalize name}} {
  constructor() {
    // Implementação gerada automaticamente
  }
}`;
  }
}
```

### 1.8. `bootstrap/core/sandbox.ts`

```typescript
import { Worker } from 'worker_threads';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

export interface TestResult {
  failures: string[];
  coverage: number;
}

export class Sandbox {
  async runTests(testFiles: { path: string; content: string }[]): Promise<TestResult> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const worker = new Worker(path.join(__dirname, 'test-runner.worker.js'), {
        workerData: { testFiles },
      });

      worker.on('message', (result: TestResult) => {
        resolve(result);
      });

      worker.on('error', (err) => {
        reject(err);
      });

      worker.on('exit', (code) => {
        if (code !== 0) reject(new Error(`Worker parou com código ${code}`));
      });

      // Timeout de segurança (30s)
      setTimeout(() => {
        worker.terminate();
        reject(new Error('Timeout nos testes (30s)'));
      }, 30000);
    });
  }
}
```

### 1.9. `bootstrap/core/test-runner.worker.js`

```javascript
import { parentPort, workerData } from 'worker_threads';
import { spawn } from 'child_process';
import fs from 'fs/promises';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

(async () => {
  try {
    const { testFiles } = workerData;
    const tempDir = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(__dirname, 'test-runner-'));

    // Escreve arquivos temporários
    for (const file of testFiles) {
      const fullPath = path.join(tempDir, file.path);
      await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(fullPath), { recursive: true });
      await fs.writeFile(fullPath, file.content, 'utf-8');
    }

    // Executa testes com Jest (simulado)
    // Em produção: usar jest ou mocha em worker isolado
    const result = {
      failures: [],
      coverage: 85
    };

    // Simulação de falhas
    if (testFiles.some(f => f.content.includes('should fail'))) {
      result.failures.push('Teste simulando falha');
    }

    // Limpeza
    await fs.rm(tempDir, { recursive: true, force: true });

    parentPort.postMessage(result);
  } catch (err) {
    parentPort.postMessage({ failures: [err.message], coverage: 0 });
  }
})();
```

### 1.10. `bootstrap/core/security-scanner.ts`

```typescript
export class SecurityScanner {
  private patterns: { regex: RegExp; severity: 'critical' | 'high' | 'medium'; message: string }[] = [
    { regex: /eval\(/g, severity: 'critical', message: 'Uso de eval() é perigoso' },
    { regex: /child_process\.exec/g, severity: 'critical', message: 'Execução de comandos arbitrários' },
    { regex: /\.innerHTML\s*=/g, severity: 'high', message: 'XSS potencial via innerHTML' },
    { regex: /\.sql\s*`[^`]*\${/g, severity: 'critical', message: 'Possível SQL Injection' },
    { regex: /process\.env/g, severity: 'medium', message: 'Acesso a variáveis de ambiente' },
    { regex: /require\(['"]fs['"]\)/g, severity: 'medium', message: 'Acesso ao sistema de arquivos' },
    { regex: /__dirname/g, severity: 'low', message: 'Uso de __dirname' },
    { regex: /__filename/g, severity: 'low', message: 'Uso de __filename' }
  ];

  scan(codebase: { files: { path: string; content: string }[] }): { severity: string; message: string; file: string }[] {
    const issues: { severity: string; message: string; file: string }[] = [];
    for (const file of codebase.files) {
      for (const pattern of this.patterns) {
        if (pattern.regex.test(file.content)) {
          issues.push({
            severity: pattern.severity,
            message: pattern.message,
            file: file.path
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return issues;
  }

  fixIssues(files: { path: string; content: string }[], issues: any[]): { path: string; content: string }[] {
    return files.map(file => {
      let content = file.content;
      for (const issue of issues) {
        if (issue.file === file.path) {
          if (issue.message.includes('eval')) {
            content = content.replace(/eval\(/g, 'Function(');
          }
          if (issue.message.includes('innerHTML')) {
            content = content.replace(/\.innerHTML\s*=/g, '.textContent = ');
          }
        }
      }
      return { ...file, content };
    });
  }
}
```

### 1.11. `bootstrap/core/rollback-manager.ts`

```typescript
import fs from 'fs/promises';
import path from 'path';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger.js';

export class RollbackManager {
  private checkpointDir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.arkhe', 'checkpoints');

  async createCheckpoint(codebase: any): Promise<string> {
    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const dir = path.join(this.checkpointDir, `checkpoint-${timestamp}`);
    await fs.mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });

    for (const file of codebase.files || []) {
      const fullPath = path.join(dir, file.path);
      await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(fullPath), { recursive: true });
      await fs.writeFile(fullPath, file.content, 'utf-8');
    }

    if (codebase.metadata) {
      await fs.writeFile(path.join(dir, 'state.json'), JSON.stringify(codebase.metadata, null, 2));
    }

    logger.info(`📦 Checkpoint criado: ${dir}`);
    return dir;
  }

  async restoreLatest(): Promise<void> {
    const checkpoints = await fs.readdir(this.checkpointDir).catch(() => []);
    if (checkpoints.length === 0) {
      logger.warn('⚠️ Nenhum checkpoint disponível para restauração.');
      return;
    }

    const latest = checkpoints.sort().pop();
    if (!latest) return;

    const latestDir = path.join(this.checkpointDir, latest);
    logger.info(`🔄 Restaurando checkpoint: ${latest}`);

    // Restaura todos os arquivos
    await this.copyDir(latestDir, process.cwd());
    logger.info('✅ Restauração concluída.');
  }

  private async copyDir(src: string, dest: string): Promise<void> {
    const entries = await fs.readdir(src, { withFileTypes: true });
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const srcPath = path.join(src, entry.name);
      const destPath = path.join(dest, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        await fs.mkdir(destPath, { recursive: true });
        await this.copyDir(srcPath, destPath);
      } else {
        await fs.copyFile(srcPath, destPath);
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 1.12. `bootstrap/core/code-extractor.ts`

```typescript
export class CodeExtractor {
  static extractCodeBlocks(text: string): { language: string; code: string }[] {
    const regex = /```(\w+)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;
    const matches = [];
    let match;
    while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
      matches.push({
        language: match[1],
        code: match[2].trim()
      });
    }
    return matches;
  }

  static extractJSON(text: string): any {
    const jsonMatch = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
    if (jsonMatch) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
}
```

### 1.13. `bootstrap/llm/ollama-engine.ts`

```typescript
import axios from 'axios';
import { LLMEngine, ChatMessage, ChatResponse } from './types.js';

export class OllamaEngine implements LLMEngine {
  private baseUrl: string;
  private model: string;

  constructor(model: string = 'llama3:latest', baseUrl: string = 'http://localhost:11434') {
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
    this.model = model;
  }

  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[]): Promise<ChatResponse> {
    const response = await axios.post(`${this.baseUrl}/api/chat`, {
      model: this.model,
      messages: messages.map(m => ({
        role: m.role,
        content: m.content
      })),
      stream: false,
      options: {
        temperature: 0.3,
        max_tokens: 4096
      }
    });

    return {
      content: response.data.message.content,
      usage: response.data.total_duration || 0
    };
  }

  async isAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await axios.get(`${this.baseUrl}/api/tags`);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  getCost(tokens: number): number {
    return tokens * 0.000001;
  }
}
```

### 1.14. `bootstrap/llm/external-fallback.ts`

```typescript
import { OpenAI } from 'openai';
import { LLMEngine, ChatMessage, ChatResponse } from './types.js';

export class ExternalFallback implements LLMEngine {
  private openai?: OpenAI;
  private activeProvider: 'openai' | null = null;

  constructor(apiKey?: string) {
    if (apiKey) {
      this.openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey });
    }
  }

  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[]): Promise<ChatResponse> {
    if (!this.openai) {
      throw new Error('Nenhum provedor LLM externo configurado');
    }

    try {
      const response = await this.openai.chat.completions.create({
        model: 'gpt-4-turbo',
        messages: messages.map(m => ({
          role: m.role,
          content: m.content
        })),
        temperature: 0.3,
        max_tokens: 4096
      });

      return {
        content: response.choices[0].message.content || '',
        usage: response.usage?.total_tokens || 0
      };
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(`Erro no OpenAI: ${err}`);
    }
  }

  async isAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
    return !!this.openai;
  }

  getCost(tokens: number): number {
    return tokens * 0.00004;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import inquirer from 'inquirer';

export class ApprovalUI {
  static async requestApproval(blueprint: any, codebase: any): Promise<boolean> {
    const answer = await inquirer.prompt([
      {
        type: 'confirm',
        name: 'approved',
        message: 'Deseja implantar esta versão?',
        default: false
      },
      {
        type: 'list',
        name: 'action',
        message: 'O que fazer?',
        choices: ['Implantar', 'Rejeitar', 'Modificar e Reenviar'],
        when: (answers) => !answers.approved
      }
    ]);
    return answer.approved || answer.action === 'Implantar';
  }

  static async requestKillConfirmation(): Promise<boolean> {
    const answer = await inquirer.prompt([
      {
        type: 'confirm',
        name: 'kill',
        message: 'Tem certeza que deseja ativar o kill switch?',
        default: false
      }
    ]);
    return answer.kill;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import Database from 'better-sqlite3';
import path from 'path';

const DB_PATH = path.join(process.cwd(), '.arkhe', 'metrics.db');

export class MetricsCollector {
  private db: Database.Database;

  constructor() {
    this.db = new Database(DB_PATH);
    this.initDb();
  }

  private initDb() {
    this.db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iterations (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        timestamp INTEGER,
        iteration INTEGER,
        success INTEGER,
        duration INTEGER,
        cost REAL,
        errors TEXT
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS code_quality (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        iteration_id INTEGER,
        coverage REAL,
        security_issues INTEGER,
        performance_warnings INTEGER
      );
    `);
  }

  recordIteration(iteration: number, success: boolean, duration: number, cost: number, errors: string[]) {
    const stmt = this.db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO iterations (timestamp, iteration, success, duration, cost, errors)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    stmt.run(Date.now(), iteration, success ? 1 : 0, duration, cost, JSON.stringify(errors));
  }

  recordQuality(iterationId: number, coverage: number, securityIssues: number, perfWarnings: number) {
    const stmt = this.db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO code_quality (iteration_id, coverage, security_issues, performance_warnings)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    stmt.run(iterationId, coverage, securityIssues, perfWarnings);
  }

  getMetrics() {
    return {
      totalIterations: this.db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iterations').get()['COUNT(*)'],
      successRate: this.db.prepare('SELECT AVG(success) as rate FROM iterations').get().rate,
      avgCost: this.db.prepare('SELECT AVG(cost) FROM iterations').get()['AVG(cost)'],
      avgCoverage: this.db.prepare('SELECT AVG(coverage) FROM code_quality').get()['AVG(coverage)']
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { SelfCreationOrchestrator } from '../bootstrap/orchestrator.js';

describe('SelfCreationOrchestrator', () => {
  let orchestrator: SelfCreationOrchestrator;

  beforeEach(() => {
    orchestrator = new SelfCreationOrchestrator();
  });

  test('deve criar um agente simples', async () => {

      description: 'Criar um agente chamado HelloWorld que responde "Hello"',
      maxIterations: 10,
      budget: 1,

    };
```

```rust
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug, Clone)]
pub enum BrokerError {
    #[error("Connection failed: {0}")]
    ConnectionError(String),

    #[error("Order error [{code}]: {message}")]
    OrderError { code: String, message: String },

    #[error("Market data error: {0}")]
    MarketDataError(String),

    #[error("Configuration error: {0}")]
    ConfigError(String),

    #[error("Broker error ({broker}): {message}")]
    BrokerSpecific { broker: String, message: String },

    #[error("Rate limit exceeded. Retry after {retry_after_secs}s")]
    RateLimitExceeded { retry_after_secs: u64 },

    #[error("Authentication failed: {0}")]
    AuthError(String),

    #[error("Not supported: {0}")]
    NotSupported(String),

    #[error("Internal error: {0}")]
    Internal(String),
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, BrokerError>;
```

```rust
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use rust_decimal::Decimal;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use uuid::Uuid;

pub type OrderId = Uuid;
pub type PositionId = String;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Side {
    Buy,
    Sell,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum OrderType {
    Market,
    Limit,
    Stop,
    StopLimit,
    TrailingStop,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum TimeInForce {
    Day,
    Gtc,
    Ioc,
    Fok,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum OrderStatus {
    Pending,
    Submitted,
    PartiallyFilled,
    Filled,
    Cancelled,
    Rejected,
    Expired,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct OrderRequest {
    pub id: OrderId,
    pub symbol: String,
    pub side: Side,
    pub order_type: OrderType,
    pub quantity: Decimal,
    pub price: Option<Decimal>,
    pub stop_price: Option<Decimal>,
    pub trailing_percent: Option<Decimal>,
    pub time_in_force: TimeInForce,
    pub client_order_id: Option<String>,
}

impl OrderRequest {
    pub fn market(symbol: impl Into<String>, side: Side, quantity: Decimal) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: Uuid::new_v4(),
            symbol: symbol.into(),
            side,
            order_type: OrderType::Market,
            quantity,
            price: None,
            stop_price: None,
            trailing_percent: None,
            time_in_force: TimeInForce::Day,
            client_order_id: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn limit(symbol: impl Into<String>, side: Side, quantity: Decimal, price: Decimal) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: Uuid::new_v4(),
            symbol: symbol.into(),
            side,
            order_type: OrderType::Limit,
            quantity,
            price: Some(price),
            stop_price: None,
            trailing_percent: None,
            time_in_force: TimeInForce::Day,
            client_order_id: None,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct OrderResponse {
    pub id: OrderId,
```

### 2.7. `src/unified/factory.rs`

```rust
use crate::traits::BrokerAdapter;
use crate::error::Result;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum BrokerType {
    Ibkr,
    Alpaca,
}

pub struct BrokerFactory;

impl BrokerFactory {
    pub fn create(broker_type: BrokerType, config: serde_json::Value) -> Result<Box<dyn BrokerAdapter>> {
        match broker_type {
            #[cfg(feature = "ibkr")]
            BrokerType::Ibkr => {
                let host = config["host"].as_str().unwrap_or("127.0.0.1").to_string();
                let port = config["port"].as_u64().unwrap_or(7497) as u16;
                let client_id = config["client_id"].as_u64().unwrap_or(1) as i32;
                Ok(Box::new(crate::ibkr::IbkrClient::new(host, port, client_id)))
            }
            #[cfg(feature = "alpaca")]
            BrokerType::Alpaca => {
                let api_key = config["api_key"].as_str().ok_or_else(|| {
                    crate::error::BrokerError::ConfigError("Missing api_key for Alpaca".to_string())
                })?.to_string();
                let secret_key = config["secret_key"].as_str().ok_or_else(|| {
                    crate::error::BrokerError::ConfigError("Missing secret_key for Alpaca".to_string())
                })?.to_string();
                let paper = config["paper"].as_bool().unwrap_or(true);
                Ok(Box::new(crate::alpaca::AlpacaClient::new(api_key, secret_key, paper)))
            }
            #[cfg(not(feature = "ibkr"))]
            BrokerType::Ibkr => Err(crate::error::BrokerError::NotSupported("IBKR feature not enabled".to_string())),
            #[cfg(not(feature = "alpaca"))]
            BrokerType::Alpaca => Err(crate::error::BrokerError::NotSupported("Alpaca feature not enabled".to_string())),
        }
    }
}
```

### 2.9. `src/ibkr/client.rs`

```rust
use crate::error::{BrokerError, Result};
use crate::traits::BrokerAdapter;
use crate::types::*;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use ibapi::client::Client as IbApiClient;
use ibapi::contracts::Contract;
use ibapi::orders::{Order, Action, OrderType as IbOrderType, TimeInForce as IbTimeInForce};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tracing::{debug, info, warn};

pub struct IbkrClient {
    client: Arc<Mutex<Option<IbApiClient>>>,
    host: String,
    port: u16,
    client_id: i32,
    connected: bool,
}

impl IbkrClient {
    pub fn new(host: String, port: u16, client_id: i32) -> Self {
        Self {
            client: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),
            host,
            port,
            client_id,
            connected: false,
        }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl BrokerAdapter for IbkrClient {
    fn name(&self) -> &'static str { "Interactive Brokers" }

    async fn connect(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        debug!("Connecting to IBKR at {}:{} (client_id={})", self.host, self.port, self.client_id);
        let mut client = IbApiClient::new(self.host.clone(), self.port, self.client_id);
        client.connect().map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        *self.client.lock().await = Some(client);
        self.connected = true;
        info!("✅ Connected to IBKR");
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn disconnect(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        let mut guard = self.client.lock().await;
        if let Some(client) = guard.take() {
            client.disconnect().map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        }
        self.connected = false;
        info!("Disconnected from IBKR");
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn is_connected(&self) -> bool { self.connected }

    async fn get_account_summary(&self) -> Result<AccountSummary> {
        let guard = self.client.lock().await;
        let client = guard.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| BrokerError::ConnectionError("Not connected".to_string()))?;
        // Placeholder: implementação real usa client.account_summary()
        Ok(AccountSummary {
            account_id: "DU123456".to_string(),
            currency: "USD".to_string(),
            cash_balance: Decimal::from(10000),
            buying_power: Decimal::from(20000),
            equity: Decimal::from(15000),
            day_trades_remaining: Some(3),
            maintenance_margin: Some(Decimal::from(5000)),
        })
    }

    async fn place_order(&self, order_req: OrderRequest) -> Result<OrderResponse> {
        let guard = self.client.lock().await;
        let client = guard.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| BrokerError::ConnectionError("Not connected".to_string()))?;
        let contract = Contract {
            symbol: order_req.symbol,
            sec_type: "STK".to_string(),
            exchange: "SMART".to_string(),
            currency: "USD".to_string(),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let action = match order_req.side {
            Side::Buy => Action::Buy,
            Side::Sell => Action::Sell,
        };
        let order = Order {
            action,
            order_type: match order_req.order_type {
                OrderType::Market => IbOrderType::Market,
                OrderType::Limit => IbOrderType::Limit,
                _ => IbOrderType::Market,
            },
            total_quantity: order_req.quantity.to_f64().unwrap_or(1.0) as i32,
            limit_price: order_req.price.map(|p| p.to_f64().unwrap_or(0.0)),
            time_in_force: IbTimeInForce::Day,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let resp = client.place_order(0, contract, order).map_err(|e| BrokerError::OrderError { code: "PLACE".to_string(), message: e.to_string() })?;
        Ok(OrderResponse {
            id: order_req.id,
            broker_order_id: resp.order_id.to_string(),
            status: OrderStatus::Pending,
            filled_quantity: Decimal::ZERO,
            remaining_quantity: order_req.quantity,
            avg_fill_price: None,
            last_fill_price: None,
            last_fill_time: None,
            commission: None,
            message: None,
        })
    }

    async fn cancel_order(&self, order_id: OrderId) -> Result<()> {
        let guard = self.client.lock().await;
        let client = guard.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| BrokerError::ConnectionError("Not connected".to_string()))?;
        client.cancel_order(order_id.to_string().parse().unwrap_or(0))
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::OrderError { code: "CANCEL".to_string(), message: e.to_string() })?;
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn get_order_status(&self, order_id: OrderId) -> Result<OrderResponse> {
        // Placeholder: consulta real via client.order_status()
        Ok(OrderResponse {
            id: order_id,
            broker_order_id: order_id.to_string(),
            status: OrderStatus::Filled,
            filled_quantity: Decimal::from(100),
            remaining_quantity: Decimal::ZERO,
            avg_fill_price: Some(Decimal::from(50.0)),
            last_fill_price: Some(Decimal::from(50.0)),
            last_fill_time: Some(chrono::Utc::now()),
            commission: Some(Decimal::from(0.0)),
            message: Some("Filled".to_string()),
        })
    }

    async fn list_open_orders(&self) -> Result<Vec<OrderResponse>> {
        Ok(vec![])
    }

    async fn get_position(&self, symbol: &str) -> Result<Option<Position>> {
        Ok(None)
    }

    async fn list_positions(&self) -> Result<Vec<Position>> {
```

### 2.10. `src/alpaca/client.rs`

```rust
use crate::error::{BrokerError, Result};
use crate::traits::BrokerAdapter;
use crate::types::*;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::json;
use tracing::{debug, info};

pub struct AlpacaClient {
    client: Client,
    api_key: String,
    secret_key: String,
    base_url: String,
    paper: bool,
    connected: bool,
}

impl AlpacaClient {
    pub fn new(api_key: String, secret_key: String, paper: bool) -> Self {
        let base_url = if paper {
            "https://paper-api.alpaca.markets"
        } else {
            "https://api.alpaca.markets"
        }.to_string();
        Self {
            client: Client::new(),
            api_key,
            secret_key,
            base_url,
            paper,
            connected: false,
        }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl BrokerAdapter for AlpacaClient {
    fn name(&self) -> &'static str { "Alpaca" }

    async fn connect(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        debug!("Connecting to Alpaca (paper={})", self.paper);
        // Testa autenticação com GET /v2/account
        let url = format!("{}/v2/account", self.base_url);
        let resp = self.client.get(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            let status = resp.status();
            let text = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            return Err(BrokerError::AuthError(format!("Alpaca auth failed: {} {}", status, text)));
        }
        self.connected = true;
        info!("✅ Connected to Alpaca");
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn disconnect(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        self.connected = false;
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn is_connected(&self) -> bool { self.connected }

    async fn get_account_summary(&self) -> Result<AccountSummary> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/account", self.base_url);
        let resp = self.client.get(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        let data: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        Ok(AccountSummary {
            account_id: data["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(),
            currency: data["currency"].as_str().unwrap_or("USD").to_string(),
            cash_balance: Decimal::from_str(data["cash"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            buying_power: Decimal::from_str(data["buying_power"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            equity: Decimal::from_str(data["equity"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            day_trades_remaining: data["daytrade_count"].as_i64().map(|v| v as i32),
            maintenance_margin: data["maintenance_margin"].as_str().map(|s| Decimal::from_str(s).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)),
        })
    }

    async fn place_order(&self, order_req: OrderRequest) -> Result<OrderResponse> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/orders", self.base_url);
        let side = match order_req.side {
            Side::Buy => "buy",
            Side::Sell => "sell",
        };
        let order_type = match order_req.order_type {
            OrderType::Market => "market",
            OrderType::Limit => "limit",
            _ => "market",
        };
        let mut payload = json!({
            "symbol": order_req.symbol,
            "qty": order_req.quantity.to_f64().unwrap_or(1.0),
            "side": side,
            "type": order_type,
            "time_in_force": "day",
        });
        if let Some(price) = order_req.price {
            payload["limit_price"] = json!(price.to_f64().unwrap_or(0.0));
        }
        let resp = self.client.post(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .json(&payload)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::OrderError { code: "PLACE".to_string(), message: e.to_string() })?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            let text = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            return Err(BrokerError::OrderError { code: "PLACE".to_string(), message: text });
        }
        let data: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| BrokerError::OrderError { code: "PARSE".to_string(), message: e.to_string() })?;
        Ok(OrderResponse {
            id: order_req.id,
            broker_order_id: data["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(),
            status: OrderStatus::Pending,
            filled_quantity: Decimal::from_str(data["filled_qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            remaining_quantity: Decimal::from_str(data["qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)
                - Decimal::from_str(data["filled_qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            avg_fill_price: data["filled_avg_price"].as_str().map(|s| Decimal::from_str(s).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)),
            last_fill_price: None,
            last_fill_time: None,
            commission: None,
            message: None,
        })
    }

    async fn cancel_order(&self, order_id: OrderId) -> Result<()> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/orders/{}", self.base_url, order_id);
        let resp = self.client.delete(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::OrderError { code: "CANCEL".to_string(), message: e.to_string() })?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            let text = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            return Err(BrokerError::OrderError { code: "CANCEL".to_string(), message: text });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn get_order_status(&self, order_id: OrderId) -> Result<OrderResponse> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/orders/{}", self.base_url, order_id);
        let resp = self.client.get(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        let data: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        Ok(OrderResponse {
            id: order_id,
            broker_order_id: data["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(),
            status: match data["status"].as_str().unwrap_or("") {
                "filled" => OrderStatus::Filled,
                "partial_filled" => OrderStatus::PartiallyFilled,
                "accepted" | "new" | "pending" => OrderStatus::Pending,
                "cancelled" => OrderStatus::Cancelled,
                "rejected" => OrderStatus::Rejected,
                _ => OrderStatus::Pending,
            },
            filled_quantity: Decimal::from_str(data["filled_qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            remaining_quantity: Decimal::from_str(data["qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)
                - Decimal::from_str(data["filled_qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            avg_fill_price: data["filled_avg_price"].as_str().map(|s| Decimal::from_str(s).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)),
            last_fill_price: data["last_fill_price"].as_str().map(|s| Decimal::from_str(s).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)),
            last_fill_time: data["updated_at"].as_str().and_then(|s| chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(s).ok().map(|dt| dt.to_utc())),
            commission: None,
            message: None,
        })
    }

    async fn list_open_orders(&self) -> Result<Vec<OrderResponse>> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/orders", self.base_url);
        let resp = self.client.get(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        let data: Vec<serde_json::Value> = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        let mut orders = Vec::new();
        for item in data {
            orders.push(OrderResponse {
                id: Uuid::parse_str(item["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("")).unwrap_or_else(|_| Uuid::new_v4()),
                broker_order_id: item["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(),
                status: match item["status"].as_str().unwrap_or("") {
                    "filled" => OrderStatus::Filled,
                    "partial_filled" => OrderStatus::PartiallyFilled,
                    "accepted" | "new" | "pending" => OrderStatus::Pending,
                    "cancelled" => OrderStatus::Cancelled,
                    "rejected" => OrderStatus::Rejected,
                    _ => OrderStatus::Pending,
                },
                filled_quantity: Decimal::from_str(item["filled_qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                remaining_quantity: Decimal::from_str(item["qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)
                    - Decimal::from_str(item["filled_qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                avg_fill_price: item["filled_avg_price"].as_str().map(|s| Decimal::from_str(s).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)),
                last_fill_price: item["last_fill_price"].as_str().map(|s| Decimal::from_str(s).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO)),
                last_fill_time: item["updated_at"].as_str().and_then(|s| chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(s).ok().map(|dt| dt.to_utc())),
                commission: None,
                message: None,
            });
        }
        Ok(orders)
    }

    async fn get_position(&self, symbol: &str) -> Result<Option<Position>> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/positions/{}", self.base_url, symbol);
        let resp = self.client.get(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        if resp.status() == 404 {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let data: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        Ok(Some(Position {
            id: data["symbol"].as_str().unwrap_or(symbol).to_string(),
            symbol: symbol.to_string(),
            quantity: Decimal::from_str(data["qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            avg_entry_price: Decimal::from_str(data["avg_entry_price"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            market_price: Decimal::from_str(data["current_price"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            market_value: Decimal::from_str(data["market_value"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            unrealized_pnl: Decimal::from_str(data["unrealized_pl"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            realized_pnl: Decimal::ZERO,
        }))
    }

    async fn list_positions(&self) -> Result<Vec<Position>> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/positions", self.base_url);
        let resp = self.client.get(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        let data: Vec<serde_json::Value> = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| BrokerError::ConnectionError(e.to_string()))?;
        let mut positions = Vec::new();
        for item in data {
            positions.push(Position {
                id: item["symbol"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(),
                symbol: item["symbol"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(),
                quantity: Decimal::from_str(item["qty"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                avg_entry_price: Decimal::from_str(item["avg_entry_price"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                market_price: Decimal::from_str(item["current_price"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                market_value: Decimal::from_str(item["market_value"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                unrealized_pnl: Decimal::from_str(item["unrealized_pl"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                realized_pnl: Decimal::ZERO,
            });
        }
        Ok(positions)
    }

    async fn get_quote(&self, symbol: &str) -> Result<Quote> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/stocks/{}/quotes/latest", self.base_url, symbol);
        let resp = self.client.get(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::MarketDataError(e.to_string()))?;
        let data: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| BrokerError::MarketDataError(e.to_string()))?;
        let quote = &data["quote"];
        Ok(Quote {
            symbol: symbol.to_string(),
            bid: Decimal::from_str(quote["bid_price"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            bid_size: Decimal::from_str(quote["bid_size"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            ask: Decimal::from_str(quote["ask_price"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            ask_size: Decimal::from_str(quote["ask_size"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),
        })
    }

    async fn get_bars(&self, symbol: &str, timeframe: &str, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<Bar>> {
        let url = format!("{}/v2/stocks/{}/bars", self.base_url, symbol);
        let resp = self.client.get(&url)
            .header("APCA-API-KEY-ID", &self.api_key)
            .header("APCA-API-SECRET-KEY", &self.secret_key)
            .query(&[("timeframe", timeframe), ("limit", &limit.to_string())])
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BrokerError::MarketDataError(e.to_string()))?;
        let data: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| BrokerError::MarketDataError(e.to_string()))?;
        let bars = data["bars"].as_array().unwrap_or(&vec![]);
        let mut result = Vec::new();
        for bar in bars {
            result.push(Bar {
                timestamp: bar["t"].as_str().and_then(|s| chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(s).ok().map(|dt| dt.to_utc())).unwrap_or(chrono::Utc::now()),
                open: Decimal::from_str(bar["o"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                high: Decimal::from_str(bar["h"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                low: Decimal::from_str(bar["l"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                close: Decimal::from_str(bar["c"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
                volume: Decimal::from_str(bar["v"].as_str().unwrap_or("0")).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO),
            });
        }
        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

```rust
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug, Clone)]
pub enum IsoError {
    #[error("XML parsing error: {0}")]
    XmlParse(String),

    #[error("XML serialization error: {0}")]
    XmlSerialize(String),

    #[error("Validation error: {0}")]
    Validation(String),

    #[error("Invalid field: {field} = {value}")]
    InvalidField { field: String, value: String },

    #[error("Missing required field: {0}")]
    MissingField(String),

    #[error("SWIFT header error: {0}")]
    SwiftHeader(String),

    #[error("IO error: {0}")]
    Io(String),

    #[error("Internal error: {0}")]
    Internal(String),
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, IsoError>;

impl From<quick_xml::Error> for IsoError {
    fn from(err: quick_xml::Error) -> Self {
        IsoError::XmlParse(err.to_string())
    }
}

impl From<serde_json::Error> for IsoError {
    fn from(err: serde_json::Error) -> Self {
        IsoError::XmlSerialize(err.to_string())
    }
}
```

### 3.4. `src/types.rs`

```rust
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use rust_decimal::Decimal;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

pub type CurrencyCode = String;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct Bic(pub String);

impl Bic {
    pub fn new(code: &str) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let cleaned = code.trim().to_uppercase();
        if cleaned.len() != 8 && cleaned.len() != 11 {
            return Err(format!("Invalid BIC length: {}", cleaned.len()));
        }
        Ok(Bic(cleaned))
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Bic {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}", self.0)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct Iban(pub String);

impl Iban {
    pub fn new(code: &str) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let cleaned = code.trim().replace(' ', "");
        if cleaned.len() < 14 || cleaned.len() > 34 {
            return Err(format!("Invalid IBAN length: {}", cleaned.len()));
        }
        Ok(Iban(cleaned))
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Iban {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}", self.0)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Amount {
    pub value: Decimal,
    pub currency: CurrencyCode,
}

impl Amount {
    pub fn new(value: Decimal, currency: &str) -> Self {
        Self { value, currency: currency.to_string() }
    }
    pub fn from_f64(value: f64, currency: &str) -> Self {
        Self { value: Decimal::from_f64(value).unwrap_or(Decimal::ZERO), currency: currency.to_string() }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Party {
    pub name: String,
    pub bic: Option<Bic>,
    pub iban: Option<Iban>,
    pub address: Option<PostalAddress>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct PostalAddress {
    pub street: Option<String>,
    pub city: Option<String>,
    pub country: String,
    pub postal_code: Option<String>,
}
```

```rust
use crate::types::*;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Pain001 {
    pub message_id: String,
    pub creation_date: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub payment_info: PaymentInfo,
    pub debtor: Party,
    pub debtor_account: AccountInfo,
    pub creditor: Party,
    pub creditor_account: AccountInfo,
    pub amount: Amount,
    pub instruction_id: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct PaymentInfo {
    pub payment_method: PaymentMethod,
    pub requested_execution_date: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    pub currency: String,
    pub charge_bearer: Option<ChargeBearer>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum PaymentMethod {
    CreditTransfer,
    DirectDebit,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum ChargeBearer {
    Debtor,
    Creditor,
    Shared,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AccountInfo {
    pub iban: Iban,
    pub bic: Option<Bic>,
    pub currency: CurrencyCode,
}

impl Pain001 {
    pub fn new(debtor: Party, creditor: Party, amount: Amount, debtor_iban: Iban, creditor_iban: Iban) -> Self {
        Self {
            message_id: format!("PAIN-{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
            creation_date: Utc::now(),
            payment_info: PaymentInfo {
                payment_method: PaymentMethod::CreditTransfer,
                requested_execution_date: Some(Utc::now()),
                currency: amount.currency.clone(),
                charge_bearer: Some(ChargeBearer::Shared),
            },
            debtor,
            debtor_account: AccountInfo { iban: debtor_iban, bic: None, currency: amount.currency.clone() },
            creditor,
            creditor_account: AccountInfo { iban: creditor_iban, bic: None, currency: amount.currency.clone() },
            amount,
            instruction_id: None,
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
use crate::types::*;
```

```rust
    pub id: String,
    pub account: AccountInfo,
    pub from_date: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub to_date: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub entries: Vec<StatementEntry>,
    pub balance: Amount,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct StatementEntry {
    pub entry_id: String,
    pub amount: Amount,
    pub credit_debit: CreditDebit,
    pub booking_date: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub counterparty: Option<Party>,
    pub description: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum CreditDebit {
    Credit,
    Debit,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AccountInfo {
    pub iban: Iban,
    pub bic: Option<Bic>,
    pub currency: CurrencyCode,
}

impl Camt053 {
    pub fn new(account: AccountInfo, from: DateTime<Utc>, to: DateTime<Utc>) -> Self {
        Self {
            message_id: format!("CAMT-{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
            creation_date: Utc::now(),
            statement: BankStatement {
                id: format!("STMT-{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
                account,
                from_date: from,
                to_date: to,
                entries: Vec::new(),
                balance: Amount::new(Decimal::ZERO, "USD"),
            },
        }
    }
    pub fn add_entry(&mut self, entry: StatementEntry) { self.statement.entries.push(entry); }
}
```

```rust
use crate::generator::IsoGenerator;
use crate::messages::{Pain001, Pacs008, Camt053};
use crate::error::Result;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SwiftHeader {
    pub message_type: String,
    pub receiver: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SwiftBlock {
    pub block1: String,
    pub block2: String,
    pub block3: Option<String>,
    pub block4: String,
    pub block5: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SwiftMxMessage {
    pub header: SwiftHeader,
    pub body: String,
}

impl SwiftMxMessage {
    pub fn from_pain_001(pain: &Pain001, receiver: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let body = IsoGenerator::generate_pain_001(pain)?;
        Ok(Self { header: SwiftHeader { message_type: "MX".to_string(), receiver: receiver.to_string() }, body })
    }
    pub fn render(&self) -> String {
        format!("{}{}{}{}{}{}",
            "{1:F01XXXXX0001}", "{2:MX", self.header.receiver, "}", "{4:\n", self.body, "}{5:{S}}")
    }
}
```

```rust
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let proto_dir = PathBuf::from("proto");
    let proto_files = [
        "tapcommon.proto", "taprootassets.proto", "assetwallet.proto",
        "universe.proto", "rfq.proto",
    ];
    let proto_paths: Vec<_> = proto_files.iter().map(|f| proto_dir.join(f)).collect();
    tonic_build::configure()
        .build_client(true)
        .build_server(false)
        .out_dir("src/proto")
        .compile(&proto_paths, &[&proto_dir])?;
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=proto/");
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;
use tonic::transport::{Certificate, ClientTlsConfig};

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Macaroon { bytes: Vec<u8> }

impl Macaroon {
    pub fn from_file(path: &Path) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let bytes = fs::read(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if bytes.is_empty() { return Err("Empty macaroon".to_string()); }
        Ok(Self { bytes })
    }
    pub fn bytes(&self) -> &[u8] { &self.bytes }
    pub fn to_hex(&self) -> String { hex::encode(&self.bytes) }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct TlsConfig {
    pub ca_cert: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    pub domain: String,
}

impl TlsConfig {
    pub fn new(domain: &str) -> Self { Self { ca_cert: None, domain: domain.to_string() } }
    pub fn with_ca(mut self, ca_pem: Vec<u8>) -> Self { self.ca_cert = Some(ca_pem); self }
    pub fn to_tonic_config(&self) -> Result<ClientTlsConfig, String> {
        let mut config = ClientTlsConfig::new().domain_name(self.domain.clone());
        if let Some(ca) = &self.ca_cert {
            config = config.ca_certificate(Certificate::from_pem(ca));
        }
        Ok(config)
    }
}
```
