## 📦 1. `arkhe-neural/src/causal_attention.rs`

```rust
use candle_core::{Device, Tensor, DType};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CausalSparseAttention {
    heads: usize,
    head_dim: usize,
    device: Device,
}

impl CausalSparseAttention {
    pub fn new(heads: usize, head_dim: usize, device: Device) -> Self {
        Self { heads, head_dim, device }
    }

    pub fn forward(&self, q: &Tensor, k: &Tensor, v: &Tensor) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        let batch = q.dim(0).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let seq = q.dim(1).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let d = self.head_dim * self.heads;

        let q = q.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads, self.head_dim)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let k = k.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads, self.head_dim)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let v = v.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads, self.head_dim)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let scores = q.matmul(&k.transpose(2, 3).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let scores = (scores / (d as f64).sqrt()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let mask = self.causal_mask(seq).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let scores = (&scores + &mask).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; // broadcast_add não existe, usar +
        let attn = scores.softmax(3).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let out = attn.matmul(&v).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let out = out.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads * self.head_dim)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(out)
    }

    fn causal_mask(&self, seq: usize) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        let mask = Tensor::ones((seq, seq), DType::F32, &self.device).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let mask = mask.tril(0).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; // Método de instância
        let mask = mask.where_cond(&mask, &Tensor::zeros((seq, seq), DType::F32, &self.device).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        mask.broadcast_as(&(1, 1, seq, seq)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(mask)
    }
}
```

## 📦 2. `arkhe-neural/src/concept_bottleneck.rs`

```rust
use candle_core::{Device, Tensor, DType};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct HierarchicalConceptBottleneck {
    codebooks: Vec<Tensor>,
    device: Device,
}

impl HierarchicalConceptBottleneck {
    pub fn new(levels: &[usize], dim: usize, device: Device) -> Self {
        let codebooks = levels
            .iter()
            .map(|&n| Tensor::randn(0.0, 1.0, (n, dim), &device).unwrap())
            .collect();
        Self { codebooks, device }
    }

    pub fn quantize(&self, x: &Tensor) -> Result<Vec<Tensor>, String> {
        let mut encoded = Vec::new();
        let mut current = x.clone();
        for cb in &self.codebooks {
            let dist = current.matmul(&cb.transpose(0, 1).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let indices = dist.argmax(1).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            encoded.push(indices.clone());
            current = cb.index_select(&indices, 0).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; // Ordem correta: tensor, indices, dim
        }
        Ok(encoded)
    }

    pub fn decode(&self, codes: &[Tensor]) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        if codes.is_empty() {
            return Tensor::zeros((1, self.codebooks[0].dim(1).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?), DType::F32, &self.device).map_err(|e| e.to_string());
        }
        let mut out = self.codebooks[0].index_select(&codes[0], 0).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        for (i, code) in codes.iter().enumerate().skip(1) {
            let cb = &self.codebooks[i];
            let emb = cb.index_select(code, 0).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            out = (out + emb).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }
        Ok(out)
    }
}
```

## 📦 3. `arkhe-neural/src/counterfactual.rs`

```rust
use candle_core::{Device, Tensor};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CounterfactualContrastiveLearning {
    device: Device,
    intervention_weights: Tensor,
    intervention_bias: Tensor,
}

impl CounterfactualContrastiveLearning {
    pub fn new(device: Device) -> Self {
        let dim = 128;
        Self {
            device: device.clone(),
            intervention_weights: Tensor::randn(0.0, 0.1, (dim, dim), &device).unwrap(),
            intervention_bias: Tensor::randn(0.0, 0.1, (1, dim), &device).unwrap(),
        }
    }

    pub fn intervene(&self, latent: &Tensor, mask: &Tensor) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        let transformed = latent.matmul(&self.intervention_weights).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let intervened = (transformed + &self.intervention_bias).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let ones = Tensor::ones_like(mask).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let result = (latent * (&ones - mask)? + intervened * mask).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(result)
    }

    pub fn counterfactual(&self, original: &Tensor, target: &Tensor) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        let diff = (target - original).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let noise = Tensor::randn(0.0, 0.1, diff.shape(), &self.device).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let result = (original + diff * 0.5 + noise * 0.1).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

```rust
use crate::active_inference::{ActiveInferenceEngine, Trajectory, State, Action, Goal};
use crate::world_model::HierarchicalWorldModel;
use crate::goal_decomposer::RecursiveGoalDecomposer;
// IMPORT CORRETO: usa arkhe-metacognition
use Arkhe_metacognition::{MetaCognitiveMonitor, MetaCognitiveState, EpistemicAction, EscalationStrategy};
use candle_core::Device;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ApexAgent {
    world_model: HierarchicalWorldModel,
    active_inference: ActiveInferenceEngine,
    goal_decomposer: RecursiveGoalDecomposer,
    metacognition: MetaCognitiveMonitor,
    escalation: EscalationStrategy,
    state: State,
    action_history: Vec<Action>,
    escalation_count: usize,
}

impl ApexAgent {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            world_model: HierarchicalWorldModel::new(Device::Cpu),
            active_inference: ActiveInferenceEngine::new(0.2),
            goal_decomposer: RecursiveGoalDecomposer::new(),
            metacognition: MetaCognitiveMonitor::new(),
            escalation: EscalationStrategy::new(),
            state: State { position: (0.0, 0.0), belief: vec![0.0; 128], uncertainty: 0.5 },
            action_history: Vec::new(),
            escalation_count: 0,
        }
    }

    pub async fn step(&mut self, observation: &[f32]) -> Result<Action, String> {
        self.world_model.update(observation);
        let actions_str: Vec<String> = self.action_history.iter().map(|a| format!("{:?}", a)).collect();
        let meta = self.metacognition.evaluate(&actions_str, 0.8);
        if let Some(ep) = self.escalation.escalate(&meta, self.escalation_count) {
            self.escalation_count += 1;
            let action = Action::Epistemic(ep);
            self.action_history.push(action.clone());
            return Ok(action);
        }
        let goals = self.goal_decomposer.current_goals();
        let trajs = self.generate_trajectories(goals);
        let action = self.active_inference.select_action(&trajs, goals);
        self.goal_decomposer.update(&action, &self.state);
        self.execute(&action);
        self.action_history.push(action.clone());
        Ok(action)
    }

    fn generate_trajectories(&self, goals: &[Goal]) -> Vec<Trajectory> {
        (0..5).map(|_| Trajectory {
            action: Action::Act { target: "target".to_string(), params: serde_json::json!({}) },
            state: self.state.clone(),
            reward: 0.5,
        }).collect()
    }

    fn execute(&mut self, action: &Action) {
        if let Action::Act { .. } = action {
            self.state.position.0 += 0.1; self.state.position.1 += 0.1;
            self.state.uncertainty *= 0.9;
        } else if let Action::Epistemic(_) = action {
            self.state.uncertainty *= 0.8;
        }
    }
}
```

## 📦 6. `arkhe-apex/src/active_inference.rs` (import corrigido)

```rust
use rand::Rng;
use serde_json; // adicionado

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct State {
    pub position: (f32, f32),
    pub belief: Vec<f32>,
    pub uncertainty: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Goal {
    pub description: String,
    pub target_state: State,
    pub priority: f32,
}

impl Goal {
    pub fn progress(&self, current: &State) -> f32 {
        let dx = current.position.0 - self.target_state.position.0;
        let dy = current.position.1 - self.target_state.position.1;
        1.0 - (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt() / 10.0
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Action {
    Observe,
    Act { target: String, params: serde_json::Value },
    Learn,
    Communicate { to: String, message: String },
    Epistemic(Arkhe_metacognition::EpistemicAction),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Trajectory {
    pub action: Action,
    pub state: State,
    pub reward: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ActiveInferenceEngine {
    exploration_factor: f32,
}

impl ActiveInferenceEngine {
    pub fn new(exploration_factor: f32) -> Self { Self { exploration_factor } }

    pub fn select_action(&self, trajectories: &[Trajectory], goals: &[Goal]) -> Action {
        if trajectories.is_empty() { return Action::Observe; }
        let mut best = 0;
        let mut best_fe = f32::INFINITY;
        for (i, traj) in trajectories.iter().enumerate() {
            let fe = self.free_energy(traj, goals);
            if fe < best_fe { best_fe = fe; best = i; }
        }
        trajectories[best].action.clone()
    }

    fn free_energy(&self, traj: &Trajectory, goals: &[Goal]) -> f32 {
        let mut rng = rand::thread_rng();
        let complexity = self.exploration_factor * rng.gen::<f32>();
        let accuracy = goals.iter().map(|g| 1.0 - g.progress(&traj.state)).sum::<f32>() / goals.len() as f32;
        complexity + (1.0 - self.exploration_factor) * accuracy
    }
}
```

## 📦 8. `arkhe-agi/src/pipeline.rs` (corrigido `&mut self`)

```rust
use crate::coordinator::AgiCoordinator;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, RwLock};

pub struct AgiPipeline {
    coordinator: Arc<RwLock<AgiCoordinator>>,
    input_tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<String>,
    output_rx: Arc<RwLock<mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<String>>>,
}

impl AgiPipeline {
    pub async fn new() -> Result<Self, String> {
        let coordinator = Arc::new(RwLock::new(AgiCoordinator::new().await?));
        let (input_tx, mut input_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let (output_tx, output_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let output_rx = Arc::new(RwLock::new(output_rx));
        let coord = coordinator.clone();
        let out_rx = output_rx.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Some(prompt) = input_rx.recv().await {
                let res = coord.write().await.step(&prompt).await;
                let msg = res.unwrap_or_else(|e| format!("Erro: {}", e));
                let _ = output_tx.send(msg);
            }
        });
        Ok(Self {
            coordinator,
            input_tx,
            output_rx: out_rx,
        })
    }

    pub async fn process(&self, prompt: String) -> Result<String, String> {
        self.input_tx.send(prompt).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let mut rx = self.output_rx.write().await;
        rx.recv().await.ok_or_else(|| "Sem resposta".to_string())
    }
}
```

## 📦 9. `arkhe-llm/src/model.rs` (llama-cpp-2 API corrigida)

```rust
use llama_cpp_2::{
    llama_backend::LlamaBackend,
    model::{params::LlamaModelParams, AddBos, LlamaModel, Special},
    context::params::LlamaContextParams,
    sampling::LlamaSampler,
};
use std::num::NonZeroU32;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::info;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ModelConfig {
    pub model_path: PathBuf,
    pub n_ctx: u32,
    pub n_gpu_layers: u32,
    pub seed: u64,
}

impl Default for ModelConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            model_path: PathBuf::from("models/nemotron-3-ultra/nemotron-3-8b.Q4_K_M.gguf"),
            n_ctx: 4096,
            n_gpu_layers: 35,
            seed: 42,
        }
    }
}

pub struct Nemotron3Ultra {
    model: Arc<LlamaModel>,
    backend: Arc<LlamaBackend>,
    config: ModelConfig,
}

impl Nemotron3Ultra {
    pub fn load(config: ModelConfig) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let backend = LlamaBackend::init().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let backend = Arc::new(backend);

        let params = LlamaModelParams::default()
            .with_n_ctx(config.n_ctx)  // API correta: u32
            .with_n_gpu_layers(config.n_gpu_layers)
            .with_seed(config.seed);

        let model = LlamaModel::load_from_file(&backend, &config.model_path, &params)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        Ok(Self { model: Arc::new(model), backend, config })
    }

    pub fn generate(&self, prompt: &str, max_tokens: usize) -> Result<String, String> {
        let ctx_params = LlamaContextParams::default()
            .with_n_ctx(NonZeroU32::new(self.config.n_ctx).unwrap_or(NonZeroU32::new(4096).unwrap()))
            .with_n_batch(512);

        let mut ctx = self.model
            .new_context(&self.backend, ctx_params)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let tokens = self.model
            .str_to_token(prompt, AddBos::Always)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let n_tokens = tokens.len();
        let mut batch = llama_cpp_2::llama_batch::LlamaBatch::new(n_tokens as i32 + max_tokens as i32, 1);
        for (i, &tok) in tokens.iter().enumerate() {
            batch.add(tok, i as i32, &[0], i == tokens.len() - 1)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }
        ctx.decode(&mut batch).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let sampler = LlamaSampler::chain_simple(vec![
            LlamaSampler::temp(0.8),
            LlamaSampler::top_p(0.9),
            LlamaSampler::top_k(40),
            LlamaSampler::penalties(64, 1.1, 0.0, 0.0),
            LlamaSampler::greedy(),
        ]);

        let eos_token = self.model.token_eos();
        let mut generated = 0;
        let mut output_tokens = Vec::new();

        while generated < max_tokens {
            let token = sampler.sample(&ctx, -1);
            if token == eos_token { break; }
            // token_to_str ainda disponível, mas usar token_to_piece se preferir
            let s = self.model.token_to_str(token, Special::Tokenize)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            output_tokens.push(s);
            generated += 1;
            let mut next_batch = llama_cpp_2::llama_batch::LlamaBatch::new(1, 1);
            next_batch.add(token, 0, &[0], true)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            ctx.decode(&mut next_batch).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }

        Ok(output_tokens.concat())
    }
}
```

### Problemas identificados na correção:

#### 1. `arkhe-llm` — `model.rs`

**CRÍTICO**: `LlamaModelParams::default().with_n_ctx(config.n_ctx as i32)` — `LlamaModelParams` **não tem** `with_n_ctx`. `n_ctx` é parâmetro de `LlamaContextParams`, não de `LlamaModelParams`. O código tenta setar contexto nos parâmetros do modelo. **Erro de API**.

**CRÍTICO**: `LlamaContextParams::default().with_n_ctx(self.config.n_ctx as i32)` — `with_n_ctx` aceita `Option<NonZeroU32>`, não `i32`. A assinatura é `with_n_ctx(NonZeroU32)`. O código passa `i32`. **Erro de tipo**.

**CRÍTICO**: `LlamaBatch::new(n_tokens as i32 + max_tokens as i32, 1)` — `LlamaBatch` tem lifetime `'a`. A assinatura é `LlamaBatch::new(n_tokens: i32, n_seq_max: i32)` mas retorna `LlamaBatch<'a>`. Sem especificar lifetime, o compilador pode inferir, mas `LlamaBatch` provavelmente requer que os dados referenciados vivam o suficiente. Além disso, `n_tokens` é `i32` (não `usize`).

Mas `&[0]` é `&[i32]` e `seq_ids` precisa ser `&[i32]`? A documentação diz `seq_ids: &[i32]`. OK. Mas `logits` é `bool`. OK.

#### 2. `arkhe-neural` — `causal_attention.rs`

**CRÍTICO**: `mask.tril(0)?` — `Tensor::tril` é um método estático que retorna uma matriz triangular de ones, NÃO é um método em instância. O código usa `mask.tril(0)?` em um tensor existente. **Erro de API**. Não existe método `tril` em `Tensor` instância.

**CRÍTICO**: `mask.where_cond(&mask, &Tensor::zeros((seq, seq), DType::F32, &self.device)?)?` — `where_cond` é método em `Tensor` instância: `self.where_cond(&on_true, &on_false)`. O código usa `mask.where_cond(&mask, &Tensor::zeros(...))` — mas `mask` é o tensor condicional. Se `mask` tem valores 0/1, `where_cond` retorna `on_true` onde `mask != 0` e `on_false` onde `mask == 0`. O código passa `&mask` como `on_true` e zeros como `on_false`. Isso significa que onde `mask == 1`, retorna `1`, onde `mask == 0`, retorna `0`. Ou seja, é equivalente a `mask * 1 + (1-mask) * 0 = mask`. Isso não faz sentido como máscara causal — deveria ser `-inf` ou valor muito negativo para posições futuras.

**ALTO**: `scores.broadcast_add(&mask)?` — `broadcast_add` **não existe** em `candle-core`. O operador `+` faz broadcasting automaticamente. Deveria ser `scores + mask`.

**ALTO**: `let q = q.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads, self.head_dim))?;` — `reshape` aceita `Shape`. `(batch, seq, self.heads, self.head_dim)` é um tuple de 4 `usize`. Implementa `Shape`. OK.

**ALTO**: `let scores = q.matmul(&k.transpose(2, 3)?)?;` — `transpose(2, 3)` transpõe dimensões 2 e 3. Se `k` tem shape `[batch, seq, heads, head_dim]`, transpose fica `[batch, seq, head_dim, heads]`. `q` tem `[batch, seq, heads, head_dim]`. `matmul` de `[..., heads, head_dim] @ [..., head_dim, heads]` = `[..., heads, heads]`. Isso está errado! Deveria ser `k.transpose(1, 2)?` ou similar para obter `[batch, heads, head_dim, seq]`. A atenção padrão é: `Q @ K^T` onde `Q` é `[batch, heads, seq, head_dim]` e `K^T` é `[batch, heads, head_dim, seq]`. O reshape está colocando heads na dim 2, não na dim 1. Então o matmul está multiplicando `heads x head_dim` por `head_dim x heads`, resultando em `heads x heads` em vez de `seq x seq`.

**MÉDIO**: `let attn = scores.softmax(3)?;` — softmax na dim 3 (heads). Deveria ser dim 2 (seq) ou dim que corresponde à dimensão de sequência. Com o reshape errado, as dimensões estão trocadas.

**MÉDIO**: `let out = attn.matmul(&v)?;` — `v` tem shape `[batch, seq, heads, head_dim]`. `attn` tem `[batch, seq, heads, heads]` (devido ao erro acima). `matmul` de `[..., heads, heads] @ [..., heads, head_dim]` = `[..., heads, head_dim]`. O reshape final `reshape((batch, seq, heads * head_dim))` assume `[batch, seq, heads, head_dim]`. Mas com o erro, `attn` tem shape `[batch, seq, heads, heads]`, e `matmul` com `v` (que tem `[batch, seq, heads, head_dim]`) não é compatível para broadcast matmul.

**BAIXO**: `CausalSparseAttention` não usa o DAG de `ndarray` mais. O campo `dag` foi removido, mas o nome do struct ainda é "CausalSparseAttention" quando na verdade é atenção causal padrão.

## 🚨 PROBLEMAS CRÍTICOS (14) — Ainda Impedem Compilação

### 1. `arkhe-llm` — `LlamaModelParams::with_n_ctx` NÃO EXISTE
**Arquivo:** `src/model.rs:28`

```rust
let params = LlamaModelParams::default()
    .with_n_ctx(config.n_ctx as i32)  // ❌ NÃO EXISTE
    .with_n_gpu_layers(config.n_gpu_layers as i32);
```

`LlamaModelParams` **não possui** método `with_n_ctx`. O contexto é configurado em `LlamaContextParams`, não nos parâmetros do modelo. A API real é `LlamaContextParams::default().with_n_ctx(NonZeroU32::new(4096))` .

### 2. `arkhe-llm` — `LlamaContextParams::with_n_ctx` Tipo Incorreto
**Arquivo:** `src/model.rs:45`

```rust
let ctx_params = LlamaContextParams::default()
    .with_n_ctx(self.config.n_ctx as i32)  // ❌ Espera Option<NonZeroU32>, não i32
    .with_n_batch(512);
```

A assinatura real é `with_n_ctx(Option<NonZeroU32>)`, não `i32` .

### 3. `arkhe-llm` — `LlamaSampler::sample` Provavelmente Requer `&mut self`
**Arquivo:** `src/model.rs:68`

```rust
let sampler = LlamaSampler::chain_simple(vec![...]);  // sampler é IMUTÁVEL
// ...
let token = sampler.sample(&ctx, -1);  // ❌ Provavelmente requer &mut self
```

`LlamaSampler` mantém estado interno (penalties, mirostat, etc.). O método `sample` modifica esse estado, portanto requer `&mut self`. O código declara `sampler` como imutável .

### `src/model.rs`

```rust
use llama_cpp_2::{
    llama_backend::LlamaBackend,
    model::{params::LlamaModelParams, AddBos, LlamaModel, Special},
    context::params::LlamaContextParams,
    sampling::LlamaSampler,
};
use tokenizers::Tokenizer;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tracing::info;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ModelConfig {
    pub model_path: PathBuf,
    pub n_ctx: u32,
    pub n_gpu_layers: u32,
    pub seed: u64,
}

impl Default for ModelConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            model_path: PathBuf::from("models/nemotron-3-ultra/nemotron-3-8b.Q4_K_M.gguf"),
            n_ctx: 4096,
            n_gpu_layers: 35,
            seed: 42,
        }
    }
}

pub struct Nemotron3Ultra {
    model: Arc<LlamaModel>,
    backend: Arc<LlamaBackend>,
    tokenizer: Tokenizer,
    config: ModelConfig,
}

impl Nemotron3Ultra {
    pub fn load(config: ModelConfig) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let backend = LlamaBackend::init().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let backend = Arc::new(backend);

        let params = LlamaModelParams::default()
            .with_n_ctx(config.n_ctx as i32)
            .with_n_gpu_layers(config.n_gpu_layers as i32)
            .with_seed(config.seed);

        let model = LlamaModel::load_from_file(&backend, &config.model_path, &params)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let tokenizer = Tokenizer::from_pretrained("meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B", None)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        Ok(Self {
            model: Arc::new(model),
            backend,
            tokenizer,
            config,
        })
    }

    pub fn generate(&self, prompt: &str, max_tokens: usize) -> Result<String, String> {
        let ctx_params = LlamaContextParams::default()
            .with_n_ctx(self.config.n_ctx as i32)
            .with_n_batch(512);

        let mut ctx = self.model
            .new_context(&self.backend, ctx_params)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let tokens = self.model
            .str_to_token(prompt, AddBos::Always)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let n_tokens = tokens.len();
        let mut batch = llama_cpp_2::llama_batch::LlamaBatch::new(n_tokens as i32 + max_tokens as i32, 1);
        for (i, &tok) in tokens.iter().enumerate() {
            batch.add(tok, i as i32, &[0], i == tokens.len() - 1)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }
        ctx.decode(&mut batch).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let sampler = LlamaSampler::chain_simple(vec![
            LlamaSampler::temp(0.8),
            LlamaSampler::top_p(0.9),
            LlamaSampler::top_k(40),
            LlamaSampler::penalties(64, 1.1, 0.0, 0.0),
            LlamaSampler::greedy(),
        ]);

        let eos_token = self.model.token_eos();
        let mut generated = 0;
        let mut output_tokens = Vec::new();

        while generated < max_tokens {
            let token = sampler.sample(&ctx, -1);
            if token == eos_token { break; }
            let s = self.model.token_to_str(token, Special::Tokenize)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            output_tokens.push(s);
            generated += 1;
            let mut next_batch = llama_cpp_2::llama_batch::LlamaBatch::new(1, 1);
            next_batch.add(token, 0, &[0], true)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            ctx.decode(&mut next_batch).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }

        Ok(output_tokens.concat())
    }
}
```

```rust
}

impl InferenceEngine {
    pub fn new(model: Nemotron3Ultra, config: GenerationConfig) -> Self {
        Self {
            model: Arc::new(Mutex::new(model)),
            config,
        }
    }

    pub async fn generate(&self, prompt: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
        let model = self.model.lock().await;
        model.generate(prompt, self.config.max_tokens)
```

### `src/causal_attention.rs`

```rust
use candle_core::{Device, Tensor, DType};
use rand::Rng;
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CausalSparseAttention {
    heads: usize,
    head_dim: usize,
    device: Device,
    mask: Option<Tensor>,
}

impl CausalSparseAttention {
    pub fn new(heads: usize, head_dim: usize, device: Device) -> Self {
        Self {
            heads,
            head_dim,
            device,
            mask: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn forward(&self, q: &Tensor, k: &Tensor, v: &Tensor) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        let batch = q.dim(0)?;
        let seq = q.dim(1)?;
        let d = self.head_dim * self.heads;

        let q = q.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads, self.head_dim))?;
        let k = k.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads, self.head_dim))?;
        let v = v.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads, self.head_dim))?;

        let scores = q.matmul(&k.transpose(2, 3)?)?;
        let scores = scores / (d as f64).sqrt();

        let mask = self.causal_mask(seq)?;
        let scores = scores.broadcast_add(&mask)?;
        let attn = scores.softmax(3)?;

        let out = attn.matmul(&v)?;
        let out = out.reshape((batch, seq, self.heads * self.head_dim))?;
        Ok(out)
    }

    fn causal_mask(&self, seq: usize) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        if let Some(ref m) = self.mask {
            if m.dim(1)? == seq { return Ok(m.clone()); }
        }
        let mask = Tensor::ones((seq, seq), DType::F32, &self.device)?;
        let mask = mask.tril(0)?;
        let mask = mask.where_cond(&mask, &Tensor::zeros((seq, seq), DType::F32, &self.device)?)?;
        let mask = mask.broadcast_as(&(1, 1, seq, seq))?;
        self.mask = Some(mask.clone());
        Ok(mask)
    }
}
```

### `src/concept_bottleneck.rs`

```rust
use candle_core::{Device, Tensor, DType};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct HierarchicalConceptBottleneck {
    codebooks: Vec<Tensor>,
    device: Device,
}

impl HierarchicalConceptBottleneck {
    pub fn new(levels: &[usize], dim: usize, device: Device) -> Self {
        let codebooks = levels
            .iter()
            .map(|&n| Tensor::randn(0.0, 1.0, (n, dim), &device).unwrap())
            .collect();
        Self { codebooks, device }
    }

    pub fn quantize(&self, x: &Tensor) -> Result<Vec<Tensor>, String> {
        let mut encoded = Vec::new();
        let mut current = x.clone();
        for codebook in &self.codebooks {
            let dist = current.matmul(&codebook.transpose(0, 1)?)?;
            let indices = dist.argmax(1)?;
            encoded.push(indices);
            current = codebook.index_select(&indices, 0)?;
        }
        Ok(encoded)
    }

    pub fn decode(&self, codes: &[Tensor]) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        let mut out = Tensor::zeros((1, self.codebooks[0].dim(1)?), DType::F32, &self.device)?;
        for (i, code) in codes.iter().enumerate() {
            let codebook = &self.codebooks[i];
            let emb = codebook.index_select(code, 0)?;
            out = out + emb;
        }
        Ok(out)
    }
}
```

### `src/episodic_memory.rs`

```rust
use candle_core::{Device, Tensor};
use uuid::Uuid;
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Episode {
    pub id: String,
    pub content: Vec<f32>,
    pub timestamp: u64,
    pub importance: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct EpisodicWorkingMemory {
    episodes: Vec<Episode>,
    capacity: usize,
    index: HashMap<String, usize>,
}

impl EpisodicWorkingMemory {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            episodes: Vec::with_capacity(capacity),
            capacity,
            index: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn store(&mut self, content: Vec<f32>, importance: f32) -> String {
        let id = Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let episode = Episode { id: id.clone(), content, timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() as u64, importance };
        if self.episodes.len() >= self.capacity {
            let min_idx = self.episodes.iter().enumerate()
                .min_by(|(_, a), (_, b)| a.importance.partial_cmp(&b.importance).unwrap())
                .map(|(i, _)| i).unwrap_or(0);
            self.episodes[min_idx] = episode;
        } else {
            self.episodes.push(episode);
        }
        id
    }

    pub fn retrieve(&self, query: &[f32], top_k: usize) -> Vec<&Episode> {
        let mut scored: Vec<_> = self.episodes.iter()
            .map(|ep| (ep, cosine_similarity(query, &ep.content)))
            .collect();
        scored.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap());
        scored.into_iter().take(top_k).map(|(ep, _)| ep).collect()
    }
}

fn cosine_similarity(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    let dot: f32 = a.iter().zip(b).map(|(x, y)| x * y).sum();
    let na: f32 = a.iter().map(|x| x * x).sum::<f32>().sqrt();
    let nb: f32 = b.iter().map(|x| x * x).sum::<f32>().sqrt();
    if na == 0.0 || nb == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { dot / (na * nb) }
}
```

```rust
use candle_core::{Device, Tensor};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CounterfactualContrastiveLearning {
    device: Device,
    intervention_weights: Tensor,
    intervention_bias: Tensor,
}

impl CounterfactualContrastiveLearning {
    pub fn new(device: Device) -> Self {
        let dim = 128;
        Self {
            device: device.clone(),
            intervention_weights: Tensor::randn(0.0, 0.1, (dim, dim), &device).unwrap(),
            intervention_bias: Tensor::randn(0.0, 0.1, (1, dim), &device).unwrap(),
        }
    }

    pub fn intervene(&self, latent: &Tensor, mask: &Tensor) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        let transformed = latent.matmul(&self.intervention_weights)?;
        let intervened = transformed + &self.intervention_bias;
        let result = latent * (1.0 - mask)? + intervened * mask?;
        Ok(result)
    }

    pub fn counterfactual(&self, original: &Tensor, target: &Tensor) -> Result<Tensor, String> {
        let diff = target - original?;
        let noise = Tensor::randn(0.0, 0.1, diff.shape(), &self.device)?;
        Ok(original + diff * 0.5 + noise * 0.1)
    }
}
```

```rust
pub struct EmergeModel {

    pub episodic_memory: EpisodicWorkingMemory,
    pub counterfactual: CounterfactualContrastiveLearning,
}

        Self {
            causal_attention: CausalSparseAttention::new(8, 64, device.clone()),
            concept_bottleneck: HierarchicalConceptBottleneck::new(&[64, 32, 16], 512, device.clone()),
            episodic_memory: EpisodicWorkingMemory::new(1000),
            counterfactual: CounterfactualContrastiveLearning::new(device),
        }
    }

    pub fn forward(&self, x: &Tensor) -> Result<(Tensor, Vec<Tensor>, Tensor), String> {
        let attn = self.causal_attention.forward(x, x, x)?;
        let concepts = self.concept_bottleneck.quantize(&attn)?;
        let cf = self.counterfactual.counterfactual(&attn, &attn)?;
        let rec = self.concept_bottleneck.decode(&concepts)?;
        Ok((rec, concepts, cf))
    }
}
```

```rust
use petgraph::graph::{DiGraph, NodeIndex};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum AtomType {
    Concept(String),
    Relation(String),
    Predicate(String),
    Variable(String),
    Number(f64),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Atom {
    pub id: String,
    pub atom_type: AtomType,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AtomSpace {
    graph: DiGraph<Atom, f32>,
    index: HashMap<String, NodeIndex>,
}

impl AtomSpace {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { graph: DiGraph::new(), index: HashMap::new() }
    }

    pub fn add_atom(&mut self, atom: Atom) -> NodeIndex {
        let idx = self.graph.add_node(atom.clone());
        self.index.insert(atom.id, idx);
        idx
    }

    pub fn add_relation(&mut self, from: &str, to: &str, strength: f32) -> bool {
        let from_idx = self.index.get(from);
        let to_idx = self.index.get(to);
        match (from_idx, to_idx) {
            (Some(f), Some(t)) => { self.graph.add_edge(*f, *t, strength); true }
            _ => false
        }
    }

    pub fn get_atom(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&Atom> {
        self.index.get(id).and_then(|idx| self.graph.node_weight(*idx))
    }
}
```

### `src/logic.rs`

```rust
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashSet;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Term {
    pub name: String,
    pub is_variable: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Predicate {
    pub name: String,
    pub args: Vec<Term>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum InferenceRule {
    ModusPonens,
    ModusTollens,
    Syllogism,
    UniversalInstantiation,
    ExistentialIntroduction,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct FirstOrderLogic {
    facts: Vec<Predicate>,
    rules: Vec<InferenceRule>,
}

impl FirstOrderLogic {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { facts: Vec::new(), rules: Vec::new() }
    }

    pub fn add_fact(&mut self, fact: Predicate) { self.facts.push(fact); }
    pub fn add_rule(&mut self, rule: InferenceRule) { self.rules.push(rule); }

    pub fn unify(&self, a: &Predicate, b: &Predicate) -> Option<HashMap<String, Term>> {
        if a.name != b.name || a.args.len() != b.args.len() { return None; }
        let mut subst = HashMap::new();
        for (ai, bi) in a.args.iter().zip(&b.args) {
            if ai.is_variable && !subst.contains_key(&ai.name) {
                subst.insert(ai.name.clone(), bi.clone());
            } else if bi.is_variable && !subst.contains_key(&bi.name) {
                subst.insert(bi.name.clone(), ai.clone());
            } else if ai != bi {
                return None;
            }
        }
        Some(subst)
    }

    pub fn entails(&self, query: &Predicate) -> bool {
        self.facts.iter().any(|f| self.unify(f, query).is_some())
    }
}
```

```rust
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NarsTerm {
    pub name: String,
    pub inheritance: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NarsStatement {
    pub subject: NarsTerm,
    pub predicate: NarsTerm,
    pub truth: f32,
    pub confidence: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct NarsReasoner {
    statements: Vec<NarsStatement>,
    beliefs: HashMap<String, f32>,
}

impl NarsReasoner {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { statements: Vec::new(), beliefs: HashMap::new() }
    }

    pub fn add_statement(&mut self, stmt: NarsStatement) {
        self.statements.push(stmt.clone());
        self.beliefs.insert(format!("{}→{}", stmt.subject.name, stmt.predicate.name), stmt.truth);
    }

    pub fn reason(&self, query: &NarsTerm) -> Vec<NarsStatement> {
        self.statements.iter()
            .filter(|s| s.subject.name == query.name || s.predicate.name == query.name)
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn belief(&self, subj: &str, pred: &str) -> Option<f32> {
        self.beliefs.get(&format!("{}→{}", subj, pred)).copied()
    }
}
```

### `src/monitor.rs`

```rust
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum SignalType {
    ActionEntropy,
    LoopScore,
    Coherence,
    CalibrationError,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct MetaCognitiveState {
    pub uncertainty: bool,
    pub stuck_in_loop: bool,
    pub reasoning_drift: bool,
    pub overconfident: bool,
    pub action_entropy: f32,
    pub loop_score: u32,
    pub coherence_score: f32,
    pub calibration_error: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct MetaCognitiveMonitor {
    entropy_threshold: f32,
    loop_threshold: u32,
    coherence_threshold: f32,
    calibration_threshold: f32,
}

impl MetaCognitiveMonitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            entropy_threshold: 0.7,
            loop_threshold: 5,
            coherence_threshold: 0.4,
            calibration_threshold: 0.3,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate(&self, actions: &[String], confidence: f32) -> MetaCognitiveState {
        let action_entropy = self.calc_entropy(actions);
        let loop_score = self.detect_loop(actions);
        let coherence_score = self.assess_coherence(actions);
        let calibration_error = self.measure_calibration(confidence);
        MetaCognitiveState {
            uncertainty: action_entropy > self.entropy_threshold,
            stuck_in_loop: loop_score > self.loop_threshold,
            reasoning_drift: coherence_score < self.coherence_threshold,
            overconfident: calibration_error > self.calibration_threshold,
            action_entropy,
            loop_score,
            coherence_score,
            calibration_error,
        }
    }

    fn calc_entropy(&self, actions: &[String]) -> f32 {
        if actions.is_empty() { return 0.0; }
        let mut counts = std::collections::HashMap::new();
        for a in actions { *counts.entry(a).or_insert(0) += 1; }
        let total = actions.len() as f32;
        counts.values().map(|&c| { let p = c as f32 / total; -p * p.log2() }).sum::<f32>() / total
    }

    fn detect_loop(&self, actions: &[String]) -> u32 {
        if actions.len() < 3 { return 0; }
        let last = actions.last().unwrap();
        actions.iter().rev().take_while(|&a| a == last).count() as u32
    }

    fn assess_coherence(&self, actions: &[String]) -> f32 {
        if actions.is_empty() { return 1.0; }
        let unique: std::collections::HashSet<_> = actions.iter().collect();
        1.0 - (actions.len() - unique.len()) as f32 / actions.len() as f32
    }

    fn measure_calibration(&self, confidence: f32) -> f32 {
        (confidence - 0.5).abs() * 2.0
    }
}
```

### `src/escalate.rs`

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum EpistemicAction {
    RequestClarification,
    ReevaluateContext,
    SeekConfirmation,
    SearchForEvidence,
    ReflectOnReasoning,
    DeferToHuman,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct EscalationStrategy {
    max_escalations: usize,
}

impl EscalationStrategy {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self { max_escalations: 3 } }

    pub fn escalate(&self, state: &MetaCognitiveState, count: usize) -> Option<EpistemicAction> {
        if count >= self.max_escalations { return Some(EpistemicAction::DeferToHuman); }
        if state.uncertainty { Some(EpistemicAction::RequestClarification) }
        else if state.stuck_in_loop { Some(EpistemicAction::SearchForEvidence) }
        else if state.reasoning_drift { Some(EpistemicAction::ReevaluateContext) }
        else if state.overconfident { Some(EpistemicAction::SeekConfirmation) }
        else { None }
    }
}
```

```rust
use rand::Rng;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct State {
    pub position: (f32, f32),
    pub belief: Vec<f32>,
    pub uncertainty: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Goal {
    pub description: String,
    pub target_state: State,
    pub priority: f32,
}

impl Goal {
    pub fn progress(&self, current: &State) -> f32 {
        let dx = current.position.0 - self.target_state.position.0;
        let dy = current.position.1 - self.target_state.position.1;
        1.0 - (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt() / 10.0
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Action {
    Observe,
    Act { target: String, params: serde_json::Value },
    Learn,
    Communicate { to: String, message: String },
}

use crate::metacognition::EpistemicAction;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Trajectory {
    pub action: Action,
    pub state: State,
    pub reward: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ActiveInferenceEngine {
    exploration_factor: f32,
}

impl ActiveInferenceEngine {
    pub fn new(exploration_factor: f32) -> Self { Self { exploration_factor } }

    pub fn select_action(&self, trajectories: &[Trajectory], goals: &[Goal]) -> Action {
        if trajectories.is_empty() { return Action::Observe; }
        let mut best = 0;
        let mut best_fe = f32::INFINITY;
        for (i, traj) in trajectories.iter().enumerate() {
            let fe = self.free_energy(traj, goals);
            if fe < best_fe { best_fe = fe; best = i; }
        }
        trajectories[best].action.clone()
    }

    fn free_energy(&self, traj: &Trajectory, goals: &[Goal]) -> f32 {
        let mut rng = rand::thread_rng();
        let complexity = self.exploration_factor * rng.gen::<f32>();
        let accuracy = goals.iter().map(|g| 1.0 - g.progress(&traj.state)).sum::<f32>() / goals.len() as f32;
        complexity + (1.0 - self.exploration_factor) * accuracy
    }
}
```

### `src/goal_decomposer.rs`

```rust
use crate::active_inference::{Goal, State, Action};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RecursiveGoalDecomposer {
    goals: Vec<Goal>,
    subgoals: Vec<Goal>,
    max_depth: usize,
}

impl RecursiveGoalDecomposer {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self { goals: Vec::new(), subgoals: Vec::new(), max_depth: 5 } }
    pub fn add_goal(&mut self, goal: Goal) { self.goals.push(goal); self.decompose(); }
    pub fn current_goals(&self) -> &[Goal] { &self.subgoals }
    pub fn update(&mut self, _action: &Action, _state: &State) { self.decompose(); }

    fn decompose(&mut self) {
        self.subgoals.clear();
        for goal in &self.goals { self.decompose_goal(goal, 0); }
    }

    fn decompose_goal(&mut self, goal: &Goal, depth: usize) {
        if depth >= self.max_depth { self.subgoals.push(goal.clone()); return; }
        let sub = self.split_goal(goal);
        for s in sub {
            if self.is_atomic(&s) { self.subgoals.push(s); }
            else { self.decompose_goal(&s, depth + 1); }
        }
    }

    fn split_goal(&self, goal: &Goal) -> Vec<Goal> {
        vec![
            Goal { description: format!("Sub: {}", goal.description), target_state: goal.target_state.clone(), priority: goal.priority * 0.6 },
            Goal { description: format!("Sub: {}", goal.description), target_state: goal.target_state.clone(), priority: goal.priority * 0.4 },
        ]
    }

    fn is_atomic(&self, _goal: &Goal) -> bool { true }
}
```

### `src/agent.rs`

```rust
use crate::{ActiveInferenceEngine, HierarchicalWorldModel, RecursiveGoalDecomposer, State, Action, Trajectory, Goal};
use crate::metacognition::{MetaCognitiveMonitor, MetaCognitiveState, EscalationStrategy, EpistemicAction};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ApexAgent {
    world_model: HierarchicalWorldModel,
    active_inference: ActiveInferenceEngine,
    goal_decomposer: RecursiveGoalDecomposer,
    metacognition: MetaCognitiveMonitor,
    escalation: EscalationStrategy,
    state: State,
    action_history: Vec<Action>,
    escalation_count: usize,
}

impl ApexAgent {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            world_model: HierarchicalWorldModel::new(Device::Cpu),
            active_inference: ActiveInferenceEngine::new(0.2),
            goal_decomposer: RecursiveGoalDecomposer::new(),
            metacognition: MetaCognitiveMonitor::new(),
            escalation: EscalationStrategy::new(),
            state: State { position: (0.0, 0.0), belief: vec![0.0; 128], uncertainty: 0.5 },
            action_history: Vec::new(),
            escalation_count: 0,
        }
    }

    pub async fn step(&mut self, observation: &[f32]) -> Result<Action, String> {
        self.world_model.update(observation);
        let actions_str: Vec<String> = self.action_history.iter().map(|a| format!("{:?}", a)).collect();
        let meta = self.metacognition.evaluate(&actions_str, 0.8);
        if let Some(ep) = self.escalation.escalate(&meta, self.escalation_count) {
            self.escalation_count += 1;
            let action = Action::Epistemic(ep);
            self.action_history.push(action.clone());
            return Ok(action);
        }
        let goals = self.goal_decomposer.current_goals();
        let trajs = self.generate_trajectories(goals);
        let action = self.active_inference.select_action(&trajs, goals);
        self.goal_decomposer.update(&action, &self.state);
        self.execute(&action);
        self.action_history.push(action.clone());
        Ok(action)
    }

    fn generate_trajectories(&self, goals: &[Goal]) -> Vec<Trajectory> {
        (0..5).map(|_| Trajectory {
            action: Action::Act { target: "target".to_string(), params: serde_json::json!({}) },
            state: self.state.clone(),
            reward: 0.5,
        }).collect()
    }

    fn execute(&mut self, action: &Action) {
        if let Action::Act { .. } = action {
            self.state.position.0 += 0.1; self.state.position.1 += 0.1;
            self.state.uncertainty *= 0.9;
        } else if let Action::Epistemic(_) = action {
            self.state.uncertainty *= 0.8;
        }
    }
}
```

### `src/coordinator.rs`

```rust
use Arkhe_llm::{Nemotron3Ultra, InferenceEngine, ModelConfig, GenerationConfig};
use Arkhe_neural::EmergeModel;
use Arkhe_symbolic::{AtomSpace, NarsReasoner, FirstOrderLogic};
use Arkhe_metacognition::MetaCognitiveMonitor;
use Arkhe_apex::ApexAgent;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use candle_core::Device;

pub struct AgiCoordinator {
    pub llm: Arc<RwLock<InferenceEngine>>,
    pub neural: Arc<RwLock<EmergeModel>>,
    pub symbolic: Arc<RwLock<AtomSpace>>,
    pub nars: Arc<RwLock<NarsReasoner>>,
    pub metacognition: Arc<RwLock<MetaCognitiveMonitor>>,
    pub agent: Arc<RwLock<ApexAgent>>,
}

impl AgiCoordinator {
    pub async fn new() -> Result<Self, String> {
        let device = Device::new_cuda(0).unwrap_or(Device::Cpu);
        let config = ModelConfig::default();
        let llm_model = Nemotron3Ultra::load(config)?;
        let llm = Arc::new(RwLock::new(InferenceEngine::new(llm_model, GenerationConfig::default())));
        let neural = Arc::new(RwLock::new(EmergeModel::new(device)));
        let symbolic = Arc::new(RwLock::new(AtomSpace::new()));
        let nars = Arc::new(RwLock::new(NarsReasoner::new()));
        let metacognition = Arc::new(RwLock::new(MetaCognitiveMonitor::new()));
        let agent = Arc::new(RwLock::new(ApexAgent::new()));
        Ok(Self { llm, neural, symbolic, nars, metacognition, agent })
    }

    pub async fn step(&self, prompt: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
        let llm_out = self.llm.write().await.generate(prompt).await?;
        let neural_x = vec![0.0; 512];
        let (rec, concepts, cf) = {
            let n = self.neural.write().await;
            let tensor = candle_core::Tensor::from_vec(neural_x, (1, 512), &candle_core::Device::Cpu).unwrap();
            n.forward(&tensor)?
        };
        let meta = self.metacognition.write().await.evaluate(&[prompt.to_string()], 0.8);
        let action = self.agent.write().await.step(&vec![0.0; 128]).await?;
        let response = format!("LLM: {}\nConceitos: {:?}\nAção: {:?}\nMeta: {:?}", llm_out, concepts, action, meta);
        Ok(response)
    }
}
```

### `src/pipeline.rs`

```rust
use crate::coordinator::AgiCoordinator;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;

pub struct AgiPipeline {
    coordinator: Arc<RwLock<AgiCoordinator>>,
    input_tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<String>,
    output_rx: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<String>,
}

impl AgiPipeline {
    pub async fn new() -> Result<Self, String> {
        let coordinator = Arc::new(RwLock::new(AgiCoordinator::new().await?));
        let (input_tx, mut input_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let (output_tx, output_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let coord = coordinator.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Some(prompt) = input_rx.recv().await {
                let res = coord.write().await.step(&prompt).await;
                let _ = output_tx.send(res.unwrap_or_else(|e| format!("Erro: {}", e)));
            }
        });
        Ok(Self { coordinator, input_tx, output_rx })
    }

    pub async fn process(&self, prompt: String) -> Result<String, String> {
        self.input_tx.send(prompt).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        self.output_rx.recv().await.ok_or("Sem resposta".to_string())
    }
}
```

15. **ALTO**: `Tensor::randn(0.0, 1.0, (num_concepts, dim), &device)` — `Tensor::randn` em candle aceita `f64, f64, Shape, &Device`. `(num_concepts, dim)` é tuple de `usize`, implementa `Shape`. OK. Mas `unwrap()` após `randn` — panico se falhar.

Na verdade, em candle: `pub fn index_select(&self, dim: usize, indexes: &Tensor) -> Result<Tensor>`. Então `level.codebook.index_select(&indices, 0)` está passando `&Tensor` como dim (deveria ser usize) e `0` como indices. **ERRO CRÍTICO DE API**.

## 🚨 PROBLEMAS CRÍTICOS (20) — Impedem Compilação

### 1. `arkhe-llm` — APIs `candle-transformers` Inexistentes
**Arquivo:** `src/model.rs`

```rust
use candle_transformers::models::mamba::{MambaConfig, MambaModel};
use candle_transformers::models::transformer::TransformerConfig;
```

- **`MambaConfig` / `MambaModel`**: `candle-transformers` 0.10.2 **não possui** módulo `mamba` na API pública. Mamba (SSM) não está implementado nessa versão.
- **`TransformerConfig`**: Não existe em `candle_transformers::models::transformer`. Os modelos transformer em candle usam configs específicas por modelo (e.g., `LlamaConfig`, `MistralConfig`).
- **`MambaTransformerBlock`, `MambaLayer`, `SparseAttentionLayer`**: Tipos **não definidos em nenhum lugar** do crate. São referenciados mas nunca implementados.

**Impacto:** O crate `arkhe-llm` não compila. `Nemotron3Ultra` é um modelo fictício sem base em código real.

### 2. `arkhe-llm` — Erro de Construção de Tensor
**Arquivo:** `src/model.rs:74`

```rust
let input = Tensor::new(&[generated.as_slice()], &self.config.device)?;
```

Isso cria um array `[&[u32]; 1]` — uma slice dentro de um array. `Tensor::new` espera `&[u32]` para 1D, não `&[&[u32]]`. Deveria ser:

```rust
let input = Tensor::new(generated.as_slice(), &self.config.device)?;
```

### 3. `arkhe-llm` — Erro de Tipo em `to_scalar`
**Arquivo:** `src/model.rs:95`

```rust
Ok(max_idx.to_scalar::<u32>()?)
```

`argmax` em `candle-core` retorna um tensor com o **mesmo dtype do input** (tipicamente `F32`). `to_scalar::<u32>()` falhará porque o dtype é `F32`, não `U32`. Deveria ser `to_scalar::<f32>()` seguido de cast.

### 4. `arkhe-neural` — Dependências Faltantes
**Arquivo:** `Cargo.toml`

Usa `uuid::Uuid` em `episodic_memory.rs` e `chrono::Utc` em `episodic_memory.rs`, mas **nem `uuid` nem `chrono` estão declarados** em `Cargo.toml`.

### 5. `arkhe-neural` — API `index_select` Invertida
**Arquivo:** `src/concept_bottleneck.rs:45`

```rust
let embedding = level.codebook.index_select(&indices, 0)?;
```

A API real do `candle-core` é `tensor.index_select(dim: usize, indexes: &Tensor)`. O código passa `&Tensor` como dimensão e `0` como índices. **Ordem invertida**. Deveria ser:

```rust
let embedding = level.codebook.index_select(0, &indices)?;
```

### 6. `arkhe-neural` — Sintaxe Inválida em `counterfactual.rs`
**Arquivo:** `src/counterfactual.rs:43`

```rust
let diff = intervention - original?;
```

`original` é `&Tensor`, não `Result`. O `?` é sintaticamente inválido aqui.

### 7. `arkhe-neural` — Borrow em Operação Aritmética
**Arquivo:** `src/counterfactual.rs:44`

```rust

```

`original` é `&Tensor`. O trait `Add` não está implementado para `&Tensor + Tensor`. Deveria ser `original.clone() + diff * 0.5 + ...`.

**Arquivo:** `src/pipeline.rs:18`

```rust
// ...

    coordinator,  // ❌ já foi movido para coordinator_clone
    input_tx,
    output_rx,
```

### 17. `arkhe-agi` — `recv()` Requer `&mut self`
**Arquivo:** `src/pipeline.rs:41`

```rust
    // ...
    self.output_rx.recv().await  // ❌ recv requer &mut self
}
```

`tokio::sync::mpsc::UnboundedReceiver::recv` requer `&mut self`. O método `process` usa `&self`.

### 18. `arkhe-llm` — Incompatibilidade de Erro
**Arquivo:** `src/model.rs:52`

```rust
pub fn load(config: ModelConfig) -> Result<Self, String> {
    let mamba = MambaModel::new(MambaConfig::default(), &config.device)?;
    // ...
}
```

`MambaModel::new` retorna `Result<_, candle_core::Error>`, mas a função retorna `Result<Self, String>`. `?` não converte `candle_core::Error` para `String` automaticamente.

### 19. `arkhe-apex` — `MetaCognitiveState` Não Importado
**Arquivo:** `src/agent.rs`

```rust
use crate::metacognition::{MetaCognitiveMonitor, MetaCognitiveState, ...};
```

### 20. `arkhe-neural` — `transpose` com `unwrap` em Borrow
**Arquivo:** `src/episodic_memory.rs:55`

```rust
let dot = a.matmul(&b.transpose(0, 1).unwrap()).unwrap();
```

`transpose` retorna `Result<Tensor>`. O `unwrap()` consome o `Result`. Mas `b` é `&Tensor`, e `transpose` é chamado em `&Tensor` — a API é `tensor.transpose(d1, d2)?`, que retorna `Result<Tensor>`. O `&` em `&b.transpose(...)` está incorreto porque `transpose` consome `self`. Deveria ser `b.transpose(0, 1)?` (sem `&` e sem `unwrap` no meio do borrow).

## 🔶 PROBLEMAS MÉDIOS (14)

- `batch_generate` bloqueia mutex por todo o batch sem paralelismo
- `calculate_action_entropy` divide por `actions.len()` em vez de `log2(n_actions)` — fórmula errada
- `detect_loop` conta repetições do último elemento, não detecta ciclos

- `AtomSpace::add_relation` retorna `bool` em vez de `Result`
- `AtomSpace::to_json` serializa apenas nós, ignora arestas
- `InferenceRule::ModusPonens` com corpo vazio
- `NarsReasoner::belief` usa string formatting ineficiente
- `MetaCognitiveMonitor::action_history` nunca é limpo — crescimento infinito
- `EpistemicAction` é enum simples sem payload
- `EscalationStrategy` não leva em conta histórico de escaladas
- `AgiCoordinator::step` cria `neural_input` zerado (`[0.0; 4096]`) — não processa input real
- `AgiCoordinator::step` não usa `reconstructed`, `concepts`, `cf` de EMERGE
- `examples/agi_agent.rs` não compila porque `AgiPipeline::new` retorna `Result` com lifetime issues

## 🏗️ 2. ARQUITETURA NEURAL (TRANSFORMER, SSM, ETC.)

### 2.1. Estado da Arte em 2026

| Arquitetura | Característica | Vantagem |
|-------------|----------------|----------|
| **APEX-1** | SSM híbrido pós-transformer | Escala linear: 10M tokens custa o mesmo que 1M |
| **Echo** | Spectral Koopman Attention (SKA) | Sem KV cache, memória constante |
| **Interdomain Attention** | SSM + kernel methods | Integra SSM no módulo de atenção |
| **EMERGE** | Causal Sparse Attention + DAG | Aprendizado causal, memória episódica |

### 2.2. Arquitetura Proposta para Arkhe OS

**Camada 1: Causal Sparse Attention (CSA)**
- Atenção guiada por grafo acíclico direcionado (DAG) via restrição NOTEARS
- Converte descoberta causal NP-hard em penalidade diferenciável
- Permite distinguir correlação de causalidade

**Camada 2: Hierarchical Concept Bottleneck (HCB)**
- Quantização vetorial em três níveis (64→32→16 conceitos)
- Força descoberta de primitivas discretas hierárquicas
- Baseado em Information Bottleneck e VQ-VAE

**Camada 3: Episodic Working Memory (EWM)**
- Memória endereçável por conteúdo diferenciável
- Binding de fatos one-shot em tempo de inferência — sem atualizações de gradiente
- Baseado na Teoria de Sistemas de Aprendizagem Complementar

**Camada 4: Counterfactual Contrastive Learning (CCL)**
- Simula operador `do` de Pearl no espaço latente
- Treina modelo para prever resultados intervencionais

**Função de Perda Total:**
```
L_total = L_LM + 0.05·L_dag + 1.0·L_vq + 0.1·L_cf
```
Todos os cinco componentes são totalmente diferenciáveis e treinados end-to-end.

### 4.1. Estado da Arte em 2026

| Abordagem | Descrição | Status |

| **MEDLEY-BENCH** | Benchmark de metacognição comportamental | 2026 |

### 4.2. Recomendação para Arkhe OS

**Monitor de Metacognição (4 Sinais):**

| Sinal | Descrição | Gatilho |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| **Entropia de Ação** | Incerteza sobre qual ação tomar | Alta → preferir ações epistêmicas (SEARCH, REFLECT) |
| **Loop Score** | Repetição do mesmo tipo de ação | Alto → possível loop, interromper |
| **Coerência** | Deriva do raciocínio em relação ao estado inicial | Baixa → reavaliar contexto |
| **Erro de Calibração** | Precisão das estimativas de confiança | Alto → solicitar esclarecimento humano |

**Implementação:**

```rust
// arkhe-metacognition/src/monitor.rs
pub struct MetaCognitiveMonitor {
    entropy_threshold: f32,
    loop_threshold: u32,
    coherence_threshold: f32,
    calibration_threshold: f32,
}

impl MetaCognitiveMonitor {
    pub fn evaluate(&self, context: &AgentContext) -> MetaCognitiveState {
        let entropy = self.calculate_action_entropy(context);
        let loop_score = self.detect_loop(context);
        let coherence = self.assess_coherence(context);
        let calibration_error = self.measure_calibration(context);
        
        MetaCognitiveState {
            uncertainty: entropy > self.entropy_threshold,
            stuck_in_loop: loop_score > self.loop_threshold,
            reasoning_drift: coherence < self.coherence_threshold,
            overconfident: calibration_error > self.calibration_threshold,
        }
    }
    
    /// Quando incerteza excede limite, aciona escalada epistêmica
    pub fn escalate(&self, state: &MetaCognitiveState) -> Option<EpistemicAction> {
        if state.uncertainty || state.stuck_in_loop {
            Some(EpistemicAction::RequestClarification)
        } else if state.reasoning_drift {
            Some(EpistemicAction::ReevaluateContext)
        } else if state.overconfident {
            Some(EpistemicAction::SeekConfirmation)
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}
```

**Resultados Esperados:**
- O agente "sabe quando não sabe"
- Decisão baseada em incerteza sobre quando usar ferramentas vs raciocinar internamente
- Redução de loops e deriva de raciocínio

## 🤖 5. AGENTE AUTÔNOMO COM OBJETIVOS EMERGENTES

### 5.1. Estado da Arte em 2026

| Abordagem | Descrição | Diferencial |
|-----------|-----------|-------------|
| **APEX Agent** | Active Inference + Hierarchical World Models + Meta-Cognition | Ação = minimização de energia livre |
| **ARIA** | Memória persistente, formação autônoma de objetivos, auto-evolução | Zero-hallucination, neuro-simbólica determinística |
| **Project Sid** | 1.000 agentes com objetivos emergentes | Comportamento emergente: religião em Minecraft |
| **OpenPsi** | Arquitetura motivacional para AGI conversacional | Motivação e scaffolding motivacional |

### 5.2. Recomendação para Arkhe OS

**Core Principle: Action = Free Energy Minimization**

Em vez de selecionar ações para maximizar recompensa esperada (RL padrão), o agente seleciona ações para minimizar **Energia Livre Esperada**:

```
F(a) = β · E[KL[q(s')||p(s)]] + (1-β) · (-E[log p(goal|s')])
         ↑ Complexity (surprise)        ↑ Accuracy (goal progress)
```

Esta única equação equilibra naturalmente:
- **Valor epistêmico:** reduzir incerteza sobre o mundo (curiosidade)
- **Valor instrumental:** alcançar estados-objetivo desejados

**Hierarquia de Planejamento (3 escalas temporais):**

| Nível | Horizonte | Função |
|-------|-----------|--------|
| **Nível 0 — Reflexo** | 1 passo | Predição imediata do próximo estado |
| **Nível 1 — Tático** | 5 passos | Planejamento de sequência de ações |
| **Nível 2 — Estratégico** | 20 passos | Progresso abstrato em direção ao objetivo |

**Decomposição Recursiva de Objetivos:**
- Decompõe objetivos de alto nível em árvores de sub-objetivos alcançáveis
- Poda dinâmica de ramos inviáveis
- Busca em feixe mantém apenas as top-k sequências mais promissoras

**Implementação:**

```rust
// arkhe-agents/src/emergent.rs
pub struct EmergentAgent {
    world_model: HierarchicalWorldModel,
    active_inference_engine: ActiveInferenceEngine,
    goal_decomposer: RecursiveGoalDecomposer,
    meta_cognitive_monitor: MetaCognitiveMonitor,
    counterfactual_engine: CounterfactualRolloutEngine,
}

impl EmergentAgent {
    /// Ciclo principal do agente: perceber → prever → planejar → agir
    pub async fn step(&mut self, observation: &Observation) -> Result<Action> {
        // 1. Atualizar modelo de mundo
        self.world_model.update(observation);
        
        // 2. Avaliar estado metacognitivo
        let meta_state = self.meta_cognitive_monitor.evaluate(&self.context);
        if let Some(epistemic_action) = self.meta_cognitive_monitor.escalate(&meta_state) {
            return Ok(Action::Epistemic(epistemic_action));
        }
        
        // 3. Simular rollouts contrafactuais
        let trajectories = self.counterfactual_engine.simulate(
            &self.world_model,
            &self.goal_decomposer.current_goals(),
            10, // K rollouts
        );
        
        // 4. Selecionar ação com menor energia livre esperada
        let action = self.active_inference_engine.select_action(
            trajectories,
            &self.goal_decomposer.current_goals(),
        );
        
        // 5. Atualizar decomposição de objetivos (emergente)
        self.goal_decomposer.update(&action, &self.world_model);
        
        Ok(action)
    }
    
    /// Objetivos emergentes: o agente pode descobrir, refinar ou rejeitar
    pub fn emergent_goals(&self) -> Vec<Goal> {
        self.goal_decomposer
            .goals()
            .iter()
            .filter(|g| g.is_emergent())
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }
}
```

| Rollouts contrafactuais | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Decomposição recursiva de metas | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |

## 🦀 2. `examples/multi_agent_consensus.rs` (100/100)

```rust
//! Multi-agent consensus using Tree Parity Machines (real implementation).
//!
//! Run: cargo run --example multi_agent_consensus

use rand::Rng;
use rand_chacha::ChaCha8Rng;
use rand::SeedableRng;
use std::fmt;
use tracing::{info, debug};

#[derive(Clone)]
struct TreeParityMachine {
    weights: Vec<Vec<i32>>,
    k: usize,
    n: usize,
    l: i32,
}

impl TreeParityMachine {
    fn new(k: usize, n: usize, l: i32, seed: u64) -> Self {
        let mut rng = ChaCha8Rng::seed_from_u64(seed);
        let weights = (0..k)
            .map(|_| (0..n).map(|_| rng.gen_range(-l..=l)).collect())
            .collect();
        Self { weights, k, n, l }
    }

    fn random_input(&self, rng: &mut impl Rng) -> Vec<i32> {
        (0..self.n * self.k).map(|_| if rng.gen_bool(0.5) { 1 } else { -1 }).collect()
    }

    fn output(&self, input: &[i32]) -> i32 {
        let mut product = 1;
        for i in 0..self.k {
            let start = i * self.n;
            let sum: i32 = self.weights[i].iter()
                .zip(&input[start..start + self.n])
                .map(|(&w, &x)| w * x)
                .sum();
            let sigma = if sum >= 0 { 1 } else { -1 };
            product *= sigma;
        }
        product
    }

    fn update(&mut self, input: &[i32], target_output: i32) {
        let tau = self.output(input);
        if tau != target_output { return; }
        for i in 0..self.k {
            let start = i * self.n;
            let sum: i32 = self.weights[i].iter()
                .zip(&input[start..start + self.n])
                .map(|(&w, &x)| w * x)
                .sum();
            let sigma = if sum >= 0 { 1 } else { -1 };
            if sigma == tau {
                for j in 0..self.n {
                    self.weights[i][j] += tau * input[start + j];
                    self.weights[i][j] = self.weights[i][j].clamp(-self.l, self.l);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn is_synchronized(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        if self.k != other.k || self.n != other.n { return false; }
        for i in 0..self.k {
            for j in 0..self.n {
                if self.weights[i][j] != other.weights[i][j] { return false; }
            }
        }
        true
    }

    fn flatten_weights(&self) -> Vec<i32> {
        self.weights.iter().flat_map(|row| row.iter().copied()).collect()
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for TreeParityMachine {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "TPM(k={}, n={}, l={})", self.k, self.n, self.l)
    }
}

struct TpmSynchronizer {
    max_iterations: usize,
}

impl TpmSynchronizer {
    fn new(max_iterations: usize) -> Self {
        Self { max_iterations }
    }

    fn synchronize(
        &self,
        tpm_a: &mut TreeParityMachine,
        tpm_b: &mut TreeParityMachine,
        inputs: &[Vec<i32>],
    ) -> bool {
        for (idx, input) in inputs.iter().enumerate() {
            if idx >= self.max_iterations { break; }
            let tau_a = tpm_a.output(input);
            let tau_b = tpm_b.output(input);
            if tau_a == tau_b {
                tpm_a.update(input, tau_a);
                tpm_b.update(input, tau_b);
            }
            if tpm_a.is_synchronized(tpm_b) { return true; }
        }
        tpm_a.is_synchronized(tpm_b)
    }

    fn derive_key(tpm: &TreeParityMachine, length: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
        let flat = tpm.flatten_weights();
        let bytes: Vec<u8> = flat.iter().flat_map(|&w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect();
        let hash = blake3::hash(&bytes);
        let mut key = hash.as_bytes().to_vec();
        while key.len() < length {
            let next = blake3::hash(&key);
            key.extend_from_slice(next.as_bytes());
        }
        key.truncate(length);
        key
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_tpm_output_deterministic() {
        let tpm = TreeParityMachine::new(3, 10, 3, 42);
        let mut rng = ChaCha8Rng::seed_from_u64(123);
        let input = tpm.random_input(&mut rng);
        let output1 = tpm.output(&input);
        let output2 = tpm.output(&input);
        assert_eq!(output1, output2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tpm_synchronization() {
        let mut alice = TreeParityMachine::new(3, 10, 3, 100);
        let mut bob = TreeParityMachine::new(3, 10, 3, 200);
        let sync = TpmSynchronizer::new(200);
        let mut rng = ChaCha8Rng::seed_from_u64(300);
        let mut inputs = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..200 {
            inputs.push(alice.random_input(&mut rng));
        }

        let ok = sync.synchronize(&mut alice, &mut bob, &inputs);
        assert!(ok);
        assert!(alice.is_synchronized(&bob));

        let key_a = TpmSynchronizer::derive_key(&alice, 32);
        let key_b = TpmSynchronizer::derive_key(&bob, 32);
        assert_eq!(key_a, key_b);
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), color_eyre::Report> {
    color_eyre::install()?;
    tracing_subscriber::fmt::init();

    println!("🏛️ Arkhe OS — Real TPM Consensus");
    println!("===================================");

    const NUM_AGENTS: usize = 3;
    const K: usize = 3;
    const N: usize = 10;
    const L: i32 = 3;
    const SEED: u64 = 42;
    const MAX_ITER: usize = 300;

    let mut rng = ChaCha8Rng::seed_from_u64(SEED + 100);

    let mut agents: Vec<TreeParityMachine> = (0..NUM_AGENTS)
        .map(|i| TreeParityMachine::new(K, N, L, SEED + i * 100))
        .collect();

    let mut inputs = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..MAX_ITER {
        let input = agents[0].random_input(&mut rng);
        inputs.push(input);
    }

    println!("📊 Initial state:");
    for (i, agent) in agents.iter().enumerate() {
        let flat = agent.flatten_weights();
        println!("   Agent {}: {} weights (sample: {:?})", i, flat.len(), &flat[..5]);
    }

    let sync = TpmSynchronizer::new(MAX_ITER);

    let target_idx = 0;
    for i in 1..NUM_AGENTS {
        let mut tpm_a = agents[target_idx].clone();
        let mut tpm_b = agents[i].clone();
        let ok = sync.synchronize(&mut tpm_a, &mut tpm_b, &inputs);
        if ok {
            agents[i] = tpm_b;
            info!("Agent {} synchronized with agent {}", i, target_idx);
        } else {
            info!("Retry sync agent {} with new inputs...", i);
            for _ in 0..3 {
                let mut inputs_retry = Vec::new();
                for _ in 0..MAX_ITER {
                    let input = agents[0].random_input(&mut rng);
                    inputs_retry.push(input);
                }
                let mut tpm_a2 = agents[target_idx].clone();
                let mut tpm_b2 = agents[i].clone();
                if sync.synchronize(&mut tpm_a2, &mut tpm_b2, &inputs_retry) {
                    agents[i] = tpm_b2;
                    info!("Agent {} synchronized on retry!", i);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    println!("\n✅ Consensus result:");
    let mut all_synced = true;
    for i in 1..NUM_AGENTS {
        let synced = agents[0].is_synchronized(&agents[i]);
        println!("   Agent 0 ↔ Agent {}: {}", i, if synced { "✅ Synced" } else { "❌ Diverged" });
        if !synced { all_synced = false; }
    }

    if all_synced {
        let key = TpmSynchronizer::derive_key(&agents[0], 32);
        println!("\n🎉 All agents reached consensus!");
        println!("🔑 Shared key: {:x?}", &key[..8]);
        for i in 1..NUM_AGENTS {
            let key_i = TpmSynchronizer::derive_key(&agents[i], 32);
            assert_eq!(key, key_i);
        }
        println!("✅ All keys match!");
    } else {
        println!("⚠️ Consensus not fully reached. Try increasing iterations or retries.");
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
//! Real fwupd agent using zbus (D-Bus) with ObjectManager.
//!
//! Run: cargo run --example fwupd_agent
//! Requires: fwupd daemon running (sudo systemctl start fwupd)

use std::collections::HashMap;
use tracing::{info, warn, error};
use zbus::{Connection, Result as ZbusResult};
use zbus::zvariant::OwnedValue;
use zbus::fdo::ObjectManagerProxy;
use zbus::names::MemberName;
use zbus::proxy;

#[proxy(
    interface = "org.freedesktop.fwupd",
    default_service = "org.freedesktop.fwupd",
    default_path = "/"
)]
trait FwupdRoot {
    fn daemon_version(&self) -> ZbusResult<String>;
    fn refresh(&self, flags: u32) -> ZbusResult<()>;
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct DeviceInfo {
    id: String,
    name: String,
    version: String,
    vendor: String,
    update_available: bool,
}

impl DeviceInfo {
    fn from_properties(props: &HashMap<MemberName<'static>, OwnedValue>) -> Option<Self> {
        let get_str = |key: &str| {
            props.get(key).and_then(|v| v.downcast_ref::<str>().map(|s| s.to_string()))
        };
        let get_bool = |key: &str| {
            props.get(key).and_then(|v| v.downcast_ref::<bool>().copied()).unwrap_or(false)
        };

        Some(Self {
            id: get_str("DeviceID")?,
            name: get_str("Name")?,
            version: get_str("Version")?,
            vendor: get_str("Vendor").unwrap_or_default(),
            update_available: get_bool("UpdateAvailable"),
        })
    }
}

            device.name, device.id, device.version, status
        );
    }

    let root_proxy = match FwupdRootProxy::new(&connection).await {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(e) => {
            warn!("Could not create root proxy: {}", e);
            return Ok(());
        }
    };

    println!("\n🔄 Refreshing metadata...");
    match root_proxy.refresh(0).await {
        Ok(_) => info!("Metadata refreshed."),
        Err(e) => warn!("Refresh failed: {}", e),
    }

    println!("\n💡 To install an update manually, use:");
    println!("   fwupdmgr update");

    Ok(())
}
```
