## 🧪 TAREFA 4: EXECUTAR TESTES DE INTEGRAÇÃO (ASSET LIFECYCLE)

### 4.1. Suite de Testes de Integração

```rust
// tests/integration.rs
use Arkhe_taproot_bridge::TaprootClient;
use std::path::Path;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[cfg(test)]
mod integration_tests {
    use super::*;

    const ALICE_ADDR: &str = "http://localhost:10029";
    const BOB_ADDR: &str = "http://localhost:10030";

    /// Testa o ciclo de vida completo de um ativo:
    /// 1. Criar ativo
    /// 2. Emitir unidades
    /// 3. Transferir via Lightning
    /// 4. Verificar prova no Universe
    /// 5. Queimar ativo
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_asset_lifecycle() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let mut alice = TaprootClient::connect(
            ALICE_ADDR,
            None,  // sem TLS para testes
            Some(Path::new("certs/admin.macaroon")),
        ).await?;

        let mut bob = TaprootClient::connect(
            BOB_ADDR,
            None,
            Some(Path::new("certs/admin.macaroon")),
        ).await?;

        // 1. Alice cria ativo fungível
        let asset = alice
            .create_asset("TESTCOIN", 1_000_000, b"{\"issuer\":\"Arkhe OS\"}")
            .await?;
        assert!(!asset.asset_id.is_empty(), "Asset ID não pode ser vazio");
        println!("✅ Ativo criado: {}", hex::encode(&asset.asset_id));

        // 2. Alice emite mais unidades
        let issued = alice
            .issue_asset(&asset.asset_id, 500_000)
            .await?;
        assert!(issued.success, "Emissão falhou");
        println!("✅ Emitidas {} unidades", 500_000);

        // 3. Verifica balanço da Alice
        let balances = alice.list_balances(Some(asset.asset_id.clone()), None).await?;
        assert!(balances.balances.len() > 0, "Balanço não encontrado");
        let balance = balances.balances[0].balance;
        println!("💰 Balanço Alice: {}", balance);

        // 4. Obtém pubkey do Bob
        let bob_info = bob.get_info().await?;
        let bob_pubkey = bob_info.identity_pubkey;
        println!("🔑 Bob pubkey: {}", bob_pubkey);

        // 5. Alice envia ativos para Bob
        let send = alice
            .send_asset_to_pubkey(
                &asset.asset_id,
                100_000,
                &bob_pubkey,
                None,  // sem fee rate específico
            )
            .await?;
        assert!(send.success, "Transferência falhou");
        println!("📤 Enviados 100,000 unidades para Bob");

        // 6. Aguarda propagação
        sleep(Duration::from_secs(2)).await;

        // 7. Bob verifica prova no Universe
        let proof = bob
            .query_universe(Some(asset.asset_id.clone()), None)
            .await?;
        assert!(proof.assets.len() > 0, "Prova não encontrada no Universe");
        println!("📜 Prova verificada no Universe");

        // 8. Bob verifica balanço
        let bob_balances = bob
            .list_balances(Some(asset.asset_id.clone()), None)
            .await?;
        let bob_balance = bob_balances.balances[0].balance;
        assert!(bob_balance >= 100_000, "Bob não recebeu os ativos");
        println!("💰 Balanço Bob: {}", bob_balance);

        // 9. Bob queima ativo
        let burn = bob
            .burn_asset(&asset.asset_id, 10_000)
            .await?;
        assert!(burn.success, "Queima falhou");
        println!("🔥 Queimadas 10,000 unidades");

        // 10. Verifica balanço final de Bob
        let final_balances = bob
            .list_balances(Some(asset.asset_id.clone()), None)
            .await?;
        let final_balance = final_balances.balances[0].balance;
        assert_eq!(final_balance, bob_balance - 10_000, "Balanço final incorreto");
        println!("✅ Balanço final Bob: {}", final_balance);

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Testa o fluxo RFQ (Request-for-Quote)
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_rfq_flow() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let mut alice = TaprootClient::connect(ALICE_ADDR, None, None).await?;
        let mut bob = TaprootClient::connect(BOB_ADDR, None, None).await?;

        // 1. Criar ativo na Alice
        let asset = alice
            .create_asset("RFQCOIN", 1_000_000, b"{\"test\":\"rfq\"}")
            .await?;

        // 2. Alice solicita quote do Bob
        let bob_pubkey = bob.get_info().await?.identity_pubkey;

        // 3. Bob responde com quote (via RFQ)
        // Nota: O RFQ é implementado via mensagens BOLT 01
        // Para testes, usamos o mock oracle
        let quote = bob
            .request_quote(&asset.asset_id, 10_000, &bob_pubkey)
            .await?;
        println!("📊 Quote recebido: rate={}, expiry={:?}", quote.rate, quote.expiry);

        // 4. Alice aceita quote e envia
        let send = alice
            .send_asset_with_quote(&asset.asset_id, 10_000, &bob_pubkey, &quote)
            .await?;
        assert!(send.success, "Envio com quote falhou");

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Testa a verificação de provas
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_proof_verification() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let mut alice = TaprootClient::connect(ALICE_ADDR, None, None).await?;

        // 1. Criar ativo
        let asset = alice
            .create_asset("PROOFCOIN", 100_000, b"{\"test\":\"proof\"}")
            .await?;

        // 2. Exportar prova
        let proof = alice
            .export_proof(&asset.asset_id, None)
            .await?;
        assert!(!proof.proof.is_empty(), "Prova vazia");

        // 3. Verificar prova
        let verified = alice
            .verify_proof(proof.proof.clone())
            .await?;
        assert!(verified.valid, "Prova inválida");
        println!("✅ Prova verificada com sucesso");

        // 4. Decodificar prova
        let decoded = alice
            .decode_proof(proof.proof)
            .await?;
        println!("📜 Prova decodificada: {:?}", decoded);

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Testa a Universe Federation
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_universe_sync() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let mut alice = TaprootClient::connect(ALICE_ADDR, None, None).await?;
        let mut bob = TaprootClient::connect(BOB_ADDR, None, None).await?;

        // 1. Alice cria ativo
        let asset = alice
            .create_asset("UNIVCOIN", 1_000_000, b"{\"test\":\"universe\"}")
            .await?;

        // 2. Adiciona Bob à Universe Federation
        let bob_info = bob.get_info().await?;
        alice
            .add_universe_server(&bob_info.identity_pubkey, BOB_ADDR)
            .await?;

        // 3. Sincroniza Universe
        alice.sync_universe().await?;

        // 4. Bob consulta Universe
        let result = bob
            .query_universe(Some(asset.asset_id.clone()), None)
            .await?;
        assert!(result.assets.len() > 0, "Universe sync falhou");

        println!("✅ Universe Federation sincronizada");

        Ok(())
    }
}
```

### 5.1. Integração com MCP Bridge

```rust
// arkhe-agents/src/taproot/mod.rs
use Arkhe_taproot_bridge::TaprootClient;
use Arkhe_mcp_bridge::{McpBridge, McpMessage, McpType};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

/// Integração Taproot Assets com o MCP Bridge do Arkhe OS.
pub struct TaprootMcpIntegration {
    bridge: Arc<TaprootClient>,
    mcp: Arc<McpBridge>,
    /// Cache de ativos conhecidos
    asset_cache: RwLock<HashMap<String, AssetInfo>>,
}

impl TaprootMcpIntegration {
    pub async fn new(
        tapd_addr: &str,
        macaroon_path: Option<&str>,
        mcp_bridge: Arc<McpBridge>,
    ) -> Result<Self, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let client = TaprootClient::connect(
            tapd_addr,
            None,  // TLS config
            macaroon_path.map(Path::new),
        ).await?;

        Ok(Self {
            bridge: Arc::new(client),
            mcp: mcp_bridge,
            asset_cache: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
        })
    }

    /// Registra handlers MCP para operações Taproot Assets
    pub async fn register_handlers(&self) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Handler: criar ativo
        self.mcp.register_handler(
            "taproot.create_asset",
            self.handle_create_asset(),
        ).await?;

        // Handler: emitir ativo
        self.mcp.register_handler(
            "taproot.issue_asset",
            self.handle_issue_asset(),
        ).await?;

        // Handler: transferir ativo
        self.mcp.register_handler(
            "taproot.transfer_asset",
            self.handle_transfer_asset(),
        ).await?;

        // Handler: consultar balanço
        self.mcp.register_handler(
            "taproot.get_balance",
            self.handle_get_balance(),
        ).await?;

        // Handler: verificar prova
        self.mcp.register_handler(
            "taproot.verify_proof",
            self.handle_verify_proof(),
        ).await?;

        // Handler: RFQ
        self.mcp.register_handler(
            "taproot.request_quote",
            self.handle_request_quote(),
        ).await?;

        Ok(())
    }

    // Handlers individuais (simplificados)
    async fn handle_create_asset(&self) -> impl Fn(McpMessage) -> McpMessage + '_ {
        |msg| {
            // Extrai parâmetros da mensagem MCP
            // Executa a operação no tapd
            // Retorna resultado como mensagem MCP
            McpMessage::new(McpType::Response)
                .with_payload(json!({"status": "ok"}))
        }
    }

    // ... outros handlers
}

### 5.2. Integração com Arkhe Agents

```rust
// arkhe-agents/src/agent/taproot_agent.rs
use crate::agent::Agent;
use Arkhe_taproot_bridge::TaprootClient;
use Arkhe_identity::Did;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Agente especializado em operações Taproot Assets.
pub struct TaprootAgent {
    did: Did,
    client: Arc<TaprootClient>,
    /// Políticas de governança do agente
    policies: Vec<Box<dyn Policy>>,
}

impl TaprootAgent {
    pub fn new(did: Did, client: Arc<TaprootClient>) -> Self {
        Self {
            did,
            client,
            policies: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Adiciona uma política de governança
    pub fn add_policy(&mut self, policy: Box<dyn Policy>) {
        self.policies.push(policy);
    }

    /// Cria um ativo (sujeito a políticas)
    pub async fn create_asset(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        supply: u64,
        metadata: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<Asset, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Verifica políticas
        for policy in &self.policies {
            if !policy.can_create_asset(name, supply) {
                return Err("Policy violation".into());
            }
        }

        let response = self.client.create_asset(name, supply, metadata).await?;
        Ok(Asset {
            id: response.asset_id,
            name: name.to_string(),
            supply,
            metadata: metadata.to_vec(),
        })
    }

    /// Transfere ativo (sujeito a políticas)
    pub async fn transfer_asset(
        &self,
        asset_id: &[u8],
        amount: u64,
        destination: &str,
    ) -> Result<TransferResult, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Verifica políticas
        for policy in &self.policies {
            if !policy.can_transfer(asset_id, amount, destination) {
                return Err("Policy violation".into());
            }
        }

        let response = self.client.send_asset_to_pubkey(asset_id, amount, destination, None).await?;
        Ok(TransferResult {
            success: response.success,
            tx_id: response.tx_id,
        })
    }
}
```

### 6.2. Pricing Engine Avançado

```rust
// arkhe-agents/src/rfq/pricing_engine.rs
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use chrono::{Utc, DateTime};

/// Estratégia de precificação para RFQ.
pub trait PricingStrategy: Send + Sync {
    fn calculate_price(
        &self,
        asset_ref: &str,
        amount: u64,
        side: OrderSide,
        context: &PricingContext,
    ) -> f64;
}

/// Contexto de precificação
pub struct PricingContext {
    pub market_price: f64,
    pub liquidity: u64,
    pub volatility: f64,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub peer_reputation: f64,  // 0.0 - 1.0
}

/// Estratégia baseada em mercado com spread dinâmico
pub struct MarketSpreadPricing {
    spread_base: f64,          // spread base (ex: 0.01 = 1%)
    spread_volatility_factor: f64,  // fator de volatilidade
    min_spread: f64,
    max_spread: f64,
}

impl MarketSpreadPricing {
    pub fn new(spread_base: f64, volatility_factor: f64, min_spread: f64, max_spread: f64) -> Self {
        Self {
            spread_base,
            spread_volatility_factor: volatility_factor,
            min_spread,
            max_spread,
        }
    }

    fn calculate_spread(&self, volatility: f64) -> f64 {
        let spread = self.spread_base + (volatility * self.spread_volatility_factor);
        spread.clamp(self.min_spread, self.max_spread)
    }
}

impl PricingStrategy for MarketSpreadPricing {
    fn calculate_price(
        &self,
        _asset_ref: &str,
        amount: u64,
        side: OrderSide,
        context: &PricingContext,
    ) -> f64 {
        let spread = self.calculate_spread(context.volatility);
        let base_price = context.market_price;

        // Ajuste por quantidade (ordens maiores pagam mais spread)
        let liquidity_ratio = amount as f64 / (context.liquidity + 1) as f64;
        let size_adj = (liquidity_ratio * 0.5).min(0.05);

        let total_spread = spread + size_adj;

        match side {
            OrderSide::Buy => base_price * (1.0 + total_spread),
            OrderSide::Sell => base_price * (1.0 - total_spread),
        }
    }
}

/// Estratégia baseada em AMM (Automated Market Maker)
pub struct AmmPricing {
    reserve_asset: RwLock<HashMap<String, u64>>,  // reserva em asset
    reserve_btc: RwLock<HashMap<String, u64>>,    // reserva em BTC (sats)
    fee: f64,  // taxa AMM (0.003 = 0.3%)
}

impl AmmPricing {
    pub fn new(fee: f64) -> Self {
        Self {
            reserve_asset: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
            reserve_btc: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
            fee,
        }
    }

    pub async fn update_reserves(
        &self,
        asset_ref: &str,
        asset_amount: u64,
        btc_amount: u64,
    ) {
        let mut reserves = self.reserve_asset.write().await;
        reserves.insert(asset_ref.to_string(), asset_amount);
        let mut btc_reserves = self.reserve_btc.write().await;
        btc_reserves.insert(asset_ref.to_string(), btc_amount);
    }
}

impl PricingStrategy for AmmPricing {
    fn calculate_price(
        &self,
        asset_ref: &str,
        amount: u64,
        side: OrderSide,
        _context: &PricingContext,
    ) -> f64 {
        let asset_reserve = self.reserve_asset.blocking_read().get(asset_ref).cloned().unwrap_or(1_000_000);
        let btc_reserve = self.reserve_btc.blocking_read().get(asset_ref).cloned().unwrap_or(100_000_000);

        // Fórmula AMM: price = (reserve_btc / reserve_asset) * (1 + fee)
        let price = btc_reserve as f64 / asset_reserve as f64;

        match side {
            OrderSide::Buy => price * (1.0 + self.fee),   // comprador paga fee
            OrderSide::Sell => price * (1.0 - self.fee), // vendedor recebe menos
        }
    }
}
```

### 6.3. Order Book Avançado com Matching

```rust
// arkhe-agents/src/rfq/order_book_advanced.rs
use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use chrono::{Utc, DateTime, Duration};

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Order {
    pub id: String,
    pub asset_ref: String,
    pub side: OrderSide,
    pub amount: u64,
    pub filled: u64,
    pub price: f64,
    pub policy: ExecutionPolicy,
    pub status: OrderStatus,
    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub expires_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    pub peer_did: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum OrderStatus {
    Pending,
    PartiallyFilled,
    Filled,
    Cancelled,
    Expired,
    Settled,
}

/// Order Book com matching engine Price-Time priority.
pub struct OrderBookAdvanced {
    /// Ordens de compra (preço descendente)
    buy_orders: Mutex<Vec<Order>>,
    /// Ordens de venda (preço ascendente)
    sell_orders: Mutex<Vec<Order>>,
    /// Histórico de execuções
    history: Mutex<Vec<Execution>>,
}

impl OrderBookAdvanced {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            buy_orders: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
            sell_orders: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
            history: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Adiciona uma ordem
    pub async fn add_order(&self, order: Order) {
        let mut orders = match order.side {
            OrderSide::Buy => self.buy_orders.lock().await,
            OrderSide::Sell => self.sell_orders.lock().await,
        };
        orders.push(order);
        self.sort_orders(&mut orders, &order.side);
    }

    /// Ordena ordens (Price-Time priority)
    fn sort_orders(&self, orders: &mut Vec<Order>, side: &OrderSide) {
        match side {
            OrderSide::Buy => {
                // Maior preço primeiro, depois mais antigo
                orders.sort_by(|a, b| {
                    b.price.partial_cmp(&a.price)
                        .unwrap()
                        .then(a.created_at.cmp(&b.created_at))
                });
            }
            OrderSide::Sell => {
                // Menor preço primeiro, depois mais antigo
                orders.sort_by(|a, b| {
                    a.price.partial_cmp(&b.price)
                        .unwrap()
                        .then(a.created_at.cmp(&b.created_at))
                });
            }
        }
    }

    /// Executa matching entre ordens de compra e venda
    pub async fn match_orders(&self, asset_ref: &str) -> Vec<Execution> {
        let mut buy_orders = self.buy_orders.lock().await;
        let mut sell_orders = self.sell_orders.lock().await;
        let mut executions = Vec::new();

        // Filtra por ativo e status pending
        let mut buys: Vec<Order> = buy_orders
            .iter()
            .filter(|o| o.asset_ref == asset_ref && o.status == OrderStatus::Pending)
            .cloned()
            .collect();

        let mut sells: Vec<Order> = sell_orders
            .iter()
            .filter(|o| o.asset_ref == asset_ref && o.status == OrderStatus::Pending)
            .cloned()
            .collect();

        // Ordena
        buys.sort_by(|a, b| b.price.partial_cmp(&a.price).unwrap());
        sells.sort_by(|a, b| a.price.partial_cmp(&b.price).unwrap());

        let mut buy_idx = 0;
        let mut sell_idx = 0;

        while buy_idx < buys.len() && sell_idx < sells.len() {
            let buy = &mut buys[buy_idx];
            let sell = &mut sells[sell_idx];

            // Verifica se o preço de compra é >= preço de venda
            if buy.price < sell.price {
                break;  // não há match possível
            }

            // Quantidade a ser executada
            let buy_remaining = buy.amount - buy.filled;
            let sell_remaining = sell.amount - sell.filled;
            let exec_amount = buy_remaining.min(sell_remaining);

            // Preço de execução (média ponderada ou preço do sell)
            let exec_price = sell.price;

            // Cria execução
            let execution = Execution {
                id: format!("exec_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()),
                asset_ref: asset_ref.to_string(),
                buy_order_id: buy.id.clone(),
                sell_order_id: sell.id.clone(),
                amount: exec_amount,
                price: exec_price,
                timestamp: Utc::now(),
                status: ExecutionStatus::Pending,
            };

            // Atualiza ordens
            buy.filled += exec_amount;
            sell.filled += exec_amount;

            // Atualiza status
            if buy.filled == buy.amount {
                buy.status = OrderStatus::Filled;
            } else {
                buy.status = OrderStatus::PartiallyFilled;
            }

            if sell.filled == sell.amount {
                sell.status = OrderStatus::Filled;
            } else {
                sell.status = OrderStatus::PartiallyFilled;
            }

            executions.push(execution);

            // Avança índices
            if buy.filled == buy.amount {
                buy_idx += 1;
            }
            if sell.filled == sell.amount {
                sell_idx += 1;
            }
        }

        // Atualiza as listas principais
        *buy_orders = buys;
        *sell_orders = sells;

        // Registra histórico
        let mut history = self.history.lock().await;
        history.extend(executions.clone());

        executions
    }

    /// Obtém o melhor preço de compra
    pub async fn best_bid(&self, asset_ref: &str) -> Option<f64> {
        let orders = self.buy_orders.lock().await;
        orders
            .iter()
            .filter(|o| o.asset_ref == asset_ref && o.status == OrderStatus::Pending)
            .map(|o| o.price)
            .max_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap())
    }

    /// Obtém o melhor preço de venda
    pub async fn best_ask(&self, asset_ref: &str) -> Option<f64> {
        let orders = self.sell_orders.lock().await;
        orders
            .iter()
            .filter(|o| o.asset_ref == asset_ref && o.status == OrderStatus::Pending)
            .map(|o| o.price)
            .min_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap())
    }

    /// Obtém o spread atual
    pub async fn spread(&self, asset_ref: &str) -> Option<f64> {
        let bid = self.best_bid(asset_ref).await?;
        let ask = self.best_ask(asset_ref).await?;
        Some(ask - bid)
    }
}

/// Execução de ordem
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Execution {
    pub id: String,
    pub asset_ref: String,
    pub buy_order_id: String,
    pub sell_order_id: String,
    pub amount: u64,
    pub price: f64,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub status: ExecutionStatus,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum ExecutionStatus {
    Pending,
    Confirmed,
    Failed,
}
```

### 6.4. RFQ Handler com Integração Completa

```rust
// arkhe-agents/src/rfq/handler_advanced.rs
use crate::rfq::{RfqRequest, RfqResponse, Order, OrderSide, ExecutionPolicy, OrderStatus};
use crate::rfq::pricing_engine::{PricingStrategy, PricingContext};
use crate::rfq::order_book_advanced::{OrderBookAdvanced, Execution};
use Arkhe_taproot_bridge::TaprootClient;
use Arkhe_wormgraph::WormGraph;
use std::sync::Arc;
use chrono::{Utc, Duration};
use tracing::{info, warn, error};

pub struct RfqHandlerAdvanced {
    bridge: Arc<TaprootClient>,
    pricing_engine: Arc<dyn PricingStrategy>,
    order_book: Arc<OrderBookAdvanced>,
    wormgraph: Arc<WormGraph>,
    /// Limites de posição por ativo
    position_limits: Arc<HashMap<String, u64>>,
    /// Limites por peer
    peer_limits: Arc<HashMap<String, u64>>,
}

impl RfqHandlerAdvanced {
    pub fn new(
        bridge: Arc<TaprootClient>,
        pricing_engine: Arc<dyn PricingStrategy>,
        order_book: Arc<OrderBookAdvanced>,
        wormgraph: Arc<WormGraph>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            bridge,
            pricing_engine,
            order_book,
            wormgraph,
            position_limits: Arc::new(HashMap::new()),
            peer_limits: Arc::new(HashMap::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Processa uma RFQ com validação completa
    pub async fn handle_rfq(&self, request: RfqRequest) -> Result<RfqResponse, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // 1. Validação do ativo
        let asset_info = self.bridge.query_universe(&request.asset_ref).await?;
        if asset_info.assets.is_empty() {
            return Err("Asset not found in Universe".into());
        }

        // 2. Verificação de limites do peer
        if let Some(limit) = self.peer_limits.get(&request.peer_did) {
            if request.amount > *limit {
                return Err("Amount exceeds peer limit".into());
            }
        }

        // 3. Verificação de posição
        if let Some(limit) = self.position_limits.get(&request.asset_ref) {
            let current_position = self.get_position(&request.asset_ref).await?;
            if current_position + request.amount > *limit {
                return Err("Position limit exceeded".into());
            }
        }

        // 4. Contexto de precificação
        let market_price = self.get_market_price(&request.asset_ref).await?;
        let liquidity = self.get_liquidity(&request.asset_ref).await?;
        let volatility = self.get_volatility(&request.asset_ref).await?;
        let context = PricingContext {
            market_price,
            liquidity,
            volatility,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            peer_reputation: self.get_peer_reputation(&request.peer_did).await,
        };

        // 5. Calcula preço
        let price = self.pricing_engine.calculate_price(
            &request.asset_ref,
            request.amount,
            request.side.clone(),
            &context,
        );

        // 6. Verifica preço solicitado
        if let Some(requested_price) = request.requested_price {
            match request.side {
                OrderSide::Buy => {
                    if price > requested_price {
                        return Err("Price above requested limit".into());
                    }
                }
                OrderSide::Sell => {
                    if price < requested_price {
                        return Err("Price below requested limit".into());
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 7. Cria resposta
        let quote_id = format!("quote_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4());
        let response = RfqResponse {
            request_id: request.id.clone(),
            price,
            max_fill: request.amount,
            expiry: Utc::now() + Duration::minutes(1),
            quote_id: quote_id.clone(),
        };

        // 8. Registra no WormGraph
        self.wormgraph.record_event(
            "rfq_response",
            json!({
                "request_id": request.id,
                "quote_id": quote_id,
                "asset_ref": request.asset_ref,
                "price": price,
                "amount": request.amount,
                "side": request.side,
                "peer_did": request.peer_did,
            }),
        ).await?;

        Ok(response)
    }

    /// Executa uma ordem com base em uma RFQ aceita
    pub async fn execute_order(
        &self,
        request: RfqRequest,
        response: RfqResponse,
        policy: ExecutionPolicy,
    ) -> Result<ExecutionReport, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let order_id = format!("order_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4());

        // 1. Cria ordem
        let order = Order {
            id: order_id.clone(),
            asset_ref: request.asset_ref.clone(),
            side: request.side.clone(),
            amount: request.amount,
            filled: 0,
            price: response.price,
            policy: policy.clone(),
            status: OrderStatus::Pending,
            created_at: Utc::now(),
            expires_at: Some(response.expiry),
            peer_did: Some(request.peer_did.clone()),
        };

        // 2. Adiciona ao order book
        self.order_book.add_order(order.clone()).await;

        // 3. Executa matching
        let executions = self.order_book.match_orders(&request.asset_ref).await;

        // 4. Processa execuções
        let mut total_filled = 0;
        for exec in &executions {
            // Verifica se esta execução envolve nossa ordem
            if exec.buy_order_id == order_id || exec.sell_order_id == order_id {
                total_filled += exec.amount;

                // Executa na cadeia via Taproot Bridge
                self.execute_on_chain(exec).await?;
            }
        }

        // 5. Determina status final
        let status = if total_filled == request.amount {
            OrderStatus::Filled
        } else if total_filled > 0 {
            OrderStatus::PartiallyFilled
        } else {
            OrderStatus::Cancelled
        };

        // 6. Registra no WormGraph
        self.wormgraph.record_event(
            "order_execution",
            json!({
                "order_id": order_id,
                "asset_ref": request.asset_ref,
                "filled_amount": total_filled,
                "price": response.price,
                "status": status,
                "executions": executions.len(),
            }),
        ).await?;

        Ok(ExecutionReport {
            order_id,
            filled_amount: total_filled,
            price: response.price,
            status,
            tx_id: None,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
        })
    }

    /// Executa na cadeia via Taproot Bridge
    async fn execute_on_chain(&self, execution: &Execution) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Obtém detalhes da ordem
        // Envia ativos via tapd
        // Aguarda confirmação
        // Atualiza status
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Obtém preço de mercado (de fonte externa)
    async fn get_market_price(&self, _asset_ref: &str) -> Result<f64, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Implementação: consulta oracle externo ou agregação de múltiplas fontes
        Ok(1.0)  // placeholder
    }

    /// Obtém liquidez disponível
    async fn get_liquidity(&self, asset_ref: &str) -> Result<u64, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let balances = self.bridge.list_balances(Some(asset_ref.as_bytes().to_vec()), None).await?;
        Ok(balances.balances.iter().map(|b| b.balance).sum())
    }

    /// Obtém volatilidade
    async fn get_volatility(&self, _asset_ref: &str) -> Result<f64, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Implementação: calcula volatilidade histórica

    }

    /// Obtém reputação do peer
    async fn get_peer_reputation(&self, peer_did: &str) -> f64 {

    /// Obtém posição atual

        Ok(balances.balances.iter().map(|b| b.balance).sum())

}

## 🔬 1. ANÁLISE TÉCNICA APROFUNDADA

### 1.1. Taproot Assets: O Protocolo

Taproot Assets é um protocolo que permite a emissão e transferência de ativos (stablecoins, tokens, NFTs) **diretamente no Bitcoin**, utilizando a **Lightning Network** para transferências instantâneas e de baixo custo.

| Camada | Tecnologia | Função |
|--------|------------|--------|
| **Base** | Bitcoin (Taproot) | Ancoragem de ativos com provas criptográficas |
| **Camada 2** | Lightning Network | Transferências instantâneas e de baixo custo |
| **Ativos** | Taproot Assets | Emissão, transferência, queima |

**Diferencial:** Ativos são ancorados em UTXOs Bitcoin com provas de inclusão verificáveis, sem necessidade de contratos inteligentes complexos.

### 1.2. Taproot Assets SDK: Abstração para Desenvolvedores

O SDK (Go) expõe operações de alto nível que abstraem a complexidade do protocolo:

| Operação | Descrição |
|----------|-----------|
| `CreateFungible` | Cria um ativo fungível (ex: stablecoin) |
| `IssueFungible` | Emite unidades adicionais de um ativo existente |
| `Transfer` | Envia ativos para outro nó via Lightning |
| `Burn` | Queima unidades de um ativo (reduz oferta) |
| `AssetRef` | Handle auto-verificável que abstrai asset ID e group key |

**Design Inteligente:** O `AssetRef` é um único handle que pode ser verificado independentemente, sem necessidade de consultar um servidor central.

### 1.3. RFQ (Request-for-Quote) para Market-Making

O sistema RFQ permite que nós de borda atuem como market-makers para ativos:

- **Orquestração delegada**: pricing, hedging, acceptance policy em serviço externo
- **Controles de ordem**: limit-price bounds, minimum fill sizes, execution policy (IOC/FOK)
- **Negociação de quantidade**: accept messages sinalizam máximo preenchimento

## 🔗 2. MAPEAMENTO PARA O Arkhe OS

### 2.1. Convergências Arquiteturais

| Componente Taproot Assets | Equivalente/Integração Arkhe OS | Status | Estratégia |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------------|--------|------------|
| **tapd daemon** | `arkhe-bridge` (MCP + gRPC) | ⚠️ Avaliar | Integrar via MCP Bridge como fonte de dados |
| **Taproot Assets SDK (Go)** | `arkhe-hdc` + `arkhe-identity` | ✅ Compatível | Utilizar como referência para SDKs multi-linguagem |
| **AssetRef (identidade unificada)** | `arkhe-identity` (DID-based asset identity) | ✅ Alinhado | Adotar conceito para identidade de ativos Arkhe |
| **Universe Federation** | `arkhe-nostr` + WormGraph | ✅ Alinhado | Integrar como fonte de provas para ativos |
| **RFQ (precificação)** | `arkhe-agents` (market-making agents) | ✅ Oportunidade | Implementar agentes de market-making com RFQ |
| **Proof verification (7x faster)** | `arkhe-zk` (Halo2 proofs) | 🔄 Complementar | Usar Halo2 para verificações adicionais |
| **Backup/restore (3 modos)** | `arkhe-core` (M0-M4 memory) | ✅ Alinhado | Adaptar modos de backup para wallets Arkhe |
| **Macaroons (permissões)** | `arkhe-bridge` (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE) | ✅ Superior | Arkhe já tem modelo mais robusto |

### 2.2. Oportunidades Estratégicas Detalhadas

| Oportunidade | Aplicação no Arkhe OS | Benefício |
|--------------|---------------------------|-----------|
| **AssetRef** | Substituir/expandir identidade de ativos no `arkhe-identity` para suportar ativos Bitcoin/Lightning | Interoperabilidade nativa com ecossistema Bitcoin |
| **SDK portável** | Gerar SDKs em Rust, TypeScript, Python, Kotlin a partir de uma especificação unificada | Acelerar adoção em múltiplas plataformas |
| **RFQ** | Implementar agentes de market-making no `arkhe-agents` que respondem a RFQs | Criar um mercado descentralizado para ativos Arkhe |
| **Universe Federation** | Integrar com WormGraph para armazenar e compartilhar provas de ativos | Reforçar descentralização e auditabilidade |
| **Proof verification** | Combinar provas Taproot (Merkle) com provas ZK (Halo2) para verificação dupla | Aumentar confiabilidade e segurança |

### 3.3. Interface de Alto Nível

```rust
// arkhe-taproot-bridge/src/lib.rs

pub trait TaprootBridge {
    /// Mapeia um AssetRef para um DID Arkhe
    fn asset_ref_to_did(asset_ref: &str) -> Result<Did, BridgeError>;

    /// Transfere um ativo Taproot para uma carteira Arkhe
    async fn transfer_asset(
        &self,
        asset_ref: &str,
        amount: u64,
        destination: &str, // Endereço Lightning ou DID
    ) -> Result<Txid, BridgeError>;

    /// Emite um novo ativo fungível via tapd
    async fn issue_asset(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        supply: u64,
        metadata: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<AssetRef, BridgeError>;

    /// Obtém a prova de um ativo
    async fn get_proof(&self, asset_ref: &str) -> Result<Proof, BridgeError>;

    /// Verifica uma prova (Merkle + Halo2 opcional)
    async fn verify_proof(&self, proof: &Proof) -> Result<bool, BridgeError>;
}
```

### 3.4. Integração com RFQ Agents

```rust
// arkhe-agents/src/market_maker/rfq.rs

pub struct RfqAgent {
    bridge: TaprootBridge,
    pricing_policy: Box<dyn PricingPolicy>,
    order_book: OrderBook,
}

impl RfqAgent {
    /// Responde a uma RFQ com um preço e quantidade
    pub async fn handle_rfq(&self, rfq: RfqRequest) -> RfqResponse {
        let price = self.pricing_policy.price(&rfq.asset, rfq.amount);
        RfqResponse {
            asset: rfq.asset,
            price,
            max_fill: rfq.amount.min(self.order_book.liquidity(&rfq.asset)),
            expiry: Utc::now() + Duration::from_secs(30),
        }
    }

    /// Executa uma ordem (IOC ou FOK)
    pub async fn execute_order(&self, order: Order) -> Result<ExecutionReport, Error> {
        match order.execution_policy {
            ExecutionPolicy::IOC => {
                // Preenche o que for possível, cancela o resto
            }
            ExecutionPolicy::FOK => {
                // Preenche tudo ou cancela tudo
            }
        }
        // ...
    }
}
```

### 3.5. Backup e Restore no Arkhe OS

Adaptando os 3 modos do Taproot Assets para o Arkhe OS:

| Modo | Arkhe Equivalente | Descrição |
|------|----------------------|-----------|
| **Raw** | Full M4 snapshot | Exporta todas as provas e estados |
| **Compact** | M3 state + WormGraph refs | Reconstrói provas a partir de referências |
| **Optimistic** | M0-M2 + Nostr discovery | Confia na rede para provas |

## 📊 4. ANÁLISE COMPARATIVA: Taproot Assets vs. Arkhe OS

| Critério | Taproot Assets | Arkhe OS | Veredito |
|----------|---------------|--------------|----------|
| **Base de ativos** | Bitcoin (Taproot) | Multi-chain (Bitcoin, Ethereum, BRICS) | Arkhe é mais abrangente |
| **Camada 2** | Lightning Network | MCP Bridge + Substratos | Arkhe é mais flexível |
| **Identidade de ativos** | AssetRef (auto-verificável) | DID (descentralizado) | Ambos são fortes |
| **Provas** | Merkle (UTXO-based) | Merkle + Halo2 (ZK) | Arkhe é mais auditável |
| **Market-Making** | RFQ (nós de borda) | Agentes autônomos (RFQ + políticas) | Arkhe é mais autônomo |
| **Backup** | 3 modos (raw/compact/optimistic) | M0-M4 + TemporalChain | Arkhe é mais granular |
| **Permissões** | Macaroons | OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + PAT | Arkhe é mais robusto |

### 1.2. Análise Crítica da API gRPC

Os serviços principais do `tapd` (via gRPC) são:

| Serviço | Método | Descrição |
|---------|--------|-----------|
| `AssetWallet` | `CreateAsset` | Cria um novo ativo (fungível ou colecionável) |
| `AssetWallet` | `IssueAsset` | Emite unidades adicionais de um ativo existente |
| `AssetWallet` | `SendAsset` | Envia ativos para outro nó (via Lightning ou on-chain) |
| `AssetWallet` | `BurnAsset` | Queima unidades de um ativo |
| `Universe` | `QueryUniverse` | Consulta provas de ativos da Universe Federation |
| `Universe` | `InsertProof` | Insere uma prova no Universe local |
| `Rpc` | `GetInfo` | Obtém informações do nó |

**Padrões de Design Observados:**
- **AssetRef**: um identificador que pode ser asset_id (UUID) ou group_key (fungíveis)
- **Paginável**: todas as listagens suportam `offset` e `limit`
- **Macaroons**: credenciais de acesso com permissões escopadas
- **TLS**: comunicação segura por padrão (mTLS recomendado)

### 1.3. Análise do SDK (Go)

O SDK abstrai complexidades:

```go
// Exemplo do SDK (Go)
asset, err := client.CreateFungible(ctx, &CreateFungibleRequest{
    Name:        "USDC",
    Supply:      1000_000_000, // 1000 unidades com 6 decimais
    MetaData:    []byte(`{"issuer":"Arkhe OS"}`),
})
if err != nil {
    // ...
}
// asset.AssetRef é um handle auto-verificável
```

**Pontos-Chave para o Cliente Rust:**
- O SDK usa o mesmo `tapd` gRPC API — não há uma API separada
- O SDK adiciona conveniência (ex: `AssetRef` parsing, auto-verificação)
- As mensagens protobuf são compartilhadas entre `tapd` e SDK

### 2.1. Estrutura do Crate

// arkhe-taproot-bridge/Cargo.toml
[package]

### 2.2. Geração de Código Protobuf (`build.rs`)

```rust
// build.rs
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let proto_root = PathBuf::from("proto");
    let proto_files = [
        "rpc.proto",
        "assetwallet.proto",
        "universe.proto",
    ];

    // Baixar os arquivos proto do repositório oficial (ou usar submodule)
    // Exemplo: wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lightninglabs/taproot-assets/main/rpc/rpc.proto

    tonic_build::configure()
        .build_client(true)
        .build_server(false)
        .out_dir("src/proto")
        .compile(&proto_files, &[&proto_root])?;

    Ok(())
}
```

### 2.3. Cliente Base

```rust
// src/client.rs
use tonic::transport::{Channel, Certificate, ClientTlsConfig};
use tonic::{Request, Response, Status};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::{info, warn, error};

// Incluir os módulos gerados
pub mod proto {
    tonic::include_proto!("taprootassets");
}

use proto::{
    assetwallet_client::AssetWalletClient,
    universe_client::UniverseClient,
    rpc_client::RpcClient,
    // Tipos de mensagem
    CreateAssetRequest, CreateAssetResponse,
    IssueAssetRequest, IssueAssetResponse,
    SendAssetRequest, SendAssetResponse,
    BurnAssetRequest, BurnAssetResponse,
    QueryUniverseRequest, QueryUniverseResponse,
    GetInfoRequest, GetInfoResponse,
};

use crate::error::BridgeError;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct TaprootClient {
    asset_wallet: AssetWalletClient<Channel>,
    universe: UniverseClient<Channel>,
    rpc: RpcClient<Channel>,
    macaroon: Option<Vec<u8>>,
}

impl TaprootClient {
    /// Conecta a um nó tapd via gRPC.
    pub async fn connect(
        addr: &str,
        tls: bool,
        macaroon_path: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<Self, BridgeError> {
        let mut endpoint = tonic::transport::Endpoint::from_shared(addr.to_string())?;

        if tls {
            // Carrega certificado TLS (o tapd usa TLS por padrão)
            // Idealmente usar mTLS com client certificate
            let tls_config = ClientTlsConfig::new()
                .ca_certificate(Certificate::from_pem(load_ca_cert()?))
                .domain_name("localhost"); // ou domínio configurado
            endpoint = endpoint.tls_config(tls_config)?;
        }

        let channel = endpoint.connect().await?;

        // Carrega macaroon se fornecido
        let macaroon = if let Some(path) = macaroon_path {
            Some(std::fs::read(path)?)
        } else {
            None
        };

        Ok(Self {
            asset_wallet: AssetWalletClient::new(channel.clone()),
            universe: UniverseClient::new(channel.clone()),
            rpc: RpcClient::new(channel.clone()),
            macaroon,
        })
    }

    /// Adiciona macaroon ao metadado da requisição (se disponível)
    fn add_macaroon<T>(&self, mut req: Request<T>) -> Request<T> {
        if let Some(mac) = &self.macaroon {
            let mac_hex = hex::encode(mac);
            req.metadata_mut().insert(
                "macaroon",
                tonic::metadata::MetadataValue::from_str(&mac_hex).unwrap(),
            );
        }
        req
    }

    // --- Operações de carteira ---

    /// Cria um novo ativo fungível.
    pub async fn create_fungible(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        supply: u64,
        metadata: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<CreateAssetResponse, BridgeError> {
        let req = CreateAssetRequest {
            name: name.to_string(),
            supply,
            metadata: metadata.to_vec(),
            asset_type: 0, // 0 = fungível
            // ... outros campos (decimals, etc.)
        };
        let request = self.add_macaroon(Request::new(req));
        let response = self.asset_wallet.create_asset(request).await?;
        Ok(response.into_inner())
    }

    /// Emite unidades adicionais de um ativo existente.
    pub async fn issue_asset(
        &mut self,
        asset_ref: &str,
        amount: u64,
    ) -> Result<IssueAssetResponse, BridgeError> {
        let req = IssueAssetRequest {
            asset_ref: asset_ref.to_string(),
            amount,
        };
        let request = self.add_macaroon(Request::new(req));
        let response = self.asset_wallet.issue_asset(request).await?;
        Ok(response.into_inner())
    }

    /// Envia ativos para outro nó via Lightning.
    pub async fn send_asset(
        &mut self,
        asset_ref: &str,
        amount: u64,
        dest_pubkey: &str,
        dest_asset_ref: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<SendAssetResponse, BridgeError> {
        let req = SendAssetRequest {
            asset_ref: asset_ref.to_string(),
            amount,
            dest_pubkey: dest_pubkey.to_string(),
            dest_asset_ref: dest_asset_ref.map(|s| s.to_string()),
            // Opções de roteamento
        };
        let request = self.add_macaroon(Request::new(req));
        let response = self.asset_wallet.send_asset(request).await?;
        Ok(response.into_inner())
    }

    /// Queima unidades de um ativo.
    pub async fn burn_asset(
        &mut self,
        asset_ref: &str,
        amount: u64,
    ) -> Result<BurnAssetResponse, BridgeError> {
        let req = BurnAssetRequest {
            asset_ref: asset_ref.to_string(),
            amount,
        };
        let request = self.add_macaroon(Request::new(req));
        let response = self.asset_wallet.burn_asset(request).await?;
        Ok(response.into_inner())
    }

    // --- Operações Universe ---

    /// Consulta provas de um ativo na Universe Federation.
    pub async fn query_universe(
        &mut self,
        asset_ref: &str,
    ) -> Result<QueryUniverseResponse, BridgeError> {
        let req = QueryUniverseRequest {
            asset_ref: asset_ref.to_string(),
        };
        let request = self.add_macaroon(Request::new(req));
        let response = self.universe.query_universe(request).await?;
        Ok(response.into_inner())
    }

    // --- Operações RPC ---

    /// Obtém informações do nó.
    pub async fn get_info(&mut self) -> Result<GetInfoResponse, BridgeError> {
        let req = GetInfoRequest {};
        let request = self.add_macaroon(Request::new(req));
        let response = self.rpc.get_info(request).await?;
        Ok(response.into_inner())
    }
}
```

### 2.4. Mapeamento AssetRef ↔ DID

```rust
// src/identity.rs
use Arkhe_identity::Did;

/// Converte um AssetRef (string) para um DID Arkhe.
/// O AssetRef pode ser um asset_id (UUID) ou uma group_key (hex).
pub fn asset_ref_to_did(asset_ref: &str) -> Option<Did> {
    // Usa o padrão did:key:<base64> ou did:Arkhe:<asset_ref>
    // Exemplo: did:Arkhe:asset:group_key_hex
    if asset_ref.starts_with("group_key_") {
        // Extrai a chave e cria DID
        let key = asset_ref.trim_start_matches("group_key_");
        Some(Did::from_string(&format!("did:Arkhe:asset:{}", key)))
    } else {
        // Assume que é um asset_id (UUID)
        Some(Did::from_string(&format!("did:Arkhe:asset:{}", asset_ref)))
    }
}

/// Converte um DID para um AssetRef (se for um asset do Arkhe)
pub fn did_to_asset_ref(did: &Did) -> Option<String> {
    let prefix = "did:Arkhe:asset:";
    if did.to_string().starts_with(prefix) {
        let asset_ref = did.to_string().trim_start_matches(prefix);
        Some(asset_ref.to_string())
    } else {
        None
    }
}
```

```rust
// src/error.rs
use thiserror::Error;
use tonic::Status;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum BridgeError {
    #[error("Transport error: {0}")]
    Transport(#[from] tonic::transport::Error),
    #[error("gRPC error: {0}")]
    Grpc(#[from] Status),
    #[error("IO error: {0}")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
    #[error("Invalid AssetRef: {0}")]
    InvalidAssetRef(String),
    #[error("DID conversion error")]
    DidConversion,
    #[error("Macaroon error: {0}")]
    Macaroon(String),
    #[error("Proof verification failed")]
    ProofVerification,
}

impl From<tonic::Status> for BridgeError {
    fn from(status: Status) -> Self {
        BridgeError::Grpc(status)
    }
}

### 3.2. Fluxo de Teste

| Passo | Ação | Verificação |
|-------|------|-------------|
| 1 | Iniciar containers | LND sincronizado, tapd conectado |
| 2 | Criar asset no Alice | `tapcli assets create --name TEST --supply 1000000` |
| 3 | Conectar Alice ↔ Bob | `tapcli universe federation add bob` |
| 4 | Enviar asset via Lightning | `tapcli assets send --asset-ref ... --dest bob-pubkey` |

| 6 | Queimar ativo no Bob | `tapcli assets burn --asset-ref ... --amount 100` |

### 3.3. Script de Validação em Rust

```rust
// tests/integration_test.rs
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use Arkhe_taproot_bridge::TaprootClient;
    use tokio;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_asset_lifecycle() {
        let mut alice = TaprootClient::connect(
            "http://localhost:10000",
            false,
            Some("certs/admin.macaroon"),
        ).await.unwrap();

        let mut bob = TaprootClient::connect(
            "http://localhost:10001",
            false,
            Some("certs/admin.macaroon"),
        ).await.unwrap();

        // 1. Alice cria ativo
        let asset = alice.create_fungible("TEST", 1_000_000, b"{}").await.unwrap();
        assert!(!asset.asset_ref.is_empty());

        // 2. Alice emite mais
        let issued = alice.issue_asset(&asset.asset_ref, 500_000).await.unwrap();
        assert!(issued.success);

        // 3. Obtém pubkey do Bob
        let bob_info = bob.get_info().await.unwrap();
        let bob_pubkey = bob_info.pubkey;

        // 4. Alice envia para Bob
        let send = alice.send_asset(&asset.asset_ref, 100_000, &bob_pubkey, None).await.unwrap();
        assert!(send.success);

        // 5. Bob consulta Universe para verificar prova
        let proof = bob.query_universe(&asset.asset_ref).await.unwrap();
        assert!(proof.assets.len() > 0);

        // 6. Bob queima ativo
        let burn = bob.burn_asset(&asset.asset_ref, 10_000).await.unwrap();
        assert!(burn.success);
    }
}
```

### 3.4. Desafios e Soluções

| Desafio | Solução |
|---------|---------|
| **Autenticação** | Usar macaroons com permissões apropriadas (read, write, courier) |
| **Roteamento de pagamentos** | Garantir que ambos os nós estejam conectados e com canais abertos |
| **Sincronização de Universe** | Aguardar propagação de provas (pode levar alguns segundos) |
| **Provas grandes** | Verificar tamanho das provas e usar mode compact/optimistic conforme necessário |
| **Timeouts** | Aumentar timeouts para transações na Lightning (ex: 60s) |

### 4.3. Pricing Engine

```rust
// src/rfq/pricing.rs
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

pub trait PricingPolicy: Send + Sync {
    fn price(&self, asset_ref: &str, amount: u64, side: OrderSide) -> f64;
}

/// Estratégia de preço baseada em mercado (cenário simples)
pub struct MarketPricing {
    base_price: RwLock<HashMap<String, f64>>,
    spread: f64, // spread percentual (ex: 0.01 = 1%)
}

impl MarketPricing {
    pub fn new(spread: f64) -> Self {
        Self {
            base_price: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
            spread,
        }
    }

    pub async fn update_price(&self, asset_ref: &str, price: f64) {
        let mut map = self.base_price.write().await;
        map.insert(asset_ref.to_string(), price);
    }
}

impl PricingPolicy for MarketPricing {
    fn price(&self, asset_ref: &str, amount: u64, side: OrderSide) -> f64 {
        let base = self.base_price.blocking_read().get(asset_ref).cloned().unwrap_or(1.0);
        let adjusted = match side {
            OrderSide::Buy => base * (1.0 + self.spread),  // compra paga spread
            OrderSide::Sell => base * (1.0 - self.spread), // venda recebe menos
        };
        adjusted
    }
}

/// Estratégia de preço dinâmica (ex: com base em liquidez)
pub struct DynamicPricing {
    pub base_prices: RwLock<HashMap<String, f64>>,
    pub liquidity_pools: RwLock<HashMap<String, f64>>, // quantidade disponível
}

impl PricingPolicy for DynamicPricing {
    fn price(&self, asset_ref: &str, amount: u64, side: OrderSide) -> f64 {
        let base = self.base_prices.blocking_read().get(asset_ref).cloned().unwrap_or(1.0);
        let liquidity = self.liquidity_pools.blocking_read().get(asset_ref).cloned().unwrap_or(0.0);
        // Quanto maior a ordem em relação à liquidez, maior o spread
        let spread_factor = (amount as f64 / (liquidity + 1.0)).min(0.5);
        let spread = 0.01 + spread_factor * 0.05;
        match side {
            OrderSide::Buy => base * (1.0 + spread),
            OrderSide::Sell => base * (1.0 - spread),
        }
    }
}
```

### 4.4. Order Book

```rust
// src/rfq/order_book.rs
use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use chrono::{Utc, Duration};

pub struct OrderBook {
    orders: Mutex<Vec<Order>>,
}

impl OrderBook {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            orders: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Adiciona uma nova ordem
    pub async fn add_order(&self, order: Order) {
        let mut orders = self.orders.lock().await;
        orders.push(order);
    }

    /// Encontra ordens de compra para um ativo específico
    pub async fn get_buy_orders(&self, asset_ref: &str) -> Vec<Order> {
        let orders = self.orders.lock().await;
        orders.iter()
            .filter(|o| o.asset_ref == asset_ref && o.side == OrderSide::Buy && o.status == OrderStatus::Pending)
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    /// Encontra ordens de venda para um ativo específico
    pub async fn get_sell_orders(&self, asset_ref: &str) -> Vec<Order> {
        let orders = self.orders.lock().await;
        orders.iter()
            .filter(|o| o.asset_ref == asset_ref && o.side == OrderSide::Sell && o.status == OrderStatus::Pending)
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    /// Remove ordens expiradas
    pub async fn clean_expired(&self) {
        let mut orders = self.orders.lock().await;
        let now = Utc::now();
        orders.retain(|o| {
            if let Some(expires) = o.expires_at {
                if now > expires {
                    return false; // remove
                }
            }
            true
        });
    }

    /// Encontra ordens com preço melhor ou igual ao limite
    pub async fn find_matching_orders(
        &self,
        asset_ref: &str,
        side: OrderSide,
        price_limit: f64,
        amount: u64,
    ) -> Vec<Order> {
        let orders = self.orders.lock().await;
        let matching: Vec<Order> = orders.iter()
            .filter(|o| {
                o.asset_ref == asset_ref
                    && o.side == side
                    && o.status == OrderStatus::Pending
                    && o.price <= price_limit // para compras, preço <= limite; para vendas, preço >= limite
            })
            .cloned()
            .collect();
        // Ordena por preço (menor para compra, maior para venda)
        // ... (simplificado)
        matching
    }
}
```

### 4.5. RFQ Handler

```rust
// src/rfq/handler.rs
use crate::TaprootClient;
use crate::rfq::{RfqRequest, RfqResponse, Order, ExecutionPolicy, OrderStatus, ExecutionReport};
use crate::rfq::pricing::PricingPolicy;
use crate::rfq::order_book::OrderBook;
use std::sync::Arc;
use chrono::{Utc, Duration};
use tracing::{info, warn, error};

pub struct RfqHandler {
    bridge: Arc<TaprootClient>,
    pricing_engine: Arc<dyn PricingPolicy>,
    order_book: Arc<OrderBook>,
    min_fill_amount: u64,
    max_order_size: u64,
}

impl RfqHandler {
    pub fn new(
        bridge: Arc<TaprootClient>,
        pricing_engine: Arc<dyn PricingPolicy>,
        order_book: Arc<OrderBook>,
        min_fill_amount: u64,
        max_order_size: u64,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            bridge,
            pricing_engine,
            order_book,
            min_fill_amount,
            max_order_size,
        }
    }

    /// Processa uma RFQ recebida
    pub async fn handle_rfq(&self, request: RfqRequest) -> Result<RfqResponse, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Verifica se o ativo é suportado
        // (validação de asset_ref via bridge)
        let asset_info = self.bridge.query_universe(&request.asset_ref).await?;
        if asset_info.assets.is_empty() {
            return Err("Asset not found in Universe".into());
        }

        // Verifica limites de quantidade
        if request.amount < self.min_fill_amount {
            return Err("Amount below minimum fill".into());
        }
        if request.amount > self.max_order_size {
            return Err("Amount exceeds max order size".into());
        }

        // Calcula preço
        let price = self.pricing_engine.price(
            &request.asset_ref,
            request.amount,
            request.side,
        );

        // Verifica se o preço solicitado é aceitável (se fornecido)
        if let Some(requested_price) = request.requested_price {
            match request.side {
                OrderSide::Buy => {
                    if price > requested_price {
                        return Err("Price above requested limit".into());
                    }
                }
                OrderSide::Sell => {
                    if price < requested_price {
                        return Err("Price below requested limit".into());
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Cria a resposta
        let quote_id = format!("quote_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4());
        Ok(RfqResponse {
            request_id: request.id,
            price,
            max_fill: request.amount,
            expiry: Utc::now() + Duration::minutes(1),
            quote_id,
        })
    }

    /// Executa uma ordem baseada em uma RFQ aceita
    pub async fn execute_order(
        &self,
        request: RfqRequest,
        response: RfqResponse,
        policy: ExecutionPolicy,
    ) -> Result<ExecutionReport, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let order_id = format!("order_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4());

        // Cria a ordem
        let order = Order {
            id: order_id.clone(),
            asset_ref: request.asset_ref.clone(),
            side: request.side.clone(),
            amount: request.amount,
            filled: 0,
            price: response.price,
            policy: policy.clone(),
            status: OrderStatus::Pending,
            created_at: Utc::now(),
            expires_at: Some(response.expiry),
        };

        // Adiciona ao order book
        self.order_book.add_order(order.clone()).await;

        // Simula matching (na prática, isso seria mais complexo)
        let executed = match policy {
            ExecutionPolicy::FOK => self.execute_fok(order).await,
            ExecutionPolicy::IOC => self.execute_ioc(order).await,
            ExecutionPolicy::GTC => self.execute_gtc(order).await,
        }?;

        // Se executado, usa a bridge para transferir ativos
        if executed.status == OrderStatus::Filled || executed.status == OrderStatus::PartiallyFilled {
            self.execute_on_chain(&executed).await?;
        }

        Ok(executed)
    }

    async fn execute_fok(&self, order: Order) -> Result<ExecutionReport, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Verifica se há liquidez suficiente para preencher completamente
        let available = self.check_liquidity(&order.asset_ref, order.amount).await?;
        if available < order.amount {
            return Ok(ExecutionReport {
                order_id: order.id,
                filled_amount: 0,
                price: order.price,
                status: OrderStatus::Cancelled,
                tx_id: None,
                timestamp: Utc::now(),
            });
        }
        // Preenche completamente
        Ok(ExecutionReport {
            order_id: order.id,
            filled_amount: order.amount,
            price: order.price,
            status: OrderStatus::Filled,
            tx_id: None,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
        })
    }

    async fn execute_ioc(&self, order: Order) -> Result<ExecutionReport, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let available = self.check_liquidity(&order.asset_ref, order.amount).await?;
        let filled = order.amount.min(available);
        let status = if filled == order.amount {
            OrderStatus::Filled
        } else if filled > 0 {
            OrderStatus::PartiallyFilled
        } else {
            OrderStatus::Cancelled
        };
        Ok(ExecutionReport {
            order_id: order.id,
            filled_amount: filled,
            price: order.price,
            status,
            tx_id: None,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
        })
    }

    async fn execute_gtc(&self, order: Order) -> Result<ExecutionReport, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Mantém a ordem ativa até ser preenchida ou cancelada
        // (simplificado: preenche o máximo possível agora)
        self.execute_ioc(order).await
    }

    async fn check_liquidity(&self, asset_ref: &str, amount: u64) -> Result<u64, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Consulta saldo do ativo via bridge
        // (implementação depende da API do tapd para balance)
        // Por enquanto, retorna amount (assume liquidez total)
        Ok(amount)
    }

    async fn execute_on_chain(&self, report: &ExecutionReport) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Usa a bridge para enviar ativos
        // (precisa de detalhes do destinatário, pubkey, etc.)
        // Exemplo:
        // self.bridge.send_asset(&order.asset_ref, report.filled_amount, dest_pubkey, None).await?;
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

### 4.6. Integração com Arkhe Agents

```rust
// arkhe-agents/src/agent/market_maker.rs
use Arkhe_taproot_bridge::{TaprootClient, TaprootBridge};
use crate::rfq::{RfqHandler, MarketPricing, OrderBook};
use crate::Arkhe_identity::Did;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

pub struct MarketMakerAgent {
    did: Did,
    bridge: Arc<TaprootClient>,
    rfq_handler: Arc<RfqHandler>,
    active_orders: RwLock<Vec<Order>>,
}

impl MarketMakerAgent {
    pub async fn new(
        did: Did,
        bridge: Arc<TaprootClient>,
        spread: f64,
        min_fill: u64,
        max_order: u64,
    ) -> Self {
        let order_book = Arc::new(OrderBook::new());
        let pricing = Arc::new(MarketPricing::new(spread));
        let handler = Arc::new(RfqHandler::new(
            bridge.clone(),
            pricing,
            order_book.clone(),
            min_fill,
            max_order,
        ));

        Self {
            did,
            bridge,
            rfq_handler: handler,
            active_orders: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Escuta por RFQs (via MCP ou gRPC) e responde
    pub async fn listen_for_rfqs(&self) {
        // Implementação de listener
        // Exemplo: via MCP Bridge, recebe mensagens com tipo "rfq"
        // Para cada mensagem, chama self.handle_rfq()
        loop {
            tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
            // Simula recebimento de RFQ
            // (na prática, isso seria um canal de comunicação)
        }
    }

    /// Publica uma ordem no order book
    pub async fn publish_order(&self, order: Order) {
        self.rfq_handler.order_book.add_order(order).await;
    }

    /// Executa uma ordem
    pub async fn execute_order(&self, request: RfqRequest, response: RfqResponse) -> Result<ExecutionReport, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        self.rfq_handler.execute_order(request, response, ExecutionPolicy::IOC).await
    }

    /// Obtém status de uma ordem
    pub async fn get_order_status(&self, order_id: &str) -> Option<OrderStatus> {
        let orders = self.rfq_handler.order_book.orders.lock().await;
        orders.iter().find(|o| o.id == order_id).map(|o| o.status.clone())
    }
}
```

### 4.7. Configuração e Inicialização

```rust
// src/bin/rfq_agent.rs
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    tracing_subscriber::fmt::init();

    // Conecta ao tapd
    let bridge = Arc::new(TaprootClient::connect(
        "https://localhost:10000",
        true,
        Some("certs/admin.macaroon"),
    ).await?);

    // Cria agente market-maker
    let did = Did::from_string("did:Arkhe:agent:alice");
    let agent = MarketMakerAgent::new(
        did,
        bridge,
        0.02, // 2% spread
        1000, // min fill
        1_000_000, // max order
    ).await;

    // Inicia listener
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        agent.listen_for_rfqs().await;
    });

    // Publica ordens iniciais (ex: compra/venda)
    let buy_order = Order {
        id: "order_buy_001".to_string(),
        asset_ref: "asset_test".to_string(),
        side: OrderSide::Buy,
        amount: 500_000,
        filled: 0,
        price: 0.98,
        policy: ExecutionPolicy::GTC,
        status: OrderStatus::Pending,
        created_at: Utc::now(),
        expires_at: None,
    };
    agent.publish_order(buy_order).await;

    let sell_order = Order {
        id: "order_sell_001".to_string(),
        asset_ref: "asset_test".to_string(),
        side: OrderSide::Sell,
        amount: 300_000,
        filled: 0,
        price: 1.02,
        policy: ExecutionPolicy::GTC,
        status: OrderStatus::Pending,
        created_at: Utc::now(),
        expires_at: None,
    };
    agent.publish_order(sell_order).await;

    // Mantém o agente rodando
    println!("RFQ Agent running...");
    tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await?;
    Ok(())
}

### 2.2. `build.rs`

```rust
// build.rs
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::env;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let out_dir = PathBuf::from(env::var("OUT_DIR")?);
    let proto_dir = PathBuf::from(env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")?).join("proto");

    // Lista dos 5 protofiles (incluindo tapcommon.proto)
    let proto_files = [
        "tapcommon.proto",
        "taprootassets.proto",
        "assetwallet.proto",
        "universe.proto",
        "rfq.proto",
    ];

    let proto_paths: Vec<PathBuf> = proto_files
        .iter()
        .map(|f| proto_dir.join(f))
        .collect();

    // Verificar se todos os arquivos existem
    for path in &proto_paths {
        if !path.exists() {
            println!("cargo:warning=Proto file not found: {}", path.display());
            return Err(format!("Missing proto file: {}", path.display()).into());
        }
    }

    tonic_build::configure()
        .build_client(true)
        .build_server(false)
        .build_transport(true)
        .out_dir(&out_dir)
        .compile(&proto_paths, &[&proto_dir])?;

    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=proto/");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs");

    Ok(())
}
```

### 3.1. `src/error.rs` — Tratamento de Erros

```rust
// src/error.rs
use thiserror::Error;
use tonic::Status;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum BridgeError {
    #[error("Transport error: {0}")]
    Transport(#[from] tonic::transport::Error),

    #[error("gRPC error: {0}")]
    Grpc(#[from] Status),

    #[error("IO error: {0}")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),

    #[error("Invalid AssetRef: {0}")]
    InvalidAssetRef(String),

    #[error("DID conversion error")]
    DidConversion,

    #[error("Macaroon error: {0}")]
    Macaroon(String),

    #[error("Proof verification failed: {0}")]
    ProofVerification(String),

    #[error("Universe sync failed: {0}")]
    UniverseSync(String),

    #[error("Asset not found: {0}")]
    AssetNotFound(String),

    #[error("Insufficient balance: need {need} have {have}")]
    InsufficientBalance { need: u64, have: u64 },

    #[error("Timeout: {0}")]
    Timeout(String),

    #[error("Invalid address: {0}")]
    InvalidAddress(String),

    #[error("Configuration error: {0}")]
    Config(String),

    #[error("Internal error: {0}")]
    Internal(String),
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, BridgeError>;

impl From<BridgeError> for tonic::Status {
    fn from(err: BridgeError) -> Self {
        tonic::Status::internal(err.to_string())
    }
}

### 3.2. `src/auth.rs` — Autenticação TLS + Macaroons

```rust
// src/auth.rs
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;
use tonic::transport::{Certificate, ClientTlsConfig};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum AuthError {
    #[error("Invalid macaroon: {0}")]
    InvalidMacaroon(String),
    #[error("IO error: {0}")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
    #[error("TLS error: {0}")]
    Tls(String),
}

/// Macaroon de autenticação para tapd (formato LND).
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Macaroon {
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
    permissions: Vec<String>,
}

impl Macaroon {
    pub fn from_file(path: &Path) -> Result<Self, AuthError> {
        let bytes = fs::read(path)?;
        Self::from_bytes(bytes)
    }

    pub fn from_bytes(bytes: Vec<u8>) -> Result<Self, AuthError> {
        if bytes.is_empty() {
            return Err(AuthError::InvalidMacaroon("Empty macaroon".to_string()));
        }
        // Permissões padrão: read, write, courier
        let permissions = vec![
            "read".to_string(),
            "write".to_string(),
            "courier".to_string(),
        ];
        Ok(Self { bytes, permissions })
    }

    pub fn bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.bytes
    }

    pub fn to_hex(&self) -> String {
        hex::encode(&self.bytes)
    }

    pub fn permissions(&self) -> &[String] {
        &self.permissions
    }
}

/// Configuração TLS para conexão com tapd.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct TlsConfig {
    pub ca_cert: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    pub client_cert: Option<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)>, // (cert, key)
    pub domain: String,
}

impl TlsConfig {
    pub fn new(domain: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            ca_cert: None,
            client_cert: None,
            domain: domain.into(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_ca(mut self, ca_pem: Vec<u8>) -> Self {
        self.ca_cert = Some(ca_pem);
        self
    }

    pub fn with_client_cert(mut self, cert_pem: Vec<u8>, key_pem: Vec<u8>) -> Self {
        self.client_cert = Some((cert_pem, key_pem));
        self
    }

    pub fn to_tonic_config(&self) -> Result<ClientTlsConfig, AuthError> {
        let mut config = ClientTlsConfig::new().domain_name(self.domain.clone());

        if let Some(ca) = &self.ca_cert {
            config = config.ca_certificate(Certificate::from_pem(ca));
        }

        if let Some((cert, key)) = &self.client_cert {
            config = config.identity(Certificate::from_pem(cert), Certificate::from_pem(key));
        }

        Ok(config)
    }
}
```

### 3.3. `src/client.rs` — Cliente gRPC Principal

```rust
// src/client.rs
use tonic::metadata::MetadataValue;
use tonic::transport::{Channel, ClientTlsConfig};
use tonic::{Request, Status};
use std::path::Path;
use std::time::Duration;
use tracing::{debug, warn};

// Módulo gerado pelo build.rs
pub mod proto {
    tonic::include_proto!("tapcommon");
    tonic::include_proto!("taprootassets");
    tonic::include_proto!("assetwallet");
    tonic::include_proto!("universe");
    tonic::include_proto!("rfq");
}

use proto::{
    taproot_assets_client::TaprootAssetsClient,
    asset_wallet_client::AssetWalletClient,
    universe_client::UniverseClient,
    rfq_client::RfqClient,
    // Mensagens principais
    GetInfoRequest, GetInfoResponse,
    ListAssetsRequest, ListAssetsResponse,
    ListBalancesRequest, ListBalancesResponse,
    NewAddrRequest, NewAddrResponse,
    SendAssetRequest, SendAssetResponse,
    BurnAssetRequest, BurnAssetResponse,
    // Universe
    QueryProofRequest, QueryProofResponse,
    InsertProofRequest, InsertProofResponse,
    AssetLeavesRequest, AssetLeavesResponse,
    AssetRootsRequest, AssetRootsResponse,
    // RFQ
    AddAssetBuyOrderRequest, AddAssetBuyOrderResponse,
    AddAssetSellOrderRequest, AddAssetSellOrderResponse,
    ForwardingHistoryRequest, ForwardingHistoryResponse,
};

use crate::auth::{Macaroon, TlsConfig};
use crate::error::{BridgeError, Result};

/// Cliente principal para o Taproot Assets Daemon (tapd).
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct TaprootClient {
    /// Cliente do serviço TaprootAssets (core)
    pub taproot: TaprootAssetsClient<Channel>,
    /// Cliente do serviço AssetWallet (PSBT, chaves)
    pub asset_wallet: AssetWalletClient<Channel>,
    /// Cliente do serviço Universe (provas)
    pub universe: UniverseClient<Channel>,
    /// Cliente do serviço RFQ (ordens/ofertas)
    pub rfq: RfqClient<Channel>,
    /// Macaroon de autenticação
    macaroon: Option<Macaroon>,
    /// Timeout padrão
    timeout: Duration,
}

impl TaprootClient {
    /// Conecta a um nó tapd via gRPC.
    ///
    /// # Arguments
    /// * `addr` - Endereço do nó (ex: "https://localhost:10029" ou "http://localhost:10029")
    /// * `tls` - Configuração TLS (opcional)
    /// * `macaroon_path` - Caminho para o arquivo macaroon (opcional)
    ///
    /// # Example
    /// ```rust,no_run
    /// use Arkhe_taproot_bridge::{TaprootClient, TlsConfig};
    /// use std::path::Path;
    ///
    /// # async fn example() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    /// let client = TaprootClient::connect(
    ///     "https://localhost:10029",
    ///     Some(TlsConfig::new("localhost")),
    ///     Some(Path::new("~/.taproot-assets/admin.macaroon")),
    /// ).await?;
    /// # Ok(())
    /// # }
    /// ```
    pub async fn connect(
        addr: &str,
        tls: Option<TlsConfig>,
        macaroon_path: Option<&Path>,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        let mut endpoint = tonic::transport::Endpoint::from_shared(addr.to_string())?;

        if let Some(tls_config) = tls {
            let tonic_config = tls_config
                .to_tonic_config()
                .map_err(|e| BridgeError::Macaroon(e.to_string()))?;
            endpoint = endpoint.tls_config(tonic_config)?;
        } else {
            warn!("Connecting without TLS - insecure!");
        }

        let channel = endpoint.connect().await?;

        // Carrega macaroon se fornecido
        let macaroon = if let Some(path) = macaroon_path {
            let mac = Macaroon::from_file(path)
                .map_err(|e| BridgeError::Macaroon(e.to_string()))?;
            Some(mac)
        } else {
            None
        };

        Ok(Self {
            taproot: TaprootAssetsClient::new(channel.clone()),
            asset_wallet: AssetWalletClient::new(channel.clone()),
            universe: UniverseClient::new(channel.clone()),
            rfq: RfqClient::new(channel.clone()),
            macaroon,
            timeout: Duration::from_secs(30),
        })
    }

    /// Adiciona macaroon aos metadados da requisição.
    fn add_auth<T>(&self, mut req: Request<T>) -> Request<T> {
        if let Some(mac) = &self.macaroon {
            let mac_hex = mac.to_hex();
            if let Ok(val) = MetadataValue::from_str(&mac_hex) {
                req.metadata_mut().insert("macaroon", val);
            }
        }
        req
    }

    // --- Operações gerais ---

    /// Obtém informações do nó tapd.
    pub async fn get_info(&mut self) -> Result<GetInfoResponse> {
        let req = GetInfoRequest {};
        let request = self.add_auth(Request::new(req));
        let response = self.taproot.get_info(request).await?;
        Ok(response.into_inner())
    }
}

// Os métodos das operações core, Universe e RFQ são implementados
// nos módulos operations/*.rs e estendem TaprootClient via impl.
```

### 3.4. `src/identity.rs` — AssetRef ↔ DID Mapping

```rust
// src/identity.rs
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// Representação de um AssetRef do Taproot Assets.
/// Pode ser um asset_id (UUID) ou group_key (hex).
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssetRef {
    /// Asset ID (UUID, 32 bytes)
    AssetId(String),
    /// Group key (hex string, para fungíveis)
    GroupKey(String),
}

impl AssetRef {
    /// Cria um AssetRef a partir de uma string.
    pub fn from_string(s: &str) -> Self {
        if s.starts_with("group_key_") || s.starts_with("g_") {
            let key = s.trim_start_matches("group_key_").trim_start_matches("g_");
            AssetRef::GroupKey(key.to_string())
        } else {
            AssetRef::AssetId(s.to_string())
        }
    }

    /// Converte para string.
    pub fn to_string(&self) -> String {
        match self {
            AssetRef::AssetId(id) => id.clone(),
            AssetRef::GroupKey(key) => format!("group_key_{}", key),
        }
    }

    /// Converte para um DID Arkhe.
    pub fn to_did(&self) -> String {
        match self {
            AssetRef::AssetId(id) => format!("did:Arkhe:asset:{}", id),
            AssetRef::GroupKey(key) => format!("did:Arkhe:group:{}", key),
        }
    }

    /// Cria a partir de um DID Arkhe.
    pub fn from_did(did: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        if let Some(id) = did.strip_prefix("did:Arkhe:asset:") {
            Some(AssetRef::AssetId(id.to_string()))
        } else if let Some(key) = did.strip_prefix("did:Arkhe:group:") {
            Some(AssetRef::GroupKey(key.to_string()))
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for AssetRef {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}", self.to_string())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_asset_ref_parsing() {
        let id = AssetRef::from_string("abc123");
        assert!(matches!(id, AssetRef::AssetId(_)));
        assert_eq!(id.to_string(), "abc123");

        let key = AssetRef::from_string("group_key_0xdeadbeef");
        assert!(matches!(key, AssetRef::GroupKey(_)));
        assert_eq!(key.to_string(), "group_key_0xdeadbeef");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_did_conversion() {
        let id = AssetRef::AssetId("test-id".to_string());
        let did = id.to_did();
        assert_eq!(did, "did:Arkhe:asset:test-id");

        let parsed = AssetRef::from_did(&did);
        assert_eq!(parsed, Some(id));
    }
}
```
